attribute_bonus.desc: Improves all attributes per point spent

backdoor_protection.desc: Structure takes reduced damage, and quickly regenerates any damage taken while no enemy creeps are nearby.

backdoor_protection_in_base.desc: Structure takes reduced damage, and quickly regenerates any damage taken while no enemy creeps are nearby.

necronomicon_warrior_last_will.desc: Deals damage to the unit that kills the Necronomicon Warrior.

necronomicon_warrior_mana_burn.desc: Mana burned per hit, a portion of which is dealt as damage.

necronomicon_archer_mana_burn.desc: Launches an arrow that burns away the targeted unit's mana, dealing damage equal to the amount of mana burned.

necronomicon_archer_purge.desc:
Dispels positive buffs from enemies and slows their movement speed.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: The slow starts at 100%% and decreases over time to 20%%.

courier_go_to_secretshop.desc: Sends the courier to your team's secret shop

courier_shield.desc: Summons a protective shield around the courier

courier_burst.desc: The courier gains a burst of speed for %duration% seconds

roshan_spell_block.desc: Roshan will block one targeted spell every 15 seconds. Also reduces status effects by 25%.

roshan_bash.desc: Roshan has a chance to stun on attack.

roshan_slam.desc: Roshan slams the ground, damaging and slowing all nearby enemies. Slam's damage will increase every minute. Slam does %damage_bonus_creeps%%% increased damage to creeps.

roshan_revengeroar.desc: When facing the team that last killed him, Roshan will release an angry roar, heard everywhere on the map, that damages everyone in a %radius% AoE and disarms them for %disarm_duration% seconds. Units that have been roared take %damage_pct%%% increased incoming damage.

roshan_grab_and_throw.desc: Heroes that get in Roshan's way while he's moving between pits will be violently thrown away. Upon landing, heroes take damage and become stunned for %stun_duration% second. Deals additional damage for each throw he's done within one cycle of moving between pits.
notes: Heroes will be thrown away from Roshan based on their relative position to Roshan.

roshan_devotion.desc: Roshan possesses numerous protective abilities, including 55%% magic damage resistance, the ability to reduce damage from attacking illusions, and a scaling armor bonus that increases as time goes on.

kobold_taskmaster_speed_aura.desc: The Kobold Foreman's cruel efficiency increases his movement speed and the movement speed of all nearby allies.

ogre_bruiser_ogre_smash.desc: Ogre slowly charges a big attack stunning for %hero_stun_duration% seconds and dealing %damage% + %damage_pct%%% of their current HP as damage to all units in front of him.

giant_wolf_intimidate.desc: The Giant Wolf's ferocious roar reduces all nearby enemies total attack damage.

hill_troll_rally.desc: Skeleton's allies gain bonus attack damage. This Aura stacks.

berserker_troll_break.desc: Launches a stone at the target location, dealing a small amount of damage and applying break to units hit.

spawnlord_master_stomp.desc: Stomps the ground, dealing damage to nearby units and reducing their base physical armor by %armor_reduction_pct%%%.

spawnlord_master_freeze.desc: Causes the next attack to petrify the enemy, rooting them and dealing %damage% damage per second.

gnoll_assassin_envenomed_weapon.desc: The Vhoul Assassin has soaked his weapons in his own blend of painful predator venoms that causes his enemies' natural regeneration to work against themselves. Heroes recover from the poison more quickly.

ghost_frost_attack.desc: The Ghost launches an eerie attack that chills her enemies to their bones.

neutral_spell_immunity.desc: This creature does not feel the effects of most magical spells.

mud_golem_rock_destroy.desc: On death, Mud Golems shatter into several Shard Golems.

warpine_raider_seed_shot.desc: Hucks a snowball at a target. The snowball can bounce multiple times to nearby enemies and allies, slowing and damaging enemies and healing allies.

mud_golem_hurl_boulder.desc: Hurls a boulder at the target, damaging and stunning them.

mud_golem_hurl_big_boulder.desc: Launches a huge stone at the target location, dealing a small amount of damage and stunning units hit.

giant_wolf_critical_strike.desc: The Giant Wolf's ferocious attacks occasionally tear a vital tendon, inflicting critical damage.

alpha_wolf_critical_strike.desc: The cruel Alpha Wolf attacks his enemy's unprotected vitals at every opportunity, inflicting critical damage.

alpha_wolf_command_aura.desc: The Alpha Wolf's ruthless attacks do extra damage. His commanding presence inspires nearby allies to attack ruthlessly as well.

frostbitten_golem_time_warp_aura.desc: Coming from a different era, the Frostbitten Golem has an innate control of time, speeding up the cooldowns of all nearby allies.

centaur_khan_endurance_aura.desc: The fearsome Hellbear attacks more quickly and bullies nearby allies into following suit.

centaur_khan_war_stomp.desc: The Centaur Conqueror's powerful hooves stomp the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemies. Heroes recover more quickly.

ice_shaman_incendiary_bomb.desc: The Ice Shaman chucks a blue flame towards an enemy unit or building, dealing damage over time.

radigull_eggstremism.desc: The Radigull lays %egg_count% eggs in a cone in front of it. Each egg explodes after %fuse_duration% seconds, damaging and silencing nearby enemies.

ancient_rock_golem_weakening_aura.desc: The Rock Golem's imposing figure makes enemies more susceptible to Physical Damage.

eimermole_miners_aura.desc: The Eimermole's warding presence denies relief to nearby enemies, reducing all Health Restoration they receive.

eimermole_miners_slam.desc: The Eimermole Foreman slowly winds up an overhead slam, then hammers the ground %pulse_count% times in front of him. Each blow deals %damage% damage and slows by %slow_pct%%% for %slow_duration% seconds.

odobenus_blight.desc: The Odobenus Footman's attacks corrode the target's defenses, reducing their armor for %armor_reduction_duration% seconds.

black_drake_magic_amplification_aura.desc: The Black Drakes' gaze make enemies more susceptible to Spell Damage.

tornado_tempest.desc: The Tornado's overpowering winds slow all nearby enemies, flinging debris at them and inflicting damage every second. Enemies closer to the center of the Tornado take more damage.

miniboss_unyielding_shield.desc: Passively grants a regenerating All Damage Barrier. Armor can not go below 0.

miniboss_reflect.desc: Reflects damage received evenly to the attacker and all other heroes within 1200 radius
notes: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

miniboss_radiance.desc: Deals %aura_damage% damage to all units within %aura_radius% range every second for %attack_timer_duration%s once attacked or damaged.

miniboss_alleviation.desc: After death, the Tormentor leaves behind a verdant dale, increasing the regeneration of everyone nearby by %hp_restoration_pct%%% of their Max Health.

miniboss_fortification.desc: Damage taken is reduced by %damage_reduction_per_tower%%% for each Tier 1 Tower on its team that is still standing.

creep_siege.desc: Reinforced Units and Buildings Deal Bonus Damage to other Reinforced Units and Buildings and take less attack damage from other units.

creep_piercing.desc: Piercing Units Deal Bonus Damage to non-hero, non-heavy units and reduced damage to heroes and heavy units.

creep_irresolute.desc: Runty Units Deal reduced damage to hero units.

enraged_wildkin_tornado.desc: CHANNELED - The Wildwing calls on the spirit of the wind, creating a sentient Tornado that he can control. The Tornado slows nearby enemies and does damage. It is invulnerable and can move anywhere.

enraged_wildkin_hurricane.desc: The Wildwing Ripper calls on the spirit of the wind, creating a hurricane that can push a unit in the direction of Wildwing Ripper's choice.

kobold_disarm.desc: Kobold Soldier sends forward a projection that deals a small amount of damage and applies break to enemies hit

enraged_wildkin_toughness_aura.desc: The Wildwing Ripper's fury numbs it to attacks and inspires nearby allies to withstand more blows.

flagbearer_creep_aura_effect.desc: The Flagbearer inspires all allied creeps, granting them bonus health regeneration and magic resistance.
notes: Magic resistance bonus upgrades by %bonus_magic_resistance_per_interval%%% every 7.5 minutes, up to a maximum of %maximum_intervals% upgrades.

granite_golem_hp_aura.desc: Increases the health capacity of nearby units.

satyr_trickster_purge.desc:
The Satyr Banisher knows every trick in the book, allowing him to dispel debuffs from allies or buffs from enemies. His trickery also slows the enemy's movement.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

satyr_soulstealer_mana_burn.desc: The Satyr Mindstealer removes a fragment of his enemy's soul, burning away mana equal to %burn_amount% + %int_multiplier%x the target's intelligence, and dealing damage equal to the amount of mana burned.

satyr_hellcaller_shockwave.desc: The Satyr Tormenter tears open an unstable rift to the underworld, creating a shockwave that travels in a line along the ground, dealing damage to enemies it hits.

satyr_hellcaller_unholy_aura.desc: The Satyr Tormenter's demonic communion allows him to emanate regenerative power, increasing the health regeneration of himself and all nearby allies.

forest_troll_high_priest_heal.desc: The Hill Troll Priest lays his holy blessing upon the target ally, replenishing some health.

harpy_scout_take_off.desc: Harpy Scout gains flying movement at the cost of movement speed. Consumes mana while active.

furbolg_enrage_attack_speed.desc: When Hellbear dies, all nearby allies go into a frenzy gaining attack speed for a short amount of time.

furbolg_enrage_damage.desc: When Hellbear Smasher dies, all nearby allies go into a rampage gaining bonus attack damage for a short amount of time.

polar_furbolg_ursa_warrior_thunder_clap.desc: The Hellbear Smasher claps his massive hands together, creating a deafening blast. The blast damages nearby enemies and throws them off their footing.

kobold_tunneler_prospecting.desc: Kobolds are adept at finding gold, increasing nearby allied heroes' GPM.

harpy_storm_chain_lightning.desc: The Harpy Stormcrafter releases a high-voltage bolt of electricity at the target enemy, dealing damage. The bolt jumps to other nearby enemies, losing power with each jump.

big_thunder_lizard_wardrums_aura.desc: The rhythm of the Thunderhide's heartbeat increases the attack speed and accuracy of nearby allies.

black_dragon_dragonhide_aura.desc: The Ancient Black Dragon's dreaded presence grants nearby allies additional armor. This bonus can stack with itself.

black_dragon_fireball.desc: Takes flight in an arc toward the targeted direction and loops back to its starting position, leaving a trail of fire in its wake. The fire burns for %duration% seconds, dealing %damage% damage per second to enemies caught in it.
notes: The flight lasts %dive_duration% seconds and cannot be cancelled by the caster.
Overlapping patches of fire do not stack.

mudgolem_cloak_aura.desc: This creature protects its allies with a Magic resistance aura. Creeps are better protected.

black_dragon_splash_attack.desc: The Black Dragon's explosive attacks are felt by all nearby enemies.

spawnlord_aura.desc: Gives lifesteal and health regeneration to nearby allies.

big_thunder_lizard_slam.desc: The Ancient Thunderhide slams his mammoth foot against the ground, sending %pulse_count% shockwaves, each smaller than the last. Every wave damages enemies it catches and throws them off their footing, slowing their movement and attack speed. Heroes regain their balance more quickly.

big_thunder_lizard_frenzy.desc: The Ancient Thunderhide works an ally into a frenzy, causing his ally to have increased attack speed.

ogre_seal_flop.desc: The Ancient Ogre Seal flops forward %max_bounces% times, dealing damage and slowing enemies in an area on each landing.

ogre_seal_pup_disapproval_aura.desc: The Ancient Ogre Seal Pup's withering glare slows nearby enemies.

forest_troll_high_priest_mana_aura.desc: Provides bonus mana regeneration to all nearby allies.

forest_troll_high_priest_heal_amp_aura.desc: Provides bonus Heal Amplification to all nearby allies.

frogmen_riverborn_aura.desc: Whenever the Frog is in water, it increases all allied movement speed and outgoing damage.

frogmen_arm_of_the_deep.desc: Sends out a slew of tentacles in the target direction, stunning and damaging enemies.

frogmen_tendrils_of_the_deep.desc: Sends out a cone-shaped slew of tentacles in the target direction, stunning and damaging enemies.

frogmen_congregation_of_the_deep.desc: Sends out a slew of tentacles in all directions, stunning and damaging enemies.

frogmen_water_bubble_small.desc: Creates a barrier bubble that protects the target from magic damage for %duration%s.

frogmen_water_bubble_medium.desc: Creates a barrier bubble that protects the target from magic damage for %duration%s. After it expires, it heals the target for %heal_pct%%% of the absorb amount.

frogmen_water_bubble_large.desc: Creates a barrier bubble that protects the target from magic damage for %duration%s. After it expires, it heals the target and all allies in the radius for %heal_pct%%% of the absorb amount.

ad_special_bonus_gold_lvl10_l.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

ad_special_bonus_gold_lvl15_l.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

ad_special_bonus_gold_lvl20_l.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

ad_special_bonus_gold_lvl25_l.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

ad_special_bonus_gold_lvl10_r.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

ad_special_bonus_gold_lvl15_r.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

ad_special_bonus_gold_lvl20_r.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

ad_special_bonus_gold_lvl25_r.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

seasonal_throw_snowball.desc: Throw a snowball at an ally or enemy.

seasonal_summon_penguin.desc: Summon a friendly penguin who slides around. Each time a hero bumps the penguin, it gains speed and lasts a bit longer.
notes: Your team's penguins will pass through enemy heroes that you don't have vision of.

seasonal_decorate_tree.desc: Give any tree a delightfully seasonal touch.

seasonal_festive_firework.desc: Shoot a firework into the air.

seasonal_party_hat.desc: CHANNELED. Steals an enemy hero's stack of Frostivus hats, or gives your stack to an allied hero.
seasonal_party_hat.scepter: Spirit of Frostivus becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Hats are taken from enemies first, then evenly distributed amongst allies.

plus_high_five.desc: Throw your hand (or handy appendage) in the air!

plus_guild_banner.desc: Plant your guild's banner to mark this battleground for you all!

seasonal_dark_carnival_firework.desc: Shoot a firework into the air.

abaddon_death_coil.desc:
Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist at the cost of Abaddon's health. Friendly units are healed and have their movement speed increased. Enemy units are damaged and slowed.

Health cost is %self_damage_pct%%% of the Damage/Heal amount.
abaddon_death_coil.scepter:
Mist Coil affects all units in a %effect_radius% radius around the target.

When Mist Coil hits enemies, Abaddon deals %damage_percentage_on_perform_attack%%% of his attack damage and applies on-hit effects with %potency%%% Item Potency.
notes: Abaddon can not kill himself with this skill.
Mist Coil's health cost will damage Aphotic Shield and other barriers before using Abaddon's health.

abaddon_aphotic_shield.desc:
Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
abaddon_aphotic_shield.shard: %absorb_to_damage%%% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies.
notes: The max damage is always dealt whether the barrier is destroyed by expiring or absorbing damage.
The explosion does not damage units hidden by the fog of war.

abaddon_withering_mist.desc:
Damaging enemies reduces their Health Restoration for %duration%s. The lower the enemy's HP, the stronger the Health restoration reduction effect. Minimum effect of %min_heal_reduction_pct%%% at full health. Maximum effect at zero health.

Does not apply from item damage.

abaddon_frostmourne.desc: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Abaddon gains %curse_self_attack_speed_multiplier_tooltip_only%x the attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by %tower_dps_penalty_pct%%%.

abaddon_borrowed_time.desc:
When activated, dispels you and all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm. If the ability is not on cooldown, it will automatically activate if your health falls below %hp_threshold%.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: Borrowed Time can be manually activated while Abaddon is disabled, but not while silenced.  The passive activation can still occur while silenced.
Aphotic Shield does not block any damage to Abaddon when Borrowed Time is active, allowing him to heal.
Break prevents Borrowed Time from automatically activating.

special_bonus_unique_abaddon_immolation.desc: Affects Abaddon and all enemies in a {s:bonus_immolate_aoe} AoE.

abyssal_underlord_firestorm.desc: Calls down waves of fire that damage enemy units in the target area, burning for additional damage over time.
abyssal_underlord_firestorm.shard: Firestorm can be allied targeted. When used that way, the Firestorm follows the hero around.  The wave count is increased, and tick rate / duration time occur more quickly.

abyssal_underlord_pit_of_malice.desc: A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every %pit_interval% seconds.

abyssal_underlord_atrophy_aura.desc: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.
notes: Break disables the Attack Damage Reduction aura and prevents Underlord from gaining new bonus damage.

abyssal_underlord_dark_portal.desc: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for %warp_channel_duration% seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least %minimum_distance% away from each other.
abyssal_underlord_dark_portal.scepter: Summons a Pit of Malice around the furthermost of the portals. Reduces cooldown.
notes: Double-click to teleport to your team's base, in front of your fountain

abyssal_underlord_raid_boss.desc: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain a Physical Damage Barrier based on their max health and Movement Speed. Allies receive %dark_portal_multiplier%x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.

abyssal_underlord_abyssal_horde.desc:
After teleporting through the Fiend's Gate, Underlord brings forth a Warrior or an Archer to aid him every %underling_spawn_interval%s that last for the duration of the Fiend's Gate.

The Warrior burns mana every hit, and deals magical damage to whoever kills it. The Archer has a passive movement speed aura.

abyssal_underling_warrior_last_will.desc: Deals damage to the unit that kills the Necronomicon Warrior.

abyssal_underling_warrior_mana_burn.desc: Mana burned per hit, a portion of which is dealt as damage.

alchemist_berserk_potion.desc:
Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

alchemist_acid_spray.desc: Sprays high-pressure acid across a target area. Enemy units who step across the contaminated terrain take damage per second and have their armor reduced.

alchemist_unstable_concoction.desc: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After %brew_time% seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after %brew_explosion% seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.
notes: While brewing, this ability is replaced by Unstable Concoction Throw.  Alchemist can move and act normally while brewing.
A timer above Alchemist's head will indicate the remaining brew time. This timer is visible to enemies.
You can deny yourself with this skill.
Unstable Concoction cannot be disjointed and once thrown Unstable Concoction stops brewing.
Unstable Concoction explosion damages heroes and creeps.

alchemist_unstable_concoction_throw.desc: Throw it before it blows up!

alchemist_goblins_greed.desc: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next %duration% seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.
alchemist_goblins_greed.scepter: Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and %bonus_gold_per_scepter% additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.

alchemist_chemical_rage.desc:
Alchemist causes his Ogre to enter a chemically induced rage, reducing base attack cooldown and increasing movement speed and health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Has a %transformation_time% second transformation time, which can be used to dodge projectiles and stuns.

alchemist_corrosive_weaponry.desc:
Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

Attacks apply %stacks_per_attack% stacks. Unstable Concoction applies %one_tooltip% stack per second of brew time.

ancient_apparition_cold_feet.desc: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target.  If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after %AbilityDuration% seconds.
notes: Deals damage every half second.

ancient_apparition_ice_vortex.desc: Creates a vortex of icy energy that slows, deals damage, and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.
notes: Provides vision in a small area where it is placed.

ancient_apparition_chilling_touch.desc: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range and a burst of magical damage and slow.

ancient_apparition_ice_blast.desc: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
ancient_apparition_ice_blast.shard: Freezes enemies hit with the current level of Cold Feet for %cold_feet_stun_duration_pct%%% of the duration.
notes: Upon cast, this ability is replaced by Release, used to stop the tracer on the target area.
The area of effect is %radius_min% + %radius_grow%*TimeTraveled, capped at %radius_max%.
Kill will be granted to the source of the damage that triggers the shatter.
The shatter effect doesn't work on illusions.
The HP Freeze prevents most kinds of healing, including the fountain, except Sunder, Time Lapse and Supernova.

ancient_apparition_bone_chill.desc: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy Hero with his abilities its Strength is reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.

ancient_apparition_ice_blast_release.desc: Releases the ice blast to explode at the tracer's current location. Can be cast while silenced.

antimage_mana_break.desc: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.
antimage_mana_break.scepter: Increases Max Mana Burned per Hit.
notes: Mana Break has %illusion_percentage%%% mana burn effect if caused by illusions.

antimage_persectur.desc: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at %mana_threshold%%% mana, up to max slow at 0%% mana. No effect if enemy is above %mana_threshold%%% mana.
notes: Full effect if caused by illusions.

antimage_blink.desc: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.
antimage_blink.scepter: After casting Blink, your next Mana Break within %empowered_mana_break_duration%s burns an additional %empowered_max_burn_pct_tooltip%%% max mana and prevents the target from regenerating or gaining mana for a short duration. This debuff is undispellable.
notes: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.

antimage_counterspell.desc: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.
antimage_counterspell.shard: Creates a blinked fragment of Anti-Mage next to the enemy caster upon reflecting their unit-targeted spell while active.
notes: Break disables the passive magic resistance.

antimage_counterspell_ally.desc: Counterspell Ally may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around an allied hero that blocks and reflects any targeted spells. Any time a spell is blocked by Counterspell or Counterspell Ally, an illusion of Anti-Mage will be created next to the enemy.

antimage_mana_void.desc: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies.  The main target is also mini-stunned.
notes: Damage is calculated based on the primary target's mana, but applied to all enemies within the area of effect.

arc_warden_flux.desc: Infuses a lone enemy unit with swirling, volatile energy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target. The damage is not applied if another enemy unit is near the target.
arc_warden_flux.scepter: Flux silences when the target is alone, deals more damage, and lasts longer.

arc_warden_magnetic_field.desc: Arc Warden generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy. The Magnetic Field grants bonus attack speed and protects allied units within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field. The Magnetic Field pulls runes, and runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.

arc_warden_spark_wraith.desc: Summons a Spark Wraith that slowly materializes and patrols a targeted area until an enemy comes within its range. Once a target has been found the wraith fuses with them, dealing magical damage and slowing the unit.
notes: Spark Wraiths can not be disjointed.

arc_warden_tempest_double.desc:
Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.

The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.
arc_warden_tempest_double.shard:
The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.

Does not trigger Runic Infusion.
notes: Tempest Double and Refresher Orb cannot be used by the duplicate.

arc_warden_runic_infusion.desc: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.

axe_berserkers_call.desc: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
axe_berserkers_call.shard: Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.

axe_battle_hunger.desc: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.
axe_battle_hunger.shard: Multiple instances of Battle Hunger can stack on a single target.
notes: Destroying buildings will also remove the debuff.

axe_counter_helix.desc: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.
axe_counter_helix.scepter: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.
notes: Illusions' counters don't increase when they attack when you have a Scepter.

axe_culling_blade.desc:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.
notes: Culling Blade death cannot be prevented with other abilities like Shallow Grave.

axe_one_man_army.desc: Axe gains Strength based on %armor_pct_as_strength%%% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within %radius% distance from Axe.  The effect fades over %bonus_linger_duration%s after approaching an ally.

bane_enfeeble.desc: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.

bane_brain_sap.desc: Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.
bane_brain_sap.shard: Reduces cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%. Causes Brain Sap to become a %shard_radius% AoE spell. Secondary targets only heal for %shard_secondary_target_heal_pct%%%.

bane_fiends_grip.desc: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every %fiend_grip_tick_interval% seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.
bane_fiends_grip.scepter: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take %scepter_incoming_illusion_damage%%% incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.

bane_nightmare.desc:
Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.

Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.
notes: In the first second of Nightmare, the unit is invulnerable.
Bane can wake himself from Nightmare.
On cast, replaced with Nightmare End: Ends all ongoing Nightmares on any affected units.

bane_ichor_of_nyctasha.desc: Every time Bane kills an enemy hero or they die under the effect of Bane's debuff, they receive a Terror for the rest of the game that decreases their status resistance to Bane's subsequent debuffs.

batrider_sticky_napalm.desc: Drenches an area in sticky oil, amplifying damage from Batrider's attacks and abilities and slowing the movement speed and turn rate of enemies. Additional casts of Sticky Napalm continue to increase damage, up to %max_stacks% stacks. Applies a small amount of damage with each cast.
batrider_sticky_napalm.shard:
Sticky Napalm no longer has a stack limit.

Sticky Napalm deals damage to structures.
notes: All damage from Batrider gets amplified, except for Radiance, Orb of Venom, Urn of Shadows, and Spirit Vessel.
Sticky Napalm does not require turning to cast.
Sticky Napalm deals %creep_damage_pct%%% damage to creeps.

batrider_smoldering_resin.desc: Batrider's attacks apply a debuff that deals %tick_attack_damage_pct%%% of the attack damage every %tick_rate%s for %total_ticks%s.

batrider_flamebreak.desc: Hurls an explosive cocktail that explodes when it reaches the target location, knocking back, slowing and dealing damage over time to enemies in the area.

batrider_firefly.desc: Batrider takes to the skies, moving increasingly fast and laying down a trail of flames from the air. The fire damages any enemies it touches and destroys trees below Batrider. Maximum movement speed bonus is reached at the end of Firefly's duration.
notes: During this the Batrider can fly above units, trees and impassable terrain.
If duration ends when above impassable terrain, the Batrider can get stuck.
The trail persists through Batrider's death.

batrider_flaming_lasso.desc: Lassoes an enemy and drags them in Batrider's wake. Dragged units cannot move, attack, or use abilities.  Teleporting or blinking will break the lasso.
batrider_flaming_lasso.scepter: Flaming Lasso grabs both its target, as well as the target's nearest allied hero within %grab_radius_scepter% units. The secondary target is tethered to the first.
notes: Killing the target or the Batrider will break the lasso before its expiration.
If Batrider moves more than 425 units in 0.05 seconds the lasso breaks.
Batrider cannot attack while using Flaming Lasso.

beastmaster_wild_axes.desc: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path.  Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.
beastmaster_wild_axes.shard: Beastmaster's attacks on enemy heroes also apply the Wild Axes debuff of its corresponding level.
notes: This ability destroys trees.

beastmaster_summon_razorback.desc: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.

beastmaster_summon_thunderhide.desc: Beastmaster calls forth an Ancient Thunderhide to fight alongside him. The Thunderhide can Slam the ground to damage and slow nearby enemies, and beats its Thunderhide Drum as Beastmaster or Beastmaster's units attack, increasing their damage and max health.
notes: A newly summoned Thunderhide's Slam starts on a %thunderhide_slam_spawn_cooldown% second cooldown.

beastmaster_thunderhide_drum.desc: Attacks from the Ancient Thunderhide, its owner, or a nearby unit its owner controls cause it to beat its drum, building up to %max_stacks% stacks. Each stack increases the max health and base damage of Ancient Thunderhide, its owner, and their other nearby controlled units by %bonus_pct_per_stack%%%. If no attacks are made, stacks are gradually lost. When the Thunderhide dies, or a unit leaves its range, that unit's bonus fades at the same rate.

beastmaster_hawk_dive.desc: Flies towards the target enemy, dealing damage and rooting it.

beastmaster_summon_raptor.desc: Beastmaster summons %hawk_count% hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every %hawk_base_attack_interval%s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.
beastmaster_summon_raptor.shard: Increases Hawk duration by %bonus_duration%s and summons an additional Hawk.

beastmaster_boar_poison.desc: Inflicts a poison that slows attack and movement speeds.

beastmaster_greater_boar_poison.desc: Inflicts a poison that slows attack and movement speeds.

beastmaster_inner_beast.desc: Untaps the inner fury of Beastmaster and units he controls, passively increasing their attack speed.
notes: Break disables the passive attack speed bonus.

beastmaster_primal_roar.desc: Beastmaster lets loose a deafening roar that stuns, and shoves open a path to its target. All units in the path of the roar are damaged, while units shoved aside by the roar have their movement and attack speed slowed. Additionally, Beastmaster and his units gain %movement_speed%%% movement speed for %movement_speed_duration% seconds.

beastmaster_drums_of_slom.desc:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of %min_drum_hit_interval%s between hits after %max_stacks% attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.

Using Primal Roar counts as %primal_roar_stacks% attacks.

beastmaster_rugged.desc: Beastmaster's melee hero Damage Block Chance is increased from %damage_block_pct_fifty_tooltip%%% to %damage_block_pct_vs_creeps%%% versus non-hero units and non-building units.

special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_5.desc: The Movespeed Aura is global, persists through death, and affects Beastmaster and all his summons.

special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_6.desc: The Max Health Aura is global, persists through death, and affects Beastmaster and all his summons.

bloodseeker_bloodrage.desc: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.
bloodseeker_bloodrage.shard: Bloodseeker's Bloodrage attacks now deal %max_health_dmg_pct%%% of the target's max health as <font color="#d8ae53">Pure</font> damage.
notes: Damage dealt to Bloodseeker is non-lethal.

bloodseeker_blood_bath.desc: Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After %delay_plus_castpoint_tooltip% seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.
notes: Total time is a %delay% second delay plus a %abilitycastpoint% second cast time.

bloodseeker_thirst.desc: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below %min_bonus_pct%%%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below %invis_threshold_pct%%%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.
notes: Not triggered by Illusions.
Max movement speed bonus occurs when an enemy's health is at or below %max_bonus_pct%%%.
Effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds if a target dies.

bloodseeker_rupture.desc: Causes an enemy unit's skin to rupture, dealing initial damage based on its current health. If the unit moves, it takes damage based on the distance moved.
bloodseeker_rupture.scepter: Increases initial damage and grants %AbilityCharges% Rupture Charges. Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s.

bloodseeker_blood_mist.desc:
Bloodseeker sprays his blood continuously in the area around him, losing health to damage and slow his enemies. While active, Sanguivore's healing is increased. Cannot be turned off while on cooldown.

Additionally, passively turns all your overheal from your own abilities into an all damage barrier up to 50% of Bloodseeker's Max Health. Barrier amount decays by %barrier_decay_pct%%% per second.
notes: Damage dealt to Bloodseeker is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.

bloodseeker_sanguivore.desc:
Bloodseeker restores some life when he kills a unit, equal to %base_heal% health plus a percentage of the units max health.

Restores for half values if an ally kills a nearby enemy hero.
notes: Creeps lifesteal is reduced by %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%.

bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.desc: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed.  The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a %bounce_aoe% radius of each other.
bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss.scepter: Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.

bounty_hunter_jinada.desc: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.

bounty_hunter_wind_walk.desc: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell.  If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
notes: Will not break most channeling of spells upon activation.

bounty_hunter_wind_walk_ally.desc: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is %fade_time%s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.

bounty_hunter_track.desc: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.
notes: Bounty Hunter will get the bonus gold if the target dies while Track is active, regardless of how it died.
Track's effect is only visible to allies.
You can see the amount of gold the target is carrying by mousing over the debuff icon above the target's ability bar.
Bonus gold is reliable gold.

bounty_hunter_cutpurse.desc: Bounty Hunter steals %gold_steal% gold when targeting enemy heroes with his abilities or items.
notes: Reapplying Track does not steal gold with Cutpurse.

bounty_hunter_big_game_hunter.desc: Bounty Hunter receives %kill_assist_gold_bonus_percent%%% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.

brewmaster_thunder_clap.desc: Slams the ground, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed and attack rate of nearby enemy units.

brewmaster_cinder_brew.desc:
Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.

Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed. If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by %extra_duration%s and causing them to take damage over time.

brewmaster_drunken_brawler.desc:
Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.

Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by %brewed_up_bonus%%% for %brewed_up_duration%s. If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by %brewed_up_duration_extend%s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for %hangover_time%s.

Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.

Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.

Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.
notes: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

brewmaster_drunken_brawler_brew_up.desc: Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up and his stance becomes empowered.  If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended.  The cooldown starts when the effect ends.

brewmaster_liquid_courage.desc: After taking %damage_threshold% damage from player-controlled units, Brewmaster gains a Status Resistance buff for %trigger_duration%s and his movement speed alternates every %speed_toggle_time%s between being faster and being slower. Damage taken is reset if Brewmaster takes no damage for %damage_reset_interval%s. Can only trigger once every %trigger_cooldown%s.
brewmaster_liquid_courage.shard:
Liquid Courage can be activated to toss a strong drink to a teammate or yourself to gain the effects of Liquid Courage and %max_hp_regen%%% Max HP Regen per second. Increases speed increase.

Lasts %drink_duration% seconds.
notes: Damage from Roshan counts towards the damage threshold.

brewmaster_primal_split.desc: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn.  Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.
brewmaster_primal_split.scepter:
Primal Split gains %scepter_bonus_levels% max and current level, improving the Brewlings and their abilities.

Allows Primal Split to be cancelled early, and causes the Brewlings to be Brewed Up when Primal Split begins.
notes: The Earth Element will carry all auras that the Brewmaster has, as well as True Sight.
The Fire Element has phased movement.
When the spell ends, Brewmaster will take the place of an element in this order, assuming they are alive: Earth, Storm, Fire.

brewmaster_primal_companion.desc:
Creates a Brewling based on Brewmaster's current Drunken Brawler Stance.

A new Brewling cannot be resummoned for %cooldown_on_take_damage%s if the current one takes damage from enemy Heroes or hero-controlled units. If the Brewling dies, the ability goes on cooldown for %cooldown_on_death% seconds.

Only one Brewling can exist at a time. If Brewmaster uses Primal Split, the existing Brewling disappears.

brewmaster_earth_hurl_boulder.desc: Throws a boulder at a unit, doing damage and stunning it.

brewmaster_earth_spell_immunity.desc: Magic, status, and slow resistance increased.

brewmaster_storm_dispel_magic.desc:
Damages summoned units in an area and dispels most buffs or debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Can be cast on invulnerable units.

brewmaster_storm_cyclone.desc: Encloses a unit in a tornado, removing it from the battlefield and deals %landing_damage% damage when after they land.

brewmaster_storm_wind_walk.desc: Provides temporary invisibility.  Bonus movement speed and attack damage when invisible.

brewmaster_fire_phase.desc: Provides the Brewling with phased movement and bonus Status Resistance.

brewmaster_fire_pull.desc: Pulls the target and the Fire Brewling in the target direction. Enemies are damaged upon arrival.

bristleback_hairball.desc: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.

bristleback_viscous_nasal_goo.desc: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for %goo_duration% seconds.  Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.

bristleback_quill_spray.desc: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback.  Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last %quill_stack_duration% seconds.
notes: Quill Spray damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

bristleback_bristleback.desc: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
bristleback_bristleback.scepter: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after %activation_delay%s, forcefully ejects %activation_num_quill_sprays% sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every %activation_spray_interval%s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by %activation_movement_speed_pct%%%.
notes: Bristleback's rear is considered to be within 70 degrees from the back.
Bristleback's side is considered to be within 110 degrees from the back.
Damage done by Quill Sprays released by this ability passively is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

bristleback_prickly.desc: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.

bristleback_brawlers_grit.desc: Every time Bristleback is Stunned, Hexed, Feared, Taunted, or Rooted he gains a stacking buff for %duration%s that provides status resistance and debuff amplificiation, up to a maximum of %max_stacks% stacks.

bristleback_warpath.desc: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
notes: Bristleback's illusions will receive the bonuses.
Items will not trigger Warpath.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

broodmother_spawn_spiderlings.desc: Broodmother injects her young into an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing them for %slow_duration% seconds. The spiderlings will hatch if the target is killed while under this influence.
notes: If the target is killed within %buff_duration% seconds of being hit with this skill, the Spiderlings will spawn.
Units killed by Spiderlings will then give birth to additional Spiderlings.

broodmother_spawn_spiderite.desc: Applies debuff on attack. If debuffed unit dies, a spiderling will spawn.

broodmother_spin_web.desc:
Spins a large web that grants Broodmother a passive movement speed increase and increases her Turn Rate, while in its vicinity, as well as giving free movement.

Spin Web can be cast from anywhere as long as the new web touches an existing web. Webs never expire, and can be manually destroyed. When the maximum limit of webs is exceeded, the oldest web disappears.
notes: Also affects Spiderlings.

broodmother_spiders_milk.desc: Whenever Broodmother or a nearby unit under her control kills an enemy, Broodmother and her units close to the victim receive a buff for %kill_heal_duration%s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every %tick_rate% seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by %kill_creeps_penalty%%%.

broodmother_incapacitating_bite.desc: Broodmother's venom cripples enemy units, causing her attacks to slow and giving the affected unit a chance to miss its attacks and extra damage from attacks.
notes: The miss chance stacks with evasion and terrain dodge chance.

broodmother_insatiable_hunger.desc: A violent lust for vital fluids increases Broodmother's attack damage and gives her and her Spiderlings a vampiric attack.
broodmother_insatiable_hunger.shard: While Hunger is active, the bonus damage is increased by %shard_damage_per_tick%%% every %shard_damage_tick_interval%s.

broodmother_sticky_snare.desc: Broodmother may create up to %count% invisible web lines touching any existing web. Enemy Heroes that cross the web line will spring the trap, becoming rooted, revealed in fog, and take damage over time.  Multiple Heroes can trip on the same line until it's destroyed after being initially triggered.  Broodmother's team is alerted via the minimap when an enemy has triggered the snare.

centaur_hoof_stomp.desc: After a brief windup, Centaur Warrunner slams the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. During the delay, he is disarmed but can move.

centaur_double_edge.desc: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.
centaur_double_edge.shard: Causes Double Edge to slow enemy heroes and increase Centaur's strength per hero hit for a short time. Duration refreshes per stack, up to a max of %shard_max_stacks% stacks.
notes: Double Edge deals magic type damage to both the targets and himself.

centaur_return.desc: Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.
notes: Retaliate triggers when the attack hits.
Retaliate deals damage to towers.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

centaur_stampede.desc: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.

centaur_work_horse.desc: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.

centaur_horsepower.desc:
Centaur Warrunner gains %strength_to_movement_pct%%% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.

centaur_mount.desc: Centaur tosses an ally into a cart hitched behind him. While in the cart, the ally is invulnerable and can still cast and attack normally, but cannot move independently or be targeted by opponents. Increases the attack range of melee heroes by %melee_attack_range%.

chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.desc: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
chaos_knight_chaos_bolt.shard: Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals Chaos Knight's full damage and has %illusion_effectiveness%%% item potency.
notes: The stun duration and damage values dealt are inversely related.
Nearby illusions will mimic the cast animation.

chaos_knight_reality_rift.desc: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for %duration%s.
chaos_knight_reality_rift.shard: Allows Reality Rift to be cast on any enemy hero that is within 1200 range of you or one of your illusions. Gathers all of your illusions and your hero and teleports them to the target enemy.
notes: Chaos Knight and the target unit are made to face each other, and Chaos Knight and his phantasms are issued an attack order against the target.

chaos_knight_chaos_strike.desc: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal.

chaos_knight_phantasm.desc:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal %outgoing_damage_tooltip%%% damage, but take %incoming_damage_tooltip%%% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
chaos_knight_phantasm.scepter:
Gains a passive component. When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a %bonus_illusion_chance%%% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.

When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.
notes: Removes most negative buffs from Chaos Knight.
Chaos Knight is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing him to dodge stuns and damage.

chaos_knight_phantasmagoria.desc: All Chaos Knight Illusions are Strong Illusions and take less damage when near him.
notes: All illusions created by Chaos Knight or of Chaos Knight are Strong Illusions. Chaos Knight's Illusions within %aura_radius% radius have %damage_reduction_pct%%% damage reduction.
Also applies to Aghanim's Scepter Phantasm Illusions.
Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.
Break disables the passive Damage Reduction aura.

chaos_knight_reins_of_chaos.desc: Whenever illusions of Chaos Knight are created, there is a %bonus_illusion_chance%%% chance that an additional %bonus_illusion_count% extra illusion will spawn.

chaos_knight_fundamental_forging.desc: Chaos Knight's Neutral Items get an additional random enchantment.
notes: The random enchantment can be any available enchantment in that tier except for enchantments with negative effects, including enchantments that are normally not available for Strength heroes.
The random enchantment cannot be the same as the chosen enchantment.

chaos_knight_armageddon.desc:
For each second Chaos Knight keeps moving without stopping or attacking, Armageddon gains bonus movement speed. The bonus drains away while stopping, and lost when attacking.

While at least one of Chaos Knight's phantasms is alive, Ahead, Armageddon can be activated to charge over terrain, building up to a max speed before releasing. Chaos Knight and the illusions will attack units they charge over.
notes: Being stunned, hexed, feared, taunted or rooted during the windup cancels the charge.
Ahead, Armageddon is only available when at least 1 of Chaos Knight's illusions created with the active cast of Phantasm is alive.
Activation of Ahead, Armageddon will gather all of Chaos Knight's illusions in %illusion_radius% radius regardless of how they were created.

chaos_knight_armageddons_flank.desc:
Chaos Knight cracks the reins, causing Armageddon to sprint forward with increasing speed but decreased ability to turn and stop, and turning causes him to slow down. Chaos Knight can use any of his abilities and attack enemies while moving.

Armageddon's Flank cannot be used for %damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.

Can be stopped with the sub-ability.

chen_penitence.desc: Damages enemy unit, forces it to move slower and lets allies attack it more quickly.

chen_divine_favor.desc:
Passively provides an aura that grants increased health regeneration. Can be cast on allies to provide them with bonus armor and increasing the healing and health regeneration they receive.

If cast on Chen, all units controlled by Chen receive the buff.

chen_holy_persuasion.desc:
Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Chen may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last %unsummon_time% seconds to unsummon it.

Casting Holy Persuasion on Chen teleports all creeps under his control to him after a delay. Taking damage from enemy heroes or their units cancels the teleport.
chen_holy_persuasion.shard: Allows Holy Persuasion to target Ancient creeps. Can control up to 1/2/3 Ancient creeps based on Hand of God's level. Additionally levels up some abilities of creeps by 1 level.
notes: Persuading a new creep above max unit count causes the oldest persuaded creep to die.
Can target Ancient creeps when Chen has Aghanim's Shard.
Fully restores the creep's mana upon converting.

chen_martyrdom.desc: Sacrifice the life of this unit to damage an enemy for %base_value% + %current_hp_pct%%% of this unit's current health.  Allies may also be targeted for a heal with %heal_factor%%% of the damage value.

chen_anoint.desc: Make this creep Chen's Anointed Zealot. After dying it can be respawned next to Chen by activating Zealot, and the previous Anointed becomes a regular controlled creep.

chen_hand_of_god.desc: Heals all allied heroes on the map as well as all units under Chen's control. A large heal is applied at first and a slow heal over time is applied for %hot_duration% seconds afterwards.
chen_hand_of_god.scepter: Decreases the cooldown of Hand of God to %AbilityCooldown%s and it becomes a channelled spell that lasts for up to %AbilityChannelTime% seconds. The initial heal happens at the start of the channel, and while channeling other nearby allied units become debuff immune with %debuff_immune_resist%%% magic resistance and the power of the heal over time is increased by %nearby_hot_boost%%%.
notes: Can heal invulnerable and hidden/banished allies.

chen_zealot.desc:
Passively provides bonus health, damage and move speed to non-hero units under Chen's control.

Chen may Anoint a unit under his control converting it into an Anointed Zealot, giving it bonus base damage and the Martyrdom ability. Anointed Zealots can no longer be killed by abilities that instantly kill creeps otherwise. Activating this ability will respawn his current Anointed Zealot. He begins the game with a melee lane creep as an Anointed Zealot.
notes: Only 1 Zealot may exist at a time.

clinkz_strafe.desc:
Clinkz gains attack speed and has bonus attack range. Any current Skeleton Archers within a %strafe_skeleton_radius% radius of Clinkz also gain bonus attack range and %archer_attack_speed_pct%%% of the attack speed bonus.

Casting Strafe does not break Skeleton Walk invisibility.

clinkz_burning_barrage.desc: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.
notes: Bonus Attack Range increases the length of Burning Barrage.

clinkz_searing_arrows.desc:
Imbues Clinkz's arrows with fire for extra damage.

Skeleton Archers will fire Searing Arrows at targets Clinkz attacks for %skeleton_damage_pct%%% damage.
notes: Searing Arrows deal damage to structures.
The damage is directly added to Clinkz' attack damage, as physical damage.

clinkz_wind_walk.desc:
Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items. Leaving Skeleton Walk creates Skeleton Archers.

Skeleton Archers are immobile and have %skeleton_health_tooltip% pip health. Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to them. Skeleton Archers deal a percentage of Clinkz' damage, and deal %skeleton_building_damage_reduction%%% less damage to buildings. Attack range is equal to Clinkz' attack range.
notes: Has a fadetime of %fade_time% seconds.

clinkz_burning_army.desc: Summons a row of Burning Skeleton Archers in the target location.

clinkz_death_pact.desc: Clinkz consumes the target enemy creep or friendly Skeleton Archer, healing and gaining max health. Does not take Clinkz out of Skeleton Walk.
notes: If the target is an enemy, Clinkz will gain the correct experience and gold.
Increases Clinkz' current and max HP. Does not stack.
When the duration ends, max HP returns to normal, but current HP stays the same.

clinkz_bone_and_arrow.desc: Clinkz summons a Skeleton Archer when he dies.

clinkz_tar_bomb.desc:
Clinkz throws a projectile filled with tar at the target enemy, dealing Magic damage on impact. After impact, the tar spills onto the ground and stays there for %ground_duration% seconds. Any enemy that walks across it gets slowed, and attacks from Clinkz or his Skeleton Archers will deal bonus physical damage.

When the Tar Bomb hits, any Skeleton Archers within attack range will attack the target. If autocast is activated, Clinkz will throw a tar bomb when attacking the target, if it is available.

clinkz_infernal_shred.desc:
Clinkz and his skeletons apply a stacking debuff that causes their attacks to pierce up to %max_armor_piercing_pct%%% of the target's total physical armor (does not reduce their armor). Clinkz applies %hero_stacks%%% per attack, and skeletons apply %skeleton_stacks%%%.

Lasts %duration% seconds.
notes: Break disables the applying of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

crystal_maiden_crystal_nova.desc: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.
notes: Crystal Nova provides vision in the targeted area for the duration.

crystal_maiden_frostbite.desc: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals %creep_multiplier%x damage to non-ancient creeps.
notes: Frostbite is considered a root.

crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura.desc:
Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a %proximity_bonus_radius% radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.

Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.

crystal_maiden_freezing_field.desc: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with %num_explosions% random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts %abilitychanneltime% seconds.
crystal_maiden_freezing_field.scepter: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move %shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by %shard_bonus_explosion%%%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over %frostbite_delay%s.
notes: The slow is applied on all enemies in the radius, even if they aren't hit by an explosion (lasts %slow_duration% second).
Explosions occur every %explosion_interval_tooltip% seconds.

crystal_maiden_crystal_clone.desc: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a %frostbite_radius% AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.

crystal_maiden_glacial_guard.desc: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.

dark_seer_normal_punch.desc: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past %recent_duration% seconds. Max power is reached after %max_distance% distance moved.

dark_seer_vacuum.desc: Dark Seer creates a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage.
notes: This ability interrupts channeling.
Pulls units over %duration% seconds before dealing damage.
Trees near the center of the vacuum will be destroyed.

dark_seer_ion_shell.desc: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it.
notes: Deals small amounts of damage in %tick_interval% second intervals.
Doesn't damage the target it is cast on.
If cast on a unit that already has Ion Shell, the new Shell replaces the old one.

dark_seer_surge.desc: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.
dark_seer_surge.shard: Surged units leave behind a %trail_radius% radius trail that lasts %trail_duration%s, slows enemies around it by %trail_move_slow%%% and deals %trail_damage% damage per second in %trail_damage_interval%s intervals. Can be put on alt-cast to disable the trail.
notes: Units with Surge cannot be slowed unless the Surge effect is removed.

dark_seer_wall_of_replica.desc: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.
notes: Doesn't create illusions from other illusions.
There cannot be more than one illusion per player per wall.

dark_seer_quick_wit.desc: Dark Seer gains %int_to_atkspd% Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

dark_seer_heart_of_battle.desc: Dark Seer moves faster when near other heroes.
notes: Dark Seer gains %movement_speed_pct%%% of the movement speed of heroes within %radius% radius. Base movement speed reduced.

dark_seer_mental_fortitude.desc: Dark Seer's Intelligence cannot be lower than the average of his Strength and Agility.
notes: If the average between his Strength and Agility is higher, he gains Bonus Intelligence to match them.

dark_seer_aggrandize.desc:
Dark Seer gains %int_to_atkspd% Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.

dark_willow_bramble_maze.desc: Dark Willow creates a %placement_range% AoE maze of %placement_count% brambles that grow in the target area after %initial_creation_delay% seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts %placement_duration% seconds.
notes: Does not interrupt channeling spells upon rooting.

dark_willow_bedlam.desc: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies.  Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.

dark_willow_terrorize.desc: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.
notes: Terrorize provides vision on affected units.

dark_willow_shadow_realm.desc: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.  Her next attack has %attack_range_bonus% bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after %max_damage_duration% seconds.
dark_willow_shadow_realm.scepter: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.
notes: Disjoints projectiles upon cast.
Grants phased movement.
Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.

dark_willow_cursed_crown.desc: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.
dark_willow_cursed_crown.shard: Cursed Crown creates %shard_bramble_amount% brambles in a %shard_spawn_radius% radius around the target after the counter ends. Triggers even upon dispel. Cursed Crown cooldown reduced by 1.5 seconds.

dark_willow_pixie_dust.desc: Dark Willow gains %hp_regen_amp%%% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to %hp_regen_amp_out_of_world%%% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.

dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.desc: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
dawnbreaker_fire_wreath.shard: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by %shard_movement_penalty%%% down to a minimum of %movement_speed%.
notes: Dawnbreaker travels at a rate of %movement_speed% for the duration of the ability and takes a brief %self_stun_duration%s to recover after the final strike.
Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be cast during the combo.
Cleave does not work with this ability.
Can be self-cast to move forward.
The first two strikes will slow enemy movement speed by %swipe_slow%%% for %sweep_stun_duration%s.

dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer.desc: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for %pause_duration% seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
notes: The hammer damages enemies both when thrown and when returning to Dawnbreaker.
Dawnbreaker's Converge movement distance is capped at the ability's cast range.
Starbreaker cannot be cast while the Hammer is out.

dawnbreaker_converge.desc: Dawnbreaker recalls her hammer, pulling them together so they meet in the middle.

dawnbreaker_luminosity.desc: After a number of attacks, Dawnbreaker powers up, charging her next attack with a critical hit that heals all allied heroes within %heal_radius% units around her for a portion of attack damage dealt. Creeps and neutral enemies provide less healing. Allies are healed for %allied_healing_pct%%% of the amount.
dawnbreaker_luminosity.scepter: Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.
notes: Luminosity Heal is increased by sources of Health Restoration Amplification.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.

dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.desc:
CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within %max_offset_distance% units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for %daytime_duration%s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.

After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.

Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
dawnbreaker_solar_guardian.scepter: Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for %scepter_aura_duration%s after landing.
notes: Pulse interval is %pulse_interval%s.
Total flight duration is %abilitychanneltime% seconds of channel time + %airtime_duration% of flight time.
Instantly recalls the Hammer on cast.

dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn.desc: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.
dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn.scepter: Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.

special_bonus_unique_dawnbreaker_gleamin.desc: {s:bonus_hammer_solar_guardian_radius} AoE. Hammer stationary duration increased by {s:bonus_pause_duration}. Damaging and Healing is {s:bonus_hammer_solar_guardian_effectiveness_pct}% of Solar Guardian's.

dazzle_poison_touch.desc: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
notes: The damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

dazzle_shallow_grave.desc: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
notes: HP cannot go below 1 while under the effects of Shallow Grave, but Axe's Culling Blade will still kill the hero.

dazzle_shadow_wave.desc: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby.  Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
dazzle_shadow_wave.scepter: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to %scepter_heal_pct%%% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.
notes: Prioritizes allied heroes over creeps.
If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.

dazzle_nothl_projection.desc:
Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has reduced cooldown.

The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
dazzle_nothl_projection.shard: Increases Nothl Projection's cast range by %shard_cast_range_bonus% and leash range by %shard_leash_range_bonus%.
notes: When Dazzle's spirit is further than %leash_start% units from the body, the tether will begin to pull him back. The strength of the pull increases with distance.
Dazzle's Soul cannot attack buildings.

dazzle_nothl_projection_end.desc: Ends Dazzle's sojourn in the Nothl Realm and returns his spirit to his body.

dazzle_through_the_realm.desc:
Only active during Nothl Projection. Dazzle pulls his body through the Nothl Realm to his spirit. Nothl Projection ends upon return.

Cannot be cast if Dazzle's body is rooted or leashed.

dazzle_innate_weave.desc: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.
dazzle_innate_weave.shard: Applying a stack of Weave heals an ally for %ally_heal% per stack of Weave.
notes: Break disables the applying of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

dazzle_nothl_boon.desc: Dazzle's overhealing is converted into a barrier. Weave is stronger on allies and amplifies incoming heals from Dazzle.
notes: Whenever Dazzle overheals himself or an ally, it grants that hero a physical damage barrier equal to the amount overhealed for %duration% seconds. If the overhealed target already has a larger barrier its duration will be refreshed instead.

special_bonus_unique_dazzle_poison_touch.desc: +{s:bonus_attack_range_bonus} Attack Range when attacking an enemy affected by Poison Touch

death_prophet_carrion_swarm.desc: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
death_prophet_carrion_swarm.shard: Crypt Swarm has %AbilityCharges% charges with a %AbilityCooldown%s cooldown between uses. Crypt Swarm slows enemies by %slow_movement_pct%%% for %slow_duration%s.
notes: Can hit units up to 1110 range away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

death_prophet_silence.desc: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.
notes: Doesn't prevent usage of items.

death_prophet_witchcraft.desc:
Whenever Death Prophet attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy and return to her with life. The spirit has a percentage of Death Prophet's attack damage and heals for %heal_percent%%% of the damage.

Death Prophet's occult knowledge deepens with experience, gaining movement speed and Witchcraft spirit damage.
notes: Spirits do %building_damage_pct%%% damage to buildings.

death_prophet_spirit_siphon.desc: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, continuously dealing damage to the enemy and healing herself.
death_prophet_spirit_siphon.scepter: Spirit Siphon steals %attack_slow% attack speed from each afflicted enemy hero. Spirit Siphon drains an additional %max_health_damage_pct%%% of the target's maximum health per second.
notes: Cannot cast multiple on same target.
Death Prophet's Heal amount is not affected if the damage is mitigated or amplified.

death_prophet_exorcism.desc: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
notes: Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.

death_prophet_spirit_collector.desc: Hero deaths empower your next Exorcism.
notes:
Whenever a hero dies, Death Prophet traps their spirit for later use. When she casts Exorcism, each trapped hero spirit will replace a standard spirit. Hero spirits deal more damage than standard spirits.

When a hero is killed while Exorcism is active a standard spirit will be replaced with a hero spirit if possible and stored for the next cast of Exorcism.
Includes Death Prophet's own death.

death_prophet_mourning_ritual.desc: Death Prophet delays a percentage of incoming damage, taking the damage in even intervals over a short duration.
notes: Delayed damage matches the damage type of the initial damage and bypasses armor, magic resistance, and damage block.

disruptor_thunder_strike.desc: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning.  Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by %slow_amount%%% for %slow_duration% seconds.  Provides vision of its target.
disruptor_thunder_strike.shard: Increases the cast range and strike count of Thunder Strike. It can now also be ground targeted, where it will lie dormant for up to %shard_ground_delay% seconds and attach to the first enemy that comes within the radius.

disruptor_glimpse.desc: Teleports the target hero back to where it was %backtrack_time% seconds ago.  Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.
notes: The travel time is a function of the distance the target will travel.

disruptor_kinetic_field.desc: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.
disruptor_kinetic_field.shard: Causes enemies that touch the field to be struck by Electromagnetic Repulsion with %strike_knockback_pct_tooltip_only%%% reduced knockback.
notes: Debuff Immune units can travel through the field.
