disruptor_kinetic_fence.desc: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.  Enemies touching the wall are struck by Electromagnetic Repulsion with %strike_knockback_pct_tooltip_only%%% reduced knockback.

disruptor_static_storm.desc: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration.  The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.

disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion.desc: Whenever Disruptor takes more than %damage_threshold% damage from any source within %effect_radius% radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to %damage_per_int%x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a %effect_radius% distance away.
notes: After %damage_reset_interval%s, the damage counter is reset.

special_bonus_unique_disruptor_consecuti.desc: Every strike increases the damage of subsequent strikes until the debuff expires

doom_bringer_devour.desc: Consumes an enemy or neutral creep, acquiring any special abilities that it possessed. If alt-cast is activated, Doom will not acquire the creep's abilities. Duration is equal to the cooldown.
doom_bringer_devour.shard: Devour has %AbilityCharges% charges and can target Ancients. Stolen creep abilities have %bonus_aoe_pct%%% increased AoE and %bonus_spell_amp_pct%%% increased spell amplification.
notes: Gives Doom the original bounty of the creep, along with the bonus gold.
If you devour a creep without abilities, you'll keep the abilities you had previously.

doom_bringer_lvl_pain.desc: Doom's attacks curse enemy heroes. After %damage_debuff_duration%s, the cursed hero bursts with a pillar of fire, damaging itself and all units in a %spread_radius% AoE for %bonus_damage_pct_base%%% of the damage taken from Doom during the curse. The damage and radius of the curse is %bonus_at_level_pct%%% stronger if the enemy's level is a multiple of %level_multiplier%.
notes: Also applies to all attacks when Doom is at max level.

doom_bringer_scorched_earth.desc: Carpets the nearby earth in flames which damage enemies, while also granting Doom increased movement speed and health regeneration.
notes: Scorched Earth follows Doom, centered on his location.

doom_bringer_infernal_blade.desc: Doom swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for %ministun_duration% seconds and applies a %burn_duration% second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.
notes: Interrupts channeling abilities.

doom_bringer_doom.desc:
Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
doom_bringer_doom.scepter: Doom applies Break to enemies. Allies in a %scepter_aura_radius% radius around the doomed target also suffer the effects of Doom. Allows Doom to be self-cast to affect enemies around himself with Doom.

doom_bringer_empty1.desc: This slot will be replaced with abilities acquired using Devour.

doom_bringer_empty2.desc: This slot will be replaced with abilities acquired using Devour.

dragon_knight_fireball.desc: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.

dragon_knight_breathe_fire.desc: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.
notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

dragon_knight_dragon_tail.desc: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.

dragon_knight_dragon_blood.desc:
The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor.

Regen and armor are increased by %regen_and_armor_multiplier_during_dragon_form%%% during Elder Dragon Form.

dragon_knight_wyrms_wrath.desc: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.

dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.desc:
Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties. The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative.

Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.

Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.

Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.
dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form.scepter: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.

drow_ranger_frost_arrows.desc: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage.  Slow lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
drow_ranger_frost_arrows.scepter: Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.
notes: The slow duration is refreshed on successive casts.

drow_ranger_multishot.desc:
CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + %arrow_range_base%. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds.

Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.
notes: Arrow base damage pierces magic immunity.
Frost Arrows' damage and slow do not pierce magic immunity.

drow_ranger_wave_of_silence.desc: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.

drow_ranger_trueshot.desc: Grants Drow bonus agility based on Drow's current agility and level. Nearby ranged heroes received %trueshot_agi_bonus_allies_pct%%% of the bonus agility.

drow_ranger_marksmanship.desc: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within %disable_range% range.
notes: Marksmanship procs have true strike.

drow_ranger_glacier.desc:
Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.

earth_spirit_boulder_smash.desc: Earth Spirit smashes the target enemy or ally, sending them in the direction he is facing. If Earth Spirit targets an area, he will smash the nearest unit in a %remnant_smash_radius_tooltip% radius, prioritizing Stone Remnants. The travelling unit or Remnant damages all enemy units it hits.  If an enemy is hit by a Stone Remnant, they are also slowed. Stone Remnants travel further than other units.

earth_spirit_rolling_boulder.desc: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a %delay%s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing %damage% + %damage_str%%% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.
notes: Rolling over a Stone Remnant will destroy the Remnant.
The boulder has a radius of %radius%.
Earth Spirit is untargetable and invulnerable while rolling.

earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip.desc:
Earth Spirit pulls the target Stone Remnant or Allied Unit. Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.

Pulled Remnants also deal damage to struck enemies.

Cast range is reduced when targeting an ally.
earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip.shard: Decreases cooldown to %AbilityCooldown%s and increases allied unit cast range and pull speed.
notes: Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Geomagnetic Grip can also target allied creeps.

earth_spirit_stone_caller.desc:
Call a Stone Remnant to the target location. Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities. Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has %AbilityCharges% charges.

Earth Spirit passively gains %attack_damage_per_stone%%% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional %attack_damage_per_stone_used%%% bonus damage for %buff_duration%s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).
notes: Break disables the bonus damage.

earth_spirit_petrify.desc:
Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies. < br>
Can be cast on Stone Remnants. Has a 5 second cooldown when used that way.
Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.
notes: Earth Spirit himself can be targeted by Boulder Smash if he is enchanted.

earth_spirit_magnetize.desc: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. Magnetized heroes cause nearby Stone Remnants to explode, destroying the remnant and refreshing Magnetize's duration on all nearby enemies. This process can repeat multiple times. If an enemy hero is affected by Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash, all magnetized heroes share the effects.

special_bonus_unique_earth_spirit_2.desc: Applies Magnetize at its current duration to enemy Heroes around Earth Spirit, and can be refreshed with Stone Remnants.

earthshaker_fissure.desc: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
earthshaker_fissure.shard: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.
notes: Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.

earthshaker_enchant_totem.desc: Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have %bonus_attack_range% bonus attack range on the next attack.
earthshaker_enchant_totem.scepter: Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there.  Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.
notes: Bonus damage is based on base damage and that given by primary attribute.

earthshaker_aftershock.desc: Causes the earth to shake underfoot, adding additional damage and stuns to nearby enemy units when Earthshaker casts his abilities.
notes: Using items does not trigger Aftershock.

earthshaker_echo_slam.desc: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units.  Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.

earthshaker_spirit_cairn.desc: When Earthshaker dies, a %fissure_radius% radius fissure is created where he died. This fissure blocks movement and allows Earthshaker to continue to gain experience around it. It remains until Earthshaker respawns.

earthshaker_slugger.desc: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.

elder_titan_echo_stomp.desc: CHANNELED - Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.  The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.
elder_titan_echo_stomp.shard: Lowers Cooldown. Echo Stomp may be placed on alt-cast to allow Elder Titan to take the place of the Astral Spirit as it completes its stomp.
notes: If a unit is hit by Astral Spirit and Elder Titan, they will take both instances of damage.

elder_titan_echo_stomp_spirit.desc: Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.  The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.  Unconscious enemies will wake if they take damage.

elder_titan_ancestral_spirit.desc:
Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through.  When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.

The Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.
elder_titan_ancestral_spirit.scepter: Causes Elder Titan to become debuff immune and gain %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance for %scepter_magic_immune_per_hero% seconds per affected enemy Hero when the spirit returns.

elder_titan_return_spirit.desc: Returns the Astral Spirit to Elder Titan.

elder_titan_move_spirit.desc: Moves the Astral Spirit to target location.

elder_titan_natural_order.desc: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.
elder_titan_natural_order.shard: Every %tick_rate%s that enemy heroes stay under the effect of Natural Order, their armor is reduced by %armor_per_tick%, and magic resistance is reduced by %magic_resistance_per_tick%%%. Stacks up to %max_stacks% times.
notes: When the Astral Spirit isn't present, both the armor and magic armor reduction is centered around Elder Titan.

elder_titan_natural_order_spirit.desc: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.
notes: When the Astral Spirit isn't present, both the armor and magic armor reduction is centered around Elder Titan.
Break disables the armor reduction aura.

elder_titan_earth_splitter.desc: Sends forth a jagged crack in front of Elder Titan. After 3 seconds, the crack implodes, slowing movement while dealing damage to each enemy based on their maximum life. Half of the damage dealt is Magical damage, while the other half is Physical damage.

elder_titan_momentum.desc: Elder Titan gains armor equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed.
notes: Bonus movement speed is any movement speed above his base movement speed.
Momentum does not reduce Elder Titan's Armor if he is slowed below his base movement speed.

elder_titan_tip_the_scales.desc: Allied creeps and buildings affected by Glyph of Fortification or Roshan's Banner deal %damage_bonus%%% bonus damage.

ember_spirit_searing_chains.desc: Ember Spirit unleashes fiery bolas that wrap around nearby enemies, anchoring them in place and dealing damage each second.
notes: Targets are chosen randomly around Xin.
Does not affect Debuff Immune or invisible units.

ember_spirit_sleight_of_fist.desc: Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location.  Deals bonus damage to heroes.
notes: Targets are determined when the spell is cast.
A regular attack is done to each target every %attack_interval% seconds.
Any attack modifier that Xin has (such as Critical Strike, Bash, Cleave, or Orb effects) will be applied normally on these attacks.
Abilities and items can be used while Sleight of Fist is active.

ember_spirit_flame_guard.desc: Ember Spirit surrounds himself with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, absorbing a percentage of the damage taken. Flame Guard deals damage per second in an area around Ember Spirit while Flame Guard is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.
notes: Magic damage reduction is calculated before any reductions.
The damage lingers for an additional %linger_duration% seconds after application.

ember_spirit_immolation.desc: Ember Spirit is continuously burning, dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies at all times.
ember_spirit_immolation.shard: Grants Fire Remnants the current level of Immolation, and increases the damage per second and radius.
notes: Break does not disable Immolation for Fire Remnants when upgraded with Aghanim's Shard.

ember_spirit_fire_remnant.desc: Sends a Fire Remnant that runs to the target location at %speed_multiplier%%% Ember Spirit's speed. Using Activate Fire Remnant, Ember Spirit will dash out to all active Fire Remnants, destroying them and dealing damage in an area and then moving to the nearest Remnant.  Ember Spirit will end at the Remnant closest to the targeted location.
ember_spirit_fire_remnant.scepter: Increases cast range, initial remnant speed, and maximum charges.
ember_spirit_fire_remnant.shard: If an enemy hero dies near Ember Spirit, a Fire Remnant charge will be replenished. Additionally, when Ember Spirit dies a Fire Remnant is spawned at his location.
notes: Starts with 3 charges (maximum).

ember_spirit_activate_fire_remnant.desc: Select the Fire Remnant to arrive at.

enchantress_untouchable.desc: Enchantress beguiles her enemies, slowing their attacks when she is attacked.
notes: All units who directly attack Enchantress will get slowed.
The slow is applied on the attacking unit when the attack starts, not when damage is applied.

enchantress_bunny_hop.desc: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the %attack_targets% furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + %bonus_attack_range%.

enchantress_little_friends.desc: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for %duration% seconds.

enchantress_enchant.desc:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for %slow_duration%s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives %xp_gain_pct%%% of their experience bounty.  Enchantress can control creeps for up to %dominate_duration%s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
enchantress_enchant.scepter: Enchantress can control multiple creeps at a time.
notes: Illusions can be converted.

enchantress_natures_attendants.desc: A cloud of wisps heals Enchantress and any friendly units nearby.
notes: Units with full HP will not be selected for the heal.

enchantress_impetus.desc: Places an enchantment on each attack while activated, causing it to deal additional damage based on how far away the target is.  The farther the target, the greater the damage dealt. Deals double damage to illusions.
notes: The damage is capped at %distance_cap% distance.
Distance to target is measured when the projectile hits.

enchantress_rabblerouser.desc: Enchantress causes neutral creeps or any unit under her control to deal additional damage to enemy Heroes.
notes: Does not affect converted neutrals, Tormentor, or Roshan.

enigma_malefice.desc: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances.  An instance strikes every %tick_rate% seconds.
enigma_malefice.shard: Increases Malefice stun duration by %shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%s and creates an Eidolon next to enemy Hero targets every instance of Malefice stun. These Eidolons will not multiply further.

enigma_demonic_conversion.desc: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health.  The eidolons health is increased by %current_health_pct%%% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply.  When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.

enigma_midnight_pulse.desc: Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing %base_damage% + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.
notes: This ability destroys trees in its area.
Multiple instances of Midnight Pulse do not stack.

enigma_black_hole.desc: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units.  Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.
enigma_black_hole.scepter: Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to %scepter_pct_damage%%% of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a %scepter_radius% AoE. Pulls at a rate of %scepter_drag_speed%.

enigma_gravity_well.desc: Allies within %max_dist% distance from Enigma have up to %damage_reduction%%% Damage Reduction. Effect starts at 0% at max distance and increases to its maximum strength when the ally is at %min_dist% distance. Does not affect Enigma itself.

enigma_splitting_image.desc: Enigma spawns Eidolons upon receiving damage.
notes: Whenever Enigma takes more than %damage_threshold% damage from any source, he spawns an Eidolon next to him. Damage counter resets to zero after %damage_reset_interval%s. Eidolons created in this fashion grant %non_splitting_bounty_reduction_tooltip%%% experience and gold.

enigma_event_horizon.desc: Units in a %radius% radius moving away from Enigma have a movespeed penalty.

faceless_void_time_walk.desc: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last %backtrack_duration% seconds.
faceless_void_time_walk.scepter: Applies a Time Lock to all units at the landing destination.
notes: Faceless Void is invulnerable while using Time Walk.

faceless_void_distortion_field.desc: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a %friendly_hero_distance% radius of him get slowed by %attack_projectile_slow%%%, when they get  within %slow_distance_max% distance of their target.

faceless_void_time_walk_reverse.desc: Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.

faceless_void_time_lock.desc: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time.
notes: Does not stack with Skull Basher.

faceless_void_time_dilation.desc: Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.
faceless_void_time_dilation.shard: Increases slow per stack. Provides Faceless Void with stacks that increase his attack and movement speed. Amount of stacks is equal to the total amount of Time Dilation stacks applied to enemies at the moment of the cast and linearly fades out over the duration.
notes: Does not affect item cooldowns.
Number of stacks can change during the effect. Casting an ability will provide a stack if it goes on cooldown. If an ability cooldown ends during Time Dilation, a stack will be removed.

faceless_void_chronosphere.desc: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed.
notes: Pauses all units and buildings, friendly or enemy, except those owned by Faceless Void.
Faceless Void is never affected by Chronospheres with any owner.

faceless_void_time_zone.desc: Creates a blister in spacetime, altering the movement, cast, projectile, cooldown, and turn rate speed of all units inside. Allies have increased speed and cooldown acceleration. Enemies have decreased speed, and have frozen ability and item cooldowns. Does not affect Ultimate abilities. Time Dilation does not tick down while inside.

special_bonus_unique_faceless_void_4.desc: Grants a {s:dodge_chance_pct}% chance to avoid damage entirely. Disabled by break.

furion_sprout.desc: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, damaging and trapping it in place and providing vision in a %vision_range% radius.
notes: Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.

furion_teleportation.desc: Teleports to any point on the map.
notes: Mana and cooldown take effect when the cast is completed.  Nature's Prophet will not use any mana or waste the cooldown if the spell is interrupted while casting.
When the cast begins, an effect is created at the target location, which is visible to allies and enemies.

furion_force_of_nature.desc: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.
notes: Nature's Call can only create as many treants as there are trees in the target area.

furion_wrath_of_nature.desc: Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies that are in vision starting with those closest to the cast point. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage, up to the maximum after %max_targets% are hit.
furion_wrath_of_nature.scepter: Entangles all enemies it hits. Duration scales from %scepter_min_entangle_duration%s up to %scepter_max_entangle_duration%s seconds at max bounce.
notes: Wrath of Nature will not hit units out of vision.
Can be cast through the minimap; the nearest valid target will be selected.

furion_curse_of_the_forest.desc: Nature's Prophet and his treants curse enemies they attack, slowing them and dealing damage per second. Curses from different attackers stack. Each attacker's curse has an independent duration that can be refreshed by further attacks from the same unit that applied it.

furion_spirit_of_the_forest.desc: Nature's Prophet's attacks gain %damage_per_tree_pct%%% bonus base damage for each tree near the target, including Sprout trees. Treants near the target also provide this bonus with multiplied values. Treants also possess this ability.
notes: Treants gain bonuses from trees and other treants around their target.
Treant Protector does not provide any bonuses.

furion_natures_profit.desc: Whenever Nature's Prophet kills an enemy hero or one dies within a %radius% radius, a money tree is created in their place. Every tick, several bags of gold are dropped that can be picked up by nearby heroes. The amount of gold is equal to a multiplier of the slain hero level.

special_bonus_unique_furion_force_of_nat.desc: Also increases Nature's Call radius by {s:bonus_area_of_effect}.

grimstroke_dark_artistry.desc:
Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits.

Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.

grimstroke_ink_creature.desc:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to the phantom.
notes: The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
The phantom will return if the target dies during the latch.

grimstroke_dark_portrait.desc: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.

grimstroke_spirit_walk.desc: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After %buff_duration% seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.
grimstroke_spirit_walk.shard:
Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal %shard_bonus_damage_pct%%% more damage and heal the target for %shard_heal_pct%%% of the damage Ink Swell deals.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

grimstroke_soul_chain.desc: Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.
notes: If bound to another unit, affected units are leashed and prevented from blinking.
Provides vision of both leashed units.

grimstroke_ink_trail.desc: Grimstroke's attacks and spells cause affected enemy heroes to leave a trail of Ink behind them and deal less damage to Grimstroke for %debuff_duration%s.
notes: Provides vision over affected heroes.
Grimstroke's illusions (including Dark Portrait) also have Ink Trail.

gyrocopter_rocket_barrage.desc: Launches a salvo of rockets at nearby enemy units in a radius around the Gyrocopter. Lasts %barrage_duration% seconds.
notes: Rocket Barrage can't hit units Gyrocopter has no vision over.
Rocket Barrage fired from Homing Missiles do not trigger Afterburner.

gyrocopter_homing_missile.desc: Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit. The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target. Enemy units can destroy the missile before it reaches its target.
gyrocopter_homing_missile.shard: Homing Missiles now constantly fires the current level of Rocket Barrage in a %shard_radius% area of effect after %shard_delay% second of being cast. This Rocket Barrage prioritizes the Homing Missile target.
notes: Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to the missile.
The crosshair effect is visible to allies only.
The missile will follow and hit invisible units.

gyrocopter_flak_cannon.desc: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks.  The additional attacks can proc attack modifiers at reduced effectiveness, except for Lifesteal and Critical Strike.  Lasts %abilityduration% seconds or until the attacks are used.
notes: Attack range for the primary attack is unchanged.

gyrocopter_call_down.desc: Call down %total_strikes% aerial missile strikes that slow and damage enemy units in a target area. Each strike is %strike_separation% distance from the previous one.
notes: The visual indicator is visible to allies only.

gyrocopter_side_gunner_spawn_ability.desc: Gyrocopter gains a Side Gunner that attacks enemy units in a %AbilityCastRange% unit radius every %sidegunner_fire_rate%s with his attack. Prioritizes furthest unit away within its range.
notes: Side Gunner can attack even while Gyrocopter is disabled.
Cannot disassemble Divine Rapier or Hand of Midas.
Gyrocopter can always sell recipes for full value.

gyrocopter_afterburner.desc: Gyrocopter gains movement speed for a short duration after damaging an enemy with his attacks or abilities.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

hoodwink_hunters_boomerang.desc: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink.  The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.

hoodwink_decoy.desc: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.

hoodwink_acorn_shot.desc:
Fires Hoodwink's attack with an acorn at the target unit.  The acorn bounces to nearby targets, slowing them and dealing a percentage of Hoodwink's attack with bonus damage.
If point targeted, a tree is created at the target position and the acorn will bounce to nearby targets.  The ability may be placed on alt-cast to force this behavior.
notes: The same target can be hit more than once.
Bounces will seek units in the fog of war in a 525 radius, but not invisible units.
The planted tree lasts for 20 seconds.

hoodwink_bushwhack.desc: Tosses a net trap that stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area.  Affected enemies take damage over time and are pulled towards the tree nearest to them within the target area, and have their vision reduced to 0 for the duration of the stun.
notes: Units can be freed from the stun by destroying the tree.
Bushwhack does not hit invisible units.

hoodwink_scurry.desc: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time.

hoodwink_sharpshooter.desc:
Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero.  The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after %max_charge_time% seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after %misfire_time% seconds.
Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of %recoil_distance% from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.
hoodwink_sharpshooter.scepter: Increases arrow speed and movement speed slow.

hoodwink_sharpshooter_release.desc: Release the charged up shot, regain ability to move and attack.

hoodwink_mistwoods_wayfarer.desc: Hoodwink has a chance to redirect enemy attacks to a nearby tree.
notes: Trees that take a redirected attack are destroyed.

hoodwink_tomokan_tracker.desc: Hoodwink can see footprints of where enemy Heroes have been in the last %trail_history_duration% seconds in a %search_radius% area around her.

huskar_inner_fire.desc: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.

huskar_burning_spear.desc: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack.  Multiple attacks will stack additional damage.  Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.
huskar_burning_spear.scepter: Burning Spears launches an additional %multishot_targets% spears onto random enemies within Huskar's attack range.
notes: Burning Spear stacks additively when used multiple times on one target.  There is no cap.
Huskar cannot kill himself with this skill.
Incendiary does not deal extra Max Health Burn Damage to Roshan.

huskar_berserkers_blood.desc: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.
huskar_berserkers_blood.shard:
Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Bonuses are provided linearly, no bonus at Full HP and full bonus at strictly less than %hp_threshold_max%%% HP.

huskar_blood_magic.desc:
Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.

Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.

huskar_life_break.desc:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed.  While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
huskar_life_break.scepter: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.
notes: If Huskar is disabled during the charge or the target moves more than 1400 units in 0.015 seconds, the charge stops.
Slow works on Spell Immune units.
Life Break cannot be disjointed.

invoker_quas.desc: Allows manipulation of ice elements. Active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> instances imbue Invoker with bonus hp regeneration. Passively grants bonus strength per level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.
notes: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

invoker_wex.desc: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
notes: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

invoker_exort.desc: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Active <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> instances imbue Invoker with bonus attack damage. Passively grants bonus intelligence per level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
notes: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

invoker_empty1.desc: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.

invoker_empty2.desc: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>, and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> buffs.

invoker_invoke.desc:
Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_orb% seconds for each orb level. Invoker gains a bonus ability point for his orbs at levels %first_ability_level%, %second_ability_level%, and %third_ability_level%.

Invoker's vast knowledge of magic allows him to choose from Multiple Aghanim's Scepter and Shard options. The items must be activated before they can be used, and cannot be changed after they are chosen.

Click the help button to see the list of possible spells.
notes: The arrangement of instances does not matter.
Invoke will not cost mana or go on cooldown if the only effect is to swap the positions of existing spells.
Invoke will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

invoker_attribute_bonus.desc: Improves all attributes per point spent

invoker_cold_snap.desc: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.
notes: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than %damage_trigger% after reductions.

invoker_cold_snap_ad.desc: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases as the level goes up.
notes: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than %damage_trigger% after reductions.

invoker_ghost_walk.desc: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
invoker_ghost_walk.shard: Ghost Walk now also applies %ice_wall_damage_multiplier%x the Ice Wall Damage Per Second to enemy heroes in its area of effect.
notes: The slow effect does not work on Spell Immune enemies.

invoker_ghost_walk_ad.desc: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies, and slows Invoker as well based on the level.
notes: The slow effect does not work on Debuff Immune enemies.

invoker_tornado.desc:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
invoker_tornado.scepter: Tornado spawns twisters along its path. They persist for Tornado's duration plus additional time based on <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, dealing damage based on <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> in a %twister_radius% radius every %twister_tick_rate% seconds. (half damage to creeps.)
notes: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.

invoker_tornado_ad.desc:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level and holds enemies in the air for a duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.

invoker_emp.desc: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after %delay% seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains %self_mana_restore_pct%%% of the mana drained.
invoker_emp.shard: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at %drag_speed% units per second.
notes: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).

invoker_emp_ad.desc: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after %delay% seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 50% of the mana drained.
invoker_emp_ad.shard: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at %shard_drag_speed% units per second.
notes: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).

invoker_alacrity.desc: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> and their damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.

invoker_alacrity_ad.desc: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed and their damage.

invoker_chaos_meteor.desc: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>, and rolling further based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
notes: Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every %damage_interval% seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over %burn_duration% seconds.
The meteor moves at a speed of %travel_speed%.

invoker_chaos_meteor_ad.desc: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage and rolling further based on the level. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time.
notes: Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every %damage_interval% seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over %burn_duration% seconds.
The meteor moves at a speed of %travel_speed%.

invoker_sun_strike.desc: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
invoker_sun_strike.scepter: Creates a Cataclysm when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a %cataclysm_cooldown% second cooldown. Creates %cataclysm_count% visible %cataclysm_damage_pct%%% damage Sun Strikes within %cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range% range of each enemy hero.
invoker_sun_strike.shard: If Sun Strike damages an enemy Hero, a Forge Spirit of current level is created at the location.
notes: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.

invoker_sun_strike_ad.desc: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
invoker_sun_strike_ad.scepter: Adds Cataclysm. Launched when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a %cataclysm_cooldown% second cooldown. Creates %cataclysm_count% visible Sun Strikes within %cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range% range of each enemy hero.
notes: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.

invoker_forge_spirit.desc: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> and <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
notes: Casting this ability will replace currently summoned Forged Spirits.

invoker_forge_spirit_ad.desc: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes.
notes: Casting this ability will replace currently summoned Forged Spirits.

forged_spirit_melting_strike.desc: Melts away the armor of heroes hit by the spirit's attack. Each successive hit increases the amount of armor melted.

invoker_ice_wall.desc: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> and deals damage each second based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>.
invoker_ice_wall.scepter: Ice Wall becomes Ice Floe, Vector Targeted. After a delay, Ice Floe appears as a %wall_width% width Ice Wall. Enemy heroes in its area for longer than %root_delay% seconds become rooted and take magic damage based on <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>.

invoker_ice_wall_ad.desc: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies and deals damage each second.
notes: The slow will still affect Debuff Immune enemies if their debuff immunity was created after being affected by Ice Wall.

invoker_deafening_blast.desc: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font>. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font>, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font>.
notes: The Knockback is undispellable.

invoker_deafening_blast_ad.desc: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration then disarm their attacks for a duration.

invoker_mastermind.desc: When Invoker denies a lane creep, he gets %xp_on_deny_percent%%% of the XP.

jakiro_dual_breath.desc: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
notes: Can hit units up to 1025 range away.
Has a %fire_delay% second interval between each breath.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

jakiro_ice_path.desc: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.
notes: It takes %path_delay% seconds for the path to reach its full extent.
The stun is removed once Ice Path is destroyed.

jakiro_ice_path_detonate.desc: Destroy the Ice Path, dealing damage and stunning enemies.

jakiro_liquid_fire.desc: Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
jakiro_liquid_fire.shard: Jakiro's Liquid Fire has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
notes: Works on both units and buildings.

jakiro_liquid_ice.desc: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for %duration% seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
jakiro_liquid_ice.shard: Jakiro's Liquid Frost has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.

jakiro_macropyre.desc: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.
jakiro_macropyre.scepter: Increases Macropyre duration and causes it to deal Pure damage. Jakiro emits two walls of ice along the edges of the Macropyre that slow any enemies trying to cross them by %ice_edge_movement_slow%%%.
notes: Units hit by Macropyre will continue to be affected after they leave the area for %linger_duration% additional seconds.

jakiro_double_trouble.desc: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.
notes: The second attack ignores Damage Block.

juggernaut_blade_dance.desc: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.

juggernaut_blade_fury.desc:
Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and dealing damage every %blade_fury_damage_tick%s to nearby enemy units. Applies a basic dispel at the start and end of the spin.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
juggernaut_blade_fury.scepter: Allows Juggernaut to attack his enemies during Blade Fury even while moving. These attacks deal %scepter_attack_damage_pct%%% damage and Item Potency.
notes: You can use items during Blade Fury.

juggernaut_healing_ward.desc: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health.  The Healing Ward moves at %healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip% movement speed after being summoned.  Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
notes: The Healing Ward can be controlled.
Multiple Healing Wards do not stack.

juggernaut_omni_slash.desc:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy unit and then slashes it. Juggernaut continues to jump slash nearby random enemies (including the previously slashed enemy) until the duration ends or there are no enemies nearby. Jump rate is dependent on Juggernaut's attack speed. Juggernaut is invulnerable and has increased attack speed during Omnislash.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: You can use items during Omnislash.

juggernaut_swift_slash.desc: Performs a short Omnislash for %duration% seconds.

juggernaut_duelist.desc: Juggernaut deals %front_damage_increase%%% more damage to targets that are facing him. Damage bonus always applies during Omnislash.

juggernaut_bladeform.desc: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every %stack_gain_time%s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after %linger_duration%s upon taking any damage.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

keeper_of_the_light_illuminate.desc: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
notes: Gives increasing vision over the channeling time.

keeper_of_the_light_radiant_bind.desc: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.

keeper_of_the_light_will_o_wisp.desc: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
notes: Ignus Fatuus applies a non-interrupting pull towards it on all enemies within the radius.

keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic.desc: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is %self_bonus%%% more effective when used on himself.
notes: Chakra Magic does not reduce the cooldown of Ultimate abilities.

keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form.desc: Ezalor temporarily turns his body luminescent, gaining cast range, increasing the speed bonus from Bright Speed, and allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies.

keeper_of_the_light_recall.desc:
After a short delay, teleports the targeted friendly hero to your location. If the targeted friendly hero takes player based damage during this time, the ability is interrupted. When cast, the teleport target's movement speed is increased. Upon teleporting, the increased movement speed buff are applied to both Keeper of the Light and the teleport target, and the latter also receives a Chakra Magic.

If alt-cast, teleports Keeper of the Light to the target Ally instead.

Ability Level increases with levels of Spirit Form.
notes: If Keeper of the Light dies, the spell effect is interrupted.
Recall will interrupt channeling spells.
You can disable help to prevent Keeper from casting this spell on you.
Can be cast through the minimap, choosing the nearest friendly hero.

keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light.desc: A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is %knockback_distance% range over %knockback_duration% seconds.
notes: Upon landing, units will destroy trees in a 150 radius.

keeper_of_the_light_special_reserve.desc: Keeper of the Light cannot go below %minimum_mana% mana.

keeper_of_the_light_bright_speed.desc:
Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every %intelligence_per_speed% Intelligence.

Whenever Keeper of the Light moves %movement_per_vision% distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see %vision_radius% range for %vision_duration% seconds.

kez_switch_weapons.desc:
Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.
kez_switch_weapons.scepter:
Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within %scepter_cooldown_timer% seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.

Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.

kez_echo_slash.desc: Kez slashes forward in a %katana_distance% distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief %tag_slow%%% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again.
notes: Destroys trees. Doesn't apply Cleave.

kez_grappling_claw.desc: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.

kez_kazurai_katana.desc:
Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time.

Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.
kez_kazurai_katana.shard: Kez lifesteals %lifesteal_pct%%% from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.

kez_raptor_dance.desc:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for %AbilityCastPoint% second, becoming invulnerable for %invuln_period%s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal a fixed damage attack based on the target's max health with enhanced lifesteal.
notes: Slash Lifesteal is reduced to %illusion_lifesteal_pct%%% when slashing an illusion. Slashes do not lifesteal from creeps.

kez_falcon_rush.desc: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks with reduced damage and Item Potency.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
notes: Does not work on buildings.

kez_talon_toss.desc: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
notes: The fixed damage attack has True Strike.

kez_shodo_sai.desc:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for %parry_duration% seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for %parry_stun_duration%s and gains a Mark. When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
kez_shodo_sai.shard: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.

kez_ravens_veil.desc: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.

kunkka_tidal_wave.desc: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.

kunkka_torrent.desc: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
notes: The initial bubble effect is only visible to allies and provides vision in fog of war.
Units tossed in the air will be stunned and still able to be attacked.

kunkka_tidebringer.desc: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.

kunkka_x_marks_the_spot.desc: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds.  Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.
notes: Interrupts channeling spells.

kunkka_return.desc: Returns the marked hero to the X.

kunkka_ghostship.desc:
Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.

Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a %rum_factor%x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
kunkka_ghostship.scepter: Ghostship creates a fleet of %fleet_count% ships at the target point on a %fleet_interval% second interval. Each ship now also fires %num_cannon_volleys% waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side, plus %forward_cannon_count% straight ahead, that deal %cannon_ball_damage_pct%%% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.
notes: Actual area of effect of ship's collision is larger than the boat itself.
The boat has a movement speed of %ghostship_speed%.

kunkka_admirals_rum.desc: Damage from enemy heroes, buildings, or Roshan that would reduce Kunkka below %damage_threshold%%% threshold causes him to douse himself with The Admiral's Rum, receiving bonus movement speed and a delayed reaction to %ghostship_absorb%%% of incoming damage for %buff_duration%s.
notes: Damage dealt after Rum wears off is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.

largo_amphibian_rhapsody.desc:
Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
largo_amphibian_rhapsody.scepter: Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.
notes: Items can be used while in this mode.

largo_song_fight_song.desc: Largo plays a song that deals %burst_damage% magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.
largo_song_fight_song.scepter: Deals additional %damage_per_stack% magic damage per Groovin' stack when this song is used in double-strumming.

largo_song_double_time.desc: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.

largo_song_good_vibrations.desc: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.

largo_frogstomp.desc: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every %stomp_interval% second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.

largo_croak_of_genius.desc:
Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following %damage_duration% seconds.

When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by %duration_reduction%s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.
notes: Only applies to damage sources affected by spell amplification.
Only applies to damage where the source and target are within %max_distance% units of each other.

largo_catchy_lick.desc:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Can lick runes to pull them.

largo_encore.desc: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.
largo_encore.shard:
Whenever Largo applies a Unit Target buff to a friendly hero, he also gets the buff.

If Largo targets himself, the buff is also applied to the nearest allied hero within the cast range of the targeted ability.

legion_commander_overwhelming_odds.desc: Turns the foes' numbers against them, dealing a %movement_slow%%% impact slow for %slow_duration%s and damage to all enemies in the area. Damage increases with each enemy unit or hero in the area, and grants Legion Commander bonus attack speed.
legion_commander_overwhelming_odds.shard: Overwhelming Odds has larger radius and grants an all damage barrier based on the damage it deals to enemy heroes.

legion_commander_press_the_attack.desc:
Removes debuffs and disables from the target friendly unit, and grants bonus movement speed and health regen for a short time.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
legion_commander_press_the_attack.scepter: Increases movement speed and becomes an %radius% area of effect ability, and always affects Legion Commander when used.

legion_commander_moment_of_courage.desc: When attacked a number of times, Legion Commander will counter-attack her target with bonus lifesteal.
notes: The lifestealing strike is only triggered if being attacked.

legion_commander_duel.desc: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration. Neither hero can use items, and the target enemy hero cannot use abilities. If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage.
legion_commander_duel.scepter: When Legion Commander wins a duel, Press the Attack is automatically triggered around her.
notes: Duels will end if the units are pushed 2000 units apart.

legion_commander_outfight_them.desc: When Legion Commander or an allied Hero within %radius% range casts an ability, they gain bonus armor for %duration%s; allies gain %ally_factor%%% of the value.  This bonus stacks independently.

leshrac_split_earth.desc: Splits the earth under enemies. Deals damage and stuns for a short duration.
leshrac_split_earth.shard: Causes Split Earth to repeat in the same location %shard_max_count% additional times, with a %shard_secondary_delay% second delay between each one. Each time the radius increases by %shard_radius_increase%. Split Earth echo location is visible to both teams.
notes: Split Earth will destroy trees in its area of effect.
There is a %delay% second delay before the effect is applied.

leshrac_diabolic_edict.desc: Saturates the area around Leshrac with magical explosions that deal pure damage to enemy units and buildings.  The fewer units available to attack, the more damage those units will take.
notes: The explosions will continue even if Leshrac is killed.

leshrac_lightning_storm.desc: Summons a lightning storm that blasts the target enemy unit, then strikes any nearby enemy units. Struck enemies have their move speed slowed.

leshrac_greater_lightning_storm.desc:
Leshrac emits an aura that disarms and constantly dispels nearby enemy units. Leshrac also constantly dispels himself.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

leshrac_pulse_nova.desc: Creates waves of damaging energy around Leshrac, one per second, to damage nearby enemy units. Drains Leshrac's mana with each pulse.

leshrac_defilement.desc: Leshrac gains %aoe_per_int% Area of Effect Bonus per Intelligence.

lich_frost_nova.desc: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for %abilityduration% seconds.  The primary target receives both base and area damage.

lich_death_charge.desc:
Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.

Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.
notes: Cannot sacrifice ancients or creep-heroes.
Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes. Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.

lich_sinister_gaze.desc: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.
lich_sinister_gaze.scepter: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.

lich_frost_shield.desc: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every %interval% seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
notes: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by the damage or slow.
Frost Shield can be cast on buildings.

lich_chain_frost.desc: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to %jumps% times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
notes: Chain Frost cannot be disjointed.
Chain Frost has a movement speed of %projectile_speed%.
Chain Frost doesn't bounce to Zombies.

lich_ice_spire.desc:
Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. When destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.

Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 pip if there are no other enemies in range.

Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 pip.

life_stealer_rage.desc:
Launch into a maddened rage, becoming Debuff Immune, increasing magic resistance and gaining movement speed.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

life_stealer_unfettered.desc:
Descend into a violent fury, gaining increased status and magic resistance. Applies a dispel and can be cast while disabled.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

life_stealer_feast.desc: Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains %bonus_hp_per_creep% permanent max HP whenever he kills a creep and %bonus_hp_per_hero% permanent max HP whenever he kills a hero.
notes: Works on allies and enemies. Does not affect Roshan.
The heal is independent of the damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

life_stealer_open_wounds.desc: Lifestealer rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.
notes: Open Wounds slows over 8 different steps: 50% / 50% / 40% / 30% / 20% / 10% / 10% / 10%, with the slow decreasing one step per second.
The amount healed is amplified by Lifestealer's Health Restoration Amplification.

life_stealer_infest.desc:
Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
life_stealer_infest.scepter: Increases cast range and reduces cooldown to %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s.  Infest may target enemy heroes for a short duration, attacking them from the inside while increasing Lifestealer's regeneration rate.
life_stealer_infest.shard: Infest explosion applies a %dot_duration%s duration Open Wounds to enemies in the damage radius. Consuming a creep with Infest drenches enemies in blood which deals damage over time based on the host's remaining health.
notes: Lifestealer gains experience while under the effects of Infest.
Creeps that are controlled while Infested gain Infest's movement speed bonus.
Infest can be used on Ancient creeps.

life_stealer_consume.desc: Lifestealer eats the host body from the inside out, exploding from within.

lina_dragon_slave.desc: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.
notes: Dragon Slave can hit units up to 1225 units away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

lina_light_strike_array.desc: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.
notes: Light Strike Array will destroy trees in its area of effect.

lina_fiery_soul.desc: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts %fiery_soul_stack_duration% seconds.
notes: Duration refreshes each time an opponent is hit with a spell.
Using items does not trigger Fiery Soul.

lina_flame_cloak.desc: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance.

lina_laguna_blade.desc: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.
lina_laguna_blade.shard: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.
notes: Laguna Blade has a %damage_delay% delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.

lina_slow_burn.desc: Lina's abilities deal an additional %burn_damage_pct%%% damage as burn damage over %burn_duration%s.

lina_combustion.desc: Every %damage_threshold% damage Lina does to an enemy hero causes them to overheat, doing damage to their nearby allies. This effect can trigger multiple times off a single instance of damage. Overheated illusions do less damage.

lion_impale.desc: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
notes: The spikes move at %speed% units per second.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

lion_voodoo.desc: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.
notes: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

lion_mana_drain.desc:
CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by %movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%.

Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a %ally_pct%%% rate.
lion_mana_drain.shard: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to %shard_bonus_targets% additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance while channeling.
notes: Prevents heroes from going invisible.

lion_finger_of_death.desc:
Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.

After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with %punch_attack_range% range with bonus movement speed.

Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills.

The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.
lion_finger_of_death.scepter: Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.
notes: Finger of Death has a %damage_delay% delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
Finger of Death only gains damage if the enemy hero dies within %grace_period% seconds of being affected by Finger of Death.

lion_to_hell_and_back.desc:
Lion gains %debuff_amp%%% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.

Lion gains %spell_amp%%% spell amplification for %duration%s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.

lone_druid_gift_bearer.desc: Lone Druid's Spirit Bear receives a copy of his Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.

lone_druid_bear_necessities.desc: Lone Druid can only use the first %item_slots% items in his inventory. These items' passive bonuses are more powerful. Other item slots do not provide any bonuses. Neutral slot is unaffected.
notes:
The following attributes can be increased:
* Intelligence, Strength and Agility
* Health, Mana and Evasion
* Attack Speed and Bonus Damage
* Health and Mana Regen

lone_druid_spirit_bear.desc:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.

If the bear moves too far away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack. Lone Druid suffers %backlash_damage%%% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies. Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
notes: Most spells interact with the Spirit Bear in the same way as they do with heroes.
Spirit Bear has 0 base attributes, 0 base armor, and %base_magic_resistance%%% base magic resistance. Attributes from buffs or items fully affect the bear as they would for Universal heroes.
Spirit Bear cannot gain experience. The Spirit Bear levels up when Lone Druid levels up.
Spirit Bear has its own Aghanim's Scepter and Shard upgrades.
Spirit Bear receives a copy of Lone Druid's Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.

lone_druid_spirit_link.desc: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
lone_druid_spirit_link.scepter:
Lone Druid severs his link to his Spirit Bear, and connects to the target allied hero, sharing the Spirit Link bonuses with them for %duration%s. Armor sharing and attack speed are increased by %active_bonus%%%. Damage done by the ally heals Lone Druid, as well as the other way around.

The Spirit Bear is feared for the duration of the transformation, unless he has his own Aghanim's Scepter.
notes: Break disables the shared lifesteal.

lone_druid_spirit_bear_spirit_link.desc: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
notes: Break disables the shared lifesteal.

lone_druid_savage_roar.desc: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by %bonus_speed%%%.
lone_druid_savage_roar.shard:
Applies a basic dispel and grants allies in an area around the caster bonus movement and attack speed. Replicates between Lone Druid and Spirit Bear regardless of castability on the other.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: An entangled hero will not be able to move.
Cooldown is shared with Spirit Bear.

lone_druid_savage_roar_bear.desc: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by %bonus_speed%%%.
notes: An entangled hero will not be able to move.
Cooldown is shared with Lone Druid.

lone_druid_true_form.desc: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining bonus armor, bonus health, and bonus attack damage.

lone_druid_spirit_bear_return.desc: Channels for %channel_tooltip% seconds and then teleports the Spirit Bear back to the Lone Druid.

lone_druid_spirit_bear_summon_druid.desc:
If Lone Druid were to die while the Spirit Bear is alive and within %attack_leash_range_tooltip% range of him, he is not killed. His spirit is stored with the Spirit Bear until the druid is summoned with an active cast of this ability. Killing the Spirit Bear while it keeps Lone Druid's spirit will kill the druid as well.

Passively increases the Spirit Bear's attack leash range by %bonus_attack_leash_range%.
notes: Lone Druid cannot be summoned back for %summon_lockout% seconds after he goes down.

lone_druid_spirit_bear_entangle.desc:
Allows Spirit Bear to Entangle enemy heroes once they gain %hits_required% stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

Spirit Bear's attacks are permanently empowered, making them apply %spirit_bear_counters_applied_tooltip% stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.
notes: Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
Enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
Stacks are only applied to enemy heroes, creep heroes, and Roshan.

lone_druid_entangle.desc:
Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain %hits_required% stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

When cast, applies %hits_incremented_on_active% stacks to each enemy hero in the area and %hits_required% stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for %lone_druid_buff_duration%s, making him apply %lone_druid_counters_applied_tooltip% stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.
