Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.
lone_druid_entangle.scepter: Entangle applies %hits_required% stacks to enemy heroes in the area and has increased radius. Enemies no longer have protection from gaining stacks while Entangled.
notes: Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
Lone Druid's Empowered Buff and enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
Entangled debuff is dispellable.
Creeps can't gain stacks from either Lone Druid's or Spirit Bear's attacks, and are Entangled only on cast.
Roshan is affected as if he were a hero.

lone_druid_spirit_bear_fetch.desc: Grabs the Target Ally, Enemy or Rune, and uncontrollably drags them towards Lone Druid for the duration. Enemies receive damage every %tick_rate%s. When dragging a unit, they are Rooted.

lone_druid_spirit_bear_demolish.desc: Spirit Bear deals more damage to buildings.

luna_lucent_beam.desc: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.
luna_lucent_beam.shard: Grants Luna an attack damage bonus buff every time an enemy hero is hit by Lucent Beam. Lucent Beams created by Eclipse grant %damage_buff_from_eclipse_pct%%% of the damage amount.

luna_lunar_orbit.desc: Creates %rotating_glaives% glaives that rotate %rotating_glaives_movement_radius% radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.
luna_lunar_orbit.shard: Increases damage reduction. While active, Luna gains %bonus_movement_speed%%% bonus movement speed.

luna_moon_glaive.desc: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Damage and Item Potency decrease with each bounce.
notes: Additional bounces do not benefit from lifesteal or critical strike.

luna_lunar_blessing.desc: Grants attack damage to Luna and nearby allied heroes within %radius% range, with Luna receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with bonus night vision.

luna_eclipse.desc: Showers random nearby enemies with strikes from Luna's current level of Lucent Beam. These beams do not stun their targets, and there is a maximum number of times that a single target can be struck. Also turns day into night for a short time.
luna_eclipse.scepter: Allows Luna to cast Eclipse on an allied unit or herself and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. Increases total beams, reduces duration, removes the limit on beams per unit, and makes the beams appear twice as fast.
notes: Eclipse doesn't work if Luna doesn't have any points in Lucent Beam.
Beams will stop if Luna is killed.
Will not hit invisible units.
There is a %beam_interval% seconds gap between beams, %beam_interval_scepter% seconds with scepter.

lycan_summon_wolves.desc: Summons %wolf_count% wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.
lycan_summon_wolves.shard: Increases the number of wolves summoned. Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.
notes: Using this spell will replace currently active summoned Wolves.

lycan_wolf_bite.desc: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. While shapeshifted this way, the target counts as a unit under Lycan's control for Pack Hunter.
notes: Wolf Bite cooldown matches the cooldown of the current level of Shapeshift.

lycan_howl.desc: Strikes fear into enemies, reducing armor and attack damage of all enemies within %radius% range of Lycan and his wolves. At night, Howl's armor and attack damage reductions are global.

lycan_pack_hunter.desc: Lycan and units under his control mark units on attack for %mark_duration% seconds. When Lycan or a unit under his control attacks a marked unit, it deals bonus damage equal to %bonus_damage%%% of its attack damage per stack, and heals the attacker for %lifesteal%%% of its attack damage per stack.
notes: Each unit can apply 1 mark per enemy.
Marked units are revealed through fog of war and invisibility.
Does not pierce Debuff Immunity.

lycan_feral_impulse.desc: Increases the HP regeneration and damage for Lycan and all units under his control.
notes: Does not increase damage from items.

lycan_shapeshift.desc: Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him critical strikes and added vision at night. During Shapeshift, Lycan moves at increased speed and cannot be slowed.  Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control.
notes: Hex doesn't remove Lycan's movement speed.

lycan_summon_wolves_critical_strike.desc: Gives %maim_chance%%% to cripple the target, causing %maim_damage% damage per second and lose %maim_attack_speed% Attack Speed for %maim_duration% seconds.

lycan_summon_wolves_hamstring.desc: The wolf bites down on an enemy's hamstring, rooting them for a short duration. After the bite, the next %damage_boost_stacks% attacks from units controlled by Lycan deal bonus damage.

lycan_summon_wolves_hightail.desc: The wolf gains a short burst of energy, gaining phased movement, evasion, hasted movement speed, and attack speed.

lycan_apex_predator.desc: Lycan and units he controls deal extra damage to neutral creeps.

magnataur_horn_toss.desc: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend %air_duration% seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.

magnataur_shockwave.desc: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line, pulling them towards him, and slowing them for a brief period.

magnataur_empower.desc:
When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack. 

 Empower is always on Magnus with %self_multiplier%%% larger bonus.
notes: The bonus damage is based only on base damage and damage from primary attributes.
Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
Ranged units cannot Cleave.

magnataur_skewer.desc: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.
magnataur_skewer.shard: Increases range and deals additional damage when skewering enemies into trees or cliffs.
notes: Skewer is interrupted if Magnus is stunned, hexed or banished.

magnataur_reverse_polarity.desc: Magnus changes properties of matter, pulling all nearby enemies in front of him and stunning them with a damaging slam.

magnataur_solid_core.desc: Magnus has increased slow resistance and suffers less knockback from enemy's abilities and items.

marci_grapple.desc: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.

marci_unleash.desc:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for %pulse_debuff_duration%s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for %time_between_flurries%s.

Marci gains %bonus_movespeed%%% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
marci_unleash.scepter:
Reduces Unleash cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction% seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for %pulse_silence_duration% seconds.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Once a Fury combo is started, each attack must be delivered within 1s or the Fury combo expires.
Removes attack speed limit.

marci_companion_run.desc:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives %ally_movespeed_pct%%% bonus movement speed for %ally_buff_duration%s.
marci_companion_run.shard: Increases damage. Rebound can be cast on enemies, and causes Marci to also get the speed boost when she casts it.
notes: Marci's initial run to her target unit can be disjointed.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Does not bring allies who are Rooted or Leashed when alt-cast.

marci_bodyguard.desc:
Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.

When cast on an ally, she provides them with %max_partner_penalty%%% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, %shared_barrier_replenish_amount%%% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.
notes: Marci cannot cast Bodyguard on herself.
Lifesteal effectiveness gets a %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%% penalty against creeps.
The shared barrier is reduced by damage on either Marci or her partner.

marci_special_delivery.desc:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.

Passively grants all allied couriers %bonus_levels% bonus levels and %bonus_hp_tooltip% extra pip.
notes: Special Delivery whistle has a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% second.
If the courier didn't transfer any items or still has items after casting, it will remain next to Marci.

mars_spear.desc: Mars throws his legendary Spear with deadly precision, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
mars_spear.shard: Spear of Mars impales up to %max_impale_targets% heroes and leaves a fire trail behind that deals damage over time and slows movement speed.
notes: Spear of Mars can hit invisible units and reveals them if they are stunned.
Spear of Mars will only pin a unit to cliffs onto elevated areas, otherwise it will push them off onto lower ground.

mars_gods_rebuke.desc: Mars smashes enemies in front of him with his shield, knocking them back and damaging them with a critical hit based on his attack. Bonus damage is added when hitting heroes. Has True Strike.
notes: Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on God's Rebuke attacks.

mars_dauntless.desc: Mars gets more HP Regen the more he is outnumbered by enemy heroes in %radius% radius.

mars_immovable.desc: Mars cannot be affected by forced movement.

mars_bulwark.desc:
Mars wields his massive shield to block a portion of each physical attack when hit from the front or sides.

Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing Mars's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs %redirect_chance%%% of the attack projectiles aimed at allies towards himself.
mars_bulwark.scepter: Creates %soldier_count% invulnerable soldiers on both sides of Mars front while Bulwark is toggled on. Soldiers move alongside Mars, dealing his attacks that have bonus damage, knock back and slow approaching enemies. An enemy can only be attacked by one soldier at a time.
notes: Redirect only works if the projectile targets are in a cone behind Mars or within 100 range of him.
Break disables the front and side damage reduction.

mars_arena_of_blood.desc: After a short formation time, Mars summons an arena lined with the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement. Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears, dealing damage and knocking them back.
mars_arena_of_blood.scepter: Lowers cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increases duration. If an enemy is killed in the Arena, Mars and all of his allies inside the Arena restore %arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%%  of their max health and mana and get a %arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%%  attack damage buff for %arena_kill_buff_duration%s. This effect stacks.

medusa_cold_blooded.desc: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for %stone_form_scepter_base_tooltip%s.

medusa_split_shot.desc:
Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.

The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
medusa_split_shot.scepter: Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.
notes: Secondary targets will be the closest enemy units excluding the primary target.
If illusions of Medusa are created while Split Shot is active, they will also have this ability.

medusa_mystic_snake.desc: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.
notes: Mystic Snake cannot be disjointed.

medusa_mana_shield.desc: Creates a shield that absorbs %absorption_pct%%% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb %illusion_percentage%%% less damage per point of mana.
notes: Absorbs damage before any damage reduction takes place, meaning that armor will not reduce the amount of mana needed to absorb damage.

medusa_stone_gaze.desc: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed.  If %face_duration% seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone.  Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.
notes: Regardless of when a unit receives the Stone Gaze buff while the ability is active on Medusa, it will still receive the full debuff duration.

medusa_gorgon_grasp.desc: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in %volley_count% groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of magic damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second. An enemy can only be hit once per cast.

medusa_undulation.desc: Medusa's movement speed is fixed at %fixed_movespeed% (%stone_gaze_ms_tooltip_only% during Stone Gaze). Medusa is unslowable and does not benefit from movement speed increases.
notes: Medusa can still benefit from movement speed bonuses from stream currents.

meepo_earthbind.desc: Tosses a net at the target point, rooting down all enemy units in an area around it.
notes: Affects invisible units, revealing them.
Does not work on Debuff Immune units or Roshan.

meepo_poof.desc:
Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for %cast_duration% seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations.

If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.
notes: Can be cast through the minimap.
Can teleport to Meepo illusions.

meepo_ransack.desc:
Steals health from the enemy with each strike and heals all other Meepos for that amount.

Reduced to 60% against creeps.
notes: Amount healed is amplified by Health Restoration Amplification

meepo_divided_we_stand.desc:
Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls.

Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them %dps_penalty_pct%%% less effective.

If any Meepo dies, they all die.

Experience gained by any Meepo is decreased proportionally by the number of Meepos that have gained experience in the last %xp_penalty_time%s.
meepo_divided_we_stand.shard:
Divided We Stand can be cast to pick up the target friendly Meepo or creep, disarming Meepo and disabling them. Use the sub-ability to throw the carried unit at the target, dealing damage and slowing enemies within %radius_tooltip% radius of the impact.

If the carried target is a Meepo, it shares damage with the carrier. The carried target will be dropped if not thrown in time.

meepo_megameepo.desc:
Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a %radius% radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains %stats_pct%%% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.

 When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals %poof_damage_factor%%% more damage for each Meepo on top.

meepo_megameepo_fling.desc: In MegaMeepo form, Meepo flings the topmost meepo towards a target within a %AbilityCastRange% range, dealing damage and slowing their movement speed.
notes: Does not trigger spell reflect.

meepo_petrify.desc:
Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for %duration%s. Restores %hp_restore%%% of his max health over that duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

meepo_pack_rat.desc: All Meepos can use the item in the neutral item slot.
notes: Most items except for Consumables, Hand of Midas, and Divine Rapier can be equipped in the neutral item slot.
Using the item on one Meepo puts it on cooldown for all other Meepos for %cooldown_pct%%% of the regular cooldown.
Certain passive abilities and effects on items have reduced or no effectiveness.

meepo_sticky_fingers.desc: Has an extra choice of neutral item to select from.

meepo_fling_release.desc:
Throws the Meepo or creep carried by Divided We Stand at the target, dealing damage in a %impact_radius% radius and slowing on impact.

If the carried target is a Meepo, it shares damage with the carrier. The carried target will be dropped after %hold_duration% seconds.
notes: Does not trigger spell reflect.

meepo_geomancy.desc:
Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain. Each Meepo grants his bonus to the other Meepos.

If there is a tree within %tree_radius% range, he receives %tree_regen% HP regen.

If he is standing on dirt, he receives %dirt_move_speed%%% bonus movement speed.

If he is in the water, his attacks slow the target by %water_move_slow%%% for %water_slow_duration% seconds.
notes: Dirt includes any terrain that is not water.

mirana_arrow.desc: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from %arrow_min_stun% to %arrow_max_stun% seconds, with bonus damage up to %arrow_bonus_damage% added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
mirana_arrow.scepter: Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.
notes: For every 150 distance the arrow travels, the stun duration upon impact increases by 0.5 seconds, and the bonus damage added increases by 14.
Sacred Arrow can hit invisible units.
Starstruck does not apply to the second Starstorm from Aghanim's Scepter.

mirana_invis.desc: Turns Mirana and all allied heroes invisible and grants bonus movement speed. Mirana gains bonus outgoing damage during the duration. If a hero is revealed, invisibility will restore after the fade delay as long as Moonlight Shadow's duration has not expired.
notes: Units affected will not auto attack enemies.

mirana_solar_flare.desc:
Gradually increases attack speed and damage of Mirana and all allied heroes, reaching maximum power after %max_damage_time%s.

Allies receive %ally_pct%%% of the bonus.

mirana_leap.desc: Mirana leaps forward into battle, empowering herself with a ferocious roar that grants bonus attack and movement speed. Speed bonus lasts %leap_bonus_duration% seconds.

mirana_starfall.desc: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units. The closest enemy unit to Mirana in a %starfall_secondary_radius% radius will be struck a second time.
notes: Starstorm is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
Starstorm cannot hit invisible units.
Starstorm will choose a new target for the second meteor if the first died before impact.

mirana_selemenes_faithful.desc: Healing Lotuses are %bonus_lotus%%% more effective on Mirana and her allies.

mirana_celestial_quiver.desc: When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will have bonus item potency and magic damage.
mirana_celestial_quiver.shard: Grants %quiver_restore% temporary Charges while Leap's buff is active.

special_bonus_unique_mirana_2.desc: The extra arrows are launched in a cone shape, {s:bonus_extra_arrows_angle} degrees to the left and right of the original arrow, and cannot hit the same target.

special_bonus_unique_mirana_5.desc: Evasion works at all times during the buff

monkey_king_boundless_strike.desc: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.
monkey_king_boundless_strike.shard: Boundless Strike applies Primal Spring with %spring_channel_pct%%% of the max channeling duration power to enemies along the staff and at the end of the staff. When Boundless Strike is set to alt-cast, Monkey King leaps to the target position and Primal Spring damage is dealt around the jump area instead.

monkey_king_mischief.desc: Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for %invul_duration% seconds upon transforming.

monkey_king_untransform.desc: Reverts Monkey King's shape to his original form.

monkey_king_tree_dance.desc: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for %unperched_stunned_duration%s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
notes: Tree Dance cooldown starts upon landing.
Right-clicking the ground will have Monkey King drop from the tree.
Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.

monkey_king_primal_spring.desc: CHANNELED - Monkey King springs out from his tree perch, damaging and slowing enemies in the area where he lands. Damage and slow amounts are in proportion to channel duration.

monkey_king_wukongs_command.desc:
Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack that attacks at a fixed rate of %attack_speed%s, and only targets enemy Heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.

Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a short duration, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead.
monkey_king_wukongs_command.scepter: Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.
notes: Soldiers do not receive Jingu Mastery bonuses.
Soldiers do not copy Basher or Abyssal.

monkey_king_jingu_mastery.desc: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the number of required hits on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns %charges% charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
notes: Hitting an enemy with Boundless Strike adds to the hit counter.
Repeatedly hitting an enemy refreshes the Jingu Mastery debuff duration.
Hit charges on enemies cannot be dispelled.
Jingu Mastery buff on self can be dispelled.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

monkey_king_transfiguration.desc: Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a %transfiguration_duration%s, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead. While transformed, Monkey King is invulnerable, but cannot attack or cast spells

morphling_waveform.desc: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.

morphling_adaptive_strike_agi.desc:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
notes: Projectile moves at %projectile_speed% speed.

morphling_morph_agi.desc: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
morphling_morph_agi.shard: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
notes: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Agility Gain will also level up Strength Gain.

morphling_morph_str.desc: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Agility and pouring them into Strength at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
morphling_morph_str.shard: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
notes: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Strength Gain will also level up Agility Gain.

morphling_syntropy.desc:
Morphling's attacks have increased attack range, slowing the target's movement and attack speed.

 If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum Attack Speed slow is applied. 

If Morphling's Strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum Movement Speed slow is applied.

morphling_ebb.desc: Morphling's Primary Attribute is now <font color='#9acd32'>Agility</font>.

morphling_flow.desc: Morphling's Primary Attribute is now <font color='#ff0000'>Strength</font>. Adaptive Strike stuns based on Morphling's strength. Morphling gains %one_percent_tooltip%%% Spell Amp per %agi_per_one_spell_amp% Agility.
notes: Break disables the Spell Amp per Agility.

morphling_replicate.desc: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
morphling_replicate.scepter: While Morph is active, every time Morphling casts a unit-targeted spell, %scepter_echo_count% lesser replicants appear one after another %scepter_echo_cast_delay% seconds apart, and cast it again at a nearby target, or the same target if no other valid targets are available. Every echo is weaker, dealing less damage, healing less health, and applying shorter buffs/debuffs than the previous one.
notes: You can't target yourself with Morph.
Morph won't copy Shard/Scepter abilities unless Morphling owns the respective item.
Does not trigger spell reflect.

morphling_morph_replicate.desc: Toggles Morphling's form between his own and the replicated enemy.

morphling_accumulation.desc: Morphling receives %percent_to_increment%%% of stat growth bonuses every half level instead of the full bonus at level up. All Attributes bonuses from skill points in the Talent Tree provide an additional +%bonus_primary_stat_per_level_of_attributes% to Morphling's primary attribute.

morphling_ebb_and_flow.desc: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.
notes: Attack range bonuses during morph only apply when morphed into a Ranged hero.

muerta_dead_shot.desc:
Muerta fires a ghostly trickshot at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.

The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.
muerta_dead_shot.scepter: Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.
notes: Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
The ricochet will travel %ricochet_distance_multiplier%x Dead Shot's cast range.
Can ricochet off of magic immune targets.

muerta_the_calling.desc: Summons a group of %num_revenants% revenants that slowly circle the targeted location. Enemies within the area are slowed. Revenants deal damage and silence enemies as they pass through them.

muerta_gunslinger.desc: Toggleable. When toggled on, Muerta's attacks have a chance to fire a second shot at another target.
notes: If no other units are in range, she fires both guns at the original target.
Secondary shots can hit units within Muerta's attack range plus %target_search_bonus_range%.
The secondary shot can trigger attack modifiers.
Prioritizes heroes, then non-hero units, then buildings.

muerta_pierce_the_veil.desc:
Muerta transforms, becoming ethereal, gaining bonus base damage and phased movement.

Passively allows Muerta to always attack ethereal targets and attack when she is ethereal. When either she or her target is ethereal, all of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage and her physical lifesteal is treated as spell lifesteal.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
muerta_pierce_the_veil.shard:
Muerta gains %spell_lifesteal%%% Spell Lifesteal during Pierce the Veil.
While Pierce the Veil is active Muerta permanently gains %spell_amp_steal%%% spell amplification each time she kills an enemy Hero or they die in her vicinity. Bonus applies retroactively.
notes: Muerta will dodge projectiles upon transformation.
Muerta cannot attack buildings while transformed.

muerta_ofrenda.desc:
Muerta places a sacred altar at the targeted location that increases her attack speed when she is near it.

When respawning, Muerta will gain the benefits of Pierce The Veil's corporeal form for %pierce_the_veil_duration_pct%%% of the duration and respawn at the Ofrenda.

Muerta can select the Ofrenda and force it to destroy itself. Only one Ofrenda can exist at a time.

muerta_supernatural.desc: Whenever an enemy hero dies within %stack_collection_range% units of Muerta, she gains a stack of %spell_amp_per_stack%%% spell amplification. When Muerta dies she loses half the stacks, rounded down.

muerta_spectral_slug.desc: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for %duration%s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and %bonus_spell_damage_pct%%% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.

muerta_ofrenda_destroy.desc: Destroy this Ofrenda, ensuring that Muerta will respawn in the fountain.

naga_siren_mirror_image.desc:
Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Naga Siren is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing her to dodge stuns and damage.
Upon casting, most effects are removed from Naga Siren.
Upon casting, existing Mirror Image illusions are destroyed.

naga_siren_ensnare.desc: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.
naga_siren_ensnare.scepter: Increases cast range and projectile speed.  Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.

naga_siren_rip_tide.desc: Naga Siren and her illusions deal bonus damage to enemies and reduce their armor for %duration% seconds every %hits% attacks.
notes: Using Rip Tide doesn't interrupt channeling.

naga_siren_deluge.desc: Naga Siren and all of her images hit nearby units with a damaging wave of water that caps their max movement speed.
notes: Casting Deluge doesn't interrupt channeling.

naga_siren_eelskin.desc: Naga Siren has bonus evasion, increased per every other Naga Siren within %radius% radius.

naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.desc: All enemies in range of the Naga Siren are put into a magical stasis where they cannot act or be attacked. Using Song of the Siren again will end the duration early.
naga_siren_song_of_the_siren.shard: Allies in range of Song of the Siren recover a percentage of their health and mana per second.
notes: Units affected by Song of the Siren are invulnerable and cannot take damage from any source.
The area of the song follows Naga, so if she moves far enough away from affected units, they will wake up.

naga_siren_song_of_the_siren_cancel.desc: Release enemy units from your song so they can be targeted again.

naga_siren_reel_in.desc: CHANNELED - Naga Siren channels for up to %AbilityChannelTime% seconds, pulling all units affected by Naga's Ensnare in a %radius% range towards her at a speed of %pull_strength%. Channeling ends when the Ensnared unit is %min_pull_distance% distance away.
naga_siren_reel_in.scepter: Allows Reel In to affect Spell Immune units.

naga_siren_slithereen_cutlass.desc: Naga Siren's attacks add a stacking debuff that causes the target to miss attacks for %debuff_duration% seconds, up to a max of %max_stacks% stacks.

necrolyte_death_seeker.desc: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
notes: Does not trigger spell reflect.

necrolyte_death_pulse.desc: Necrophos releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.
notes: Death Pulse can't be disjointed.

necrolyte_heartstopper_aura.desc: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.
necrolyte_heartstopper_aura.scepter: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by %heal_regen_to_damage%%% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.
notes: Damage won't disable items like Blink Dagger.
Does not affect ancient creeps.

necrolyte_sadist.desc: Necrophos gains stacking regen for %regen_duration% seconds for each unit he kills. Hero kills multiply the effect.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

necrolyte_ghost_shroud.desc: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.

necrolyte_reapers_scythe.desc: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.
notes: Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.

nevermore_shadowraze1.desc: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
nevermore_shadowraze1.shard: Cooldown reduced by %cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
notes: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.

nevermore_shadowraze2.desc: Shadow Fiend razes the ground a short distance away from him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
nevermore_shadowraze2.shard: Cooldown reduced by %cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
notes: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.

nevermore_shadowraze3.desc: Shadow Fiend razes the ground a longer distance away from him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
nevermore_shadowraze3.shard: Cooldown reduced by %cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
notes: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.

nevermore_necromastery.desc: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining %necromastery_damage_per_soul% bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant %souls_per_hero_kill% souls. On death, he releases %soul_release_tooltip%%% of them from bondage.
notes: Denies and neutral creeps also provide bonus damage through Necromastery.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

nevermore_dark_lord.desc: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor and magic resistance of nearby enemies.
notes: Stacks fully with other armor reduction abilities and aura.

nevermore_frenzy.desc:
Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for %duration% seconds. For the duration of the effect, every %soul_collection_interval%s he collects souls from %soul_collection_per_interval% enemies in a %soul_collection_radius% radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for %linger_duration%s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.

 Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.

nevermore_requiem.desc:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed reduced for %requiem_fear_duration% seconds, increased by %requiem_duration_per_soul% seconds for each additional soul that hits it. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.

Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
nevermore_requiem.scepter: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.
notes: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every %requiem_soul_conversion% soul in his possession.
Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.

night_stalker_void.desc: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.
night_stalker_void.shard: Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.
notes: Void does not ministun enemies during the day.

night_stalker_crippling_fear.desc: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him.  The effect lasts longer at night.

night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.desc: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.
night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.scepter: Increases bonus movement speed by %bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%% and attack speed by %bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.
night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night.shard: Hunter in the Night may be cast on a creep, instantly killing it and restoring some of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana. Cannot target ancients during the daytime.

night_stalker_darkness.desc: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.

night_stalker_heart_of_darkness.desc: Night Stalker's health regeneration is increased during the night and decreased during the day.
night_stalker_heart_of_darkness.shard: Heart of Darkness now also applies to mana regeneration at night with the same values as health regeneration. Increases the duration of night time by %nighttime_increase%s.

night_stalker_night_reign.desc: The game now starts at night instead of day. Night is longer than day.

night_stalker_midnight_feast.desc: Night Stalker heals himself when attacking enemy units. At night, the ability can be activated to instantly destroy a non-ancient creep and restore a percentage of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana.
notes: Amount of health gained from attacking is affecting by Health Restoration and is decreased when attacking non-hero targets.

nyx_assassin_impale.desc: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.
notes: The spikes move at %speed% units per second, over %length% range.
Impale cannot be blocked by Linken's Sphere.

nyx_assassin_mana_burn.desc: Deals damage to the target based on its max mana.  A percentage of that damage is dealt as mana burn.

nyx_assassin_jolt.desc: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away.

nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace.desc:
When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.

While Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.
notes: The damage is calculated after all reductions.
Spiked Carapace will only trigger on damage from other player controlled sources.
The damage reflected will have the same damage type as it had when it was dealt to Nyx Assassin.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

nyx_assassin_vendetta.desc: Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target. Nyx Assassin has %attack_range_bonus% additional attack range and a %attack_animation_bonus%%% faster attack animation for this attack.
nyx_assassin_vendetta.shard: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. For the first %free_pathing_duration%s of Vendetta, Nyx is hasted and has unobstructed pathing.
notes: If a spell is used to break the invisibility, or the invisibility expires, the bonus damage is lost.
With Aghanim's Shard, the Break is applied before the bonus damage.

nyx_assassin_burrow.desc: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources, and Scarab Metabolism is always active at %scarab_metabolism_multiplier%x strength.
notes: Casting Vendetta will cancel burrow.

nyx_assassin_nyxth_sense.desc: Nyx Assassin can detect heroes within %radius% units of himself.

nyx_assassin_neuro_sting.desc: Nyx Assassin's damage on enemies also burns mana as a percentage of the damage dealt.

nyx_assassin_scarab_metabolism.desc: After %out_of_combat_time%s without taking damage, Nyx Assassin gains bonus movement speed and regenerates based on his max health and max mana per second.

obsidian_destroyer_arcane_orb.desc: Adds extra pure damage to Outworld Destroyer's attacks, based on his remaining mana pool.
obsidian_destroyer_arcane_orb.scepter: Arcane Orb bounces to an additional target for %bounce_damage_reduction%%% less damage.
notes: The damage is calculated after the mana cost is spent.

obsidian_destroyer_ominous_discernment.desc: Outworld Destroyer gains an additional %bonus_max_mana_per_int% mana per point of Intelligence.

obsidian_destroyer_astral_imprisonment.desc: Steals a percentage of the target's max mana and places them into an astral prison. The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled. When the astral prison implodes, it deals damage to the target.
obsidian_destroyer_astral_imprisonment.shard: Astral Imprisonment now deals damage in an area. Also allows allies to move at %allied_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed during Astral Imprisonment (they are visible, but untargettable and can't perform any other actions).
notes: Imprisoned units can still be hit by Sanity's Eclipse.
Max mana steal does not increase Outworld Destroyer's current mana values or directly reduce the victim's mana values.

obsidian_destroyer_equilibrium.desc: Passively grants a chance to restore a percentage of your max mana each time you cast an ability. Restores less mana from spells that modify attacks.

obsidian_destroyer_sanity_eclipse.desc: Unleashes a psychic blast that deals damage to enemies based on the difference between your max mana and the target's max mana. Sanity's Eclipse can hit units trapped by Astral Imprisonment.

obsidian_destroyer_objurgation.desc: Increases Outworld Destroyer's maximum mana. When cast, protects Outworld Destroyer with an all damage barrier equal to a flat amount and a percentage of his maximum mana.
obsidian_destroyer_objurgation.scepter: Increases max mana to barrier. Damage that would bring Outworld Destroyer below %automatic_trigger_threshold%%% health is prevented. When that happens, Outworld Destroyer receives a strong dispel and gains an undispellable instance of Objurgation. This effect cannot occur more than once every %automatic_trigger_cd% seconds.

ogre_magi_dumb_luck.desc: Ogre Magi's max Intelligence is 0. He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.

ogre_magi_fireblast.desc: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.
ogre_magi_fireblast.scepter: Fireblast is refined, reducing cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increasing cast speed by %bonus_cast_speed%%%.
notes: When Multicast, Fireblast hits the same target each time with a %multicast_delay% seconds interval.

ogre_magi_smash.desc: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next %attacks% attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.
notes: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an %multicast_fireshield_aoe% area of effect to receive Fire Shield.

ogre_magi_unrefined_fireblast.desc: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing %base_damage% + %str_multiplier%x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is %scepter_mana%%% of Ogre Magi's current mana.
notes: When Multicast, Unrefined Fireblast hits the same target each time with a %multicast_delay% seconds interval.

ogre_magi_ignite.desc: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.
notes: Multicast makes this spell have a chance to cast multiple times at random enemy units in a %ignite_multicast_aoe% area of effect.
Ignite hitting an already affected unit adds to the burn duration.

ogre_magi_bloodlust.desc: Incites a frenzy in a friendly unit, increasing its movement speed and attack speed. Gives bonus attack speed if cast on Ogre himself. Can be cast on towers.
notes: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an %multicast_bloodlust_aoe% area of effect to receive Bloodlust.

ogre_magi_multicast.desc: Enables Ogre Magi to cast his abilities and items multiple times with each use. Each point of Strength adds to Multicast chance. Every %strength_for_one_pct% Strength adds %one_tooltip%%%.
notes: Only targeted abilities and items have a chance to be multicast.
Targeted abilities and items apply to additional enemies and neutrals in an AoE around Ogre. Fireblast and Unrefined Fireblast hit the same target multiple times.

ogre_magi_frost_armor.desc: The Ogre Frostmage summons an invisible layer of icy air that surrounds the target friendly unit, increasing its armor and temporarily slowing any enemies that dare attack it.

omniknight_hammer_of_purity.desc:
Omniknight imbues his hammer with holy power, causing his attack to have increased range, deal pure damage based on a percentage of his base damage and slow his target for a short duration.

Omniknight heals for %heal_pct%%% of the damage dealt over %heal_duration%s.
notes: When attacking non-hero targets, amount healed is decreased by the standard creep lifesteal factor.

omniknight_purification.desc: Instantly heals a friendly unit and damages all nearby enemy units.
omniknight_purification.shard: After a %recast_delay%s delay, the target is Purified again with %recast_effectiveness_pct%%% effectiveness.

omniknight_degen_aura.desc: Degenerates the movement capabilities of enemy units that stray too near, slowing their movement speed.
notes: Does not affect Debuff Immune units.

omniknight_healing_hammer.desc: Ability damage done to enemies by Omniknight heals him over time.

omniknight_martyr.desc: Grants Debuff Immunity with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance, as well as bonus HP Regen.

omniknight_guardian_angel.desc: Omniknight calls upon a Guardian Angel that grants immunity from physical damage to all allied units near Omniknight.
omniknight_guardian_angel.scepter: Guardian Angel has global radius, affects buildings, and amplifies health restoration.

oracle_fortunes_end.desc:
CHANNELED - Gathers Oracle's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and dispels enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only dispel debuffs. The root duration increases with channeling time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Affects invulnerable units.

oracle_fates_edict.desc: Oracle enraptures a target, disarming them and granting them %magic_damage_resistance_pct_tooltip%%% magic damage resistance.

oracle_purifying_flames.desc: Burns away impurities, dealing heavy magic damage to the target before causing them to regenerate health over time. The amount of health regenerated over its duration exceeds the amount of initial damage. Can be cast on enemies and allies.
notes: The healing from Purifying Flames can be stacked with itself.
The damage from Purifying Flames cannot be lethal to allies.

oracle_false_promise.desc:
Temporarily alters an ally's destiny, delaying any healing or damage taken until False Promise ends. Any healing that is delayed by False Promise is amplified. Removes most negative status effects and disables on initial cast.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: Delayed damage and healing will take armor and magic resistance reductions into account when received.
The delayed damage and healing takes effect as soon as the target becomes vulnerable.

oracle_rain_of_destiny.desc: Brings forth rain to the target area. Enemies standing in the area receive damage and have reduced Heal Amplification. Allies in the area heal and have increased incoming Heal Amplification.

oracle_diviners_deck.desc:
Oracle pulls a random Tarot Card now and every %duration% seconds to receives its buff for %duration% seconds. Oracle always knows the next Tarot Card.

Death: %spell_amplification%%% Spell Amplification
The Fool: %gold_bonus_pct%%% Increased Gold Gain
The World: %int_bonus_pct%%% Increased Intelligence
The Lovers: %heal_amplification%%% Heal Amplification
The Tower: %barrier_amount% All Damage Barrier (regenerates after not taking damage for %barrier_restore_time%s)

oracle_clairvoyant_curse.desc: Spell amplification increased by %spell_amplification%%% per hero level.

oracle_clairvoyant_cure.desc: Heal amplification increased by %heal_amplification%%% per hero level.

oracle_prognosticate.desc: Oracle will predict and announce to allies, where the next power rune will spawn (top or bottom) as well as Roshan's exact respawn time.

pangolier_swashbuckle.desc:
Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes. Attacks have decreased Item Potency.

Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
notes: Casting Swashbuckle during Rolling Thunder ends Rolling Thunder.

pangolier_shield_crash.desc:
Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.

Forward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.
pangolier_shield_crash.scepter: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals %scepter_damage_outgoing_tooltip%%% damage.

pangolier_lucky_shot.desc: Pangolier rolls the dice and lets fate decide the outcome for his enemies. Grants a chance to drastically slow their attack speed and reduce armor on any damage dealt by Pangolier's attacks or abilities.

pangolier_gyroshell.desc:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
It takes Pangolier %move_speed_ramp_up_time%s to reach full roll speed.

pangolier_fortune_favors_the_bold.desc: Random item and ability effects of enemies near Pangolier have a reduced chance to affect him.
notes: Applies to hero abilities and items.
Effect is a relative reduction in chance for effects to happen.

pangolier_rollup.desc: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.

phantom_assassin_fan_of_knives.desc: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.

phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger.desc: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing %base_damage%+%attack_factor_tooltip%%% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.
notes: If an attack effect is chance-based, the chance of its application will be the same as its chance to occur.
Spell-immune enemies are not affected by Stifling Dagger's slow.
Stifling Dagger grants vision around its location while it travels and upon impact.

phantom_assassin_phantom_strike.desc: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.

phantom_assassin_immaterial.desc:
Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks.

Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

phantom_assassin_blur.desc: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.
phantom_assassin_blur.shard: Decreases Cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. Any time Phantom Assassin gets a hero kill, her ability cooldowns advance %cooldown_refund_pct%%% of their max cooldown values.
notes: Attacking Roshan with a regular attack will dispel Blur.

phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace.desc: Phantom Assassin refines her combat abilities, acquiring a chance of gaining Deadly Focus with each attack. When attacking with Deadly Focus, Phantom Assassin will consume the buff and guarantee a critical hit. Stifling Dagger has a bonus chance to cause Deadly Focus.

phantom_lancer_spirit_lance.desc: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
phantom_lancer_spirit_lance.scepter: Spirit Lance bounces once on enemies, prioritizing Heroes. Increases Spirit Lance illusion damage.
notes: Illusions within %fake_lance_distance% range of Phantom Lancer will mimic the cast animation.

phantom_lancer_doppelwalk.desc:
Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After %delay% second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes %illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%% bonus damage and deals %illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%% less damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
Phantom Lancer and his allies can see which illusion is the 100% damage illusion.

phantom_lancer_juxtapose.desc: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for %illusion_duration% seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last %illusion_from_illusion_duration% seconds.
phantom_lancer_juxtapose.shard: Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to %invis_duration% seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by %invis_movespeed%%% during this invisibility.

phantom_lancer_phantom_edge.desc: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
phantom_lancer_phantom_edge.scepter: Increases Range. Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them. Additionally, every %illusion_spawn_travel_distance% units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.
notes: If the attack order is cancelled, the movement speed bonus is lost.
Rush movement speed is %bonus_speed%.

phantom_lancer_illusory_armaments.desc: Whenever an illusion of Phantom Lancer is created, its outgoing damage cannot go below a fixed value for %duration% seconds.

phoenix_icarus_dive.desc: Phoenix dives forward in an arc with a fixed distance in the targeted direction, dealing damage over time and slowing the movement speed of any units it comes into contact with, and then orbiting back to its original position. If Phoenix casts Supernova, the dive ends.
notes: Icarus Dive has a %dive_duration% second travel duration, and can be cancelled by casting the ability again while in flight.

phoenix_fire_spirits.desc: Summons 4 fire spirits that circle around Phoenix. Each spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
phoenix_fire_spirits.shard: Causes Fire Spirits to become a passive charge-based ability. Has 7 second replenish time.
notes: Fire Spirits reveal the area they strike for 1 second.

phoenix_sun_ray.desc: Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their max health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire.
phoenix_sun_ray.shard: Allows Sun Ray to be cast during Supernova.
notes: Sun Ray has a width of %radius% units, and a length of %abilitycastrange% units.
Sun Ray is canceled if Phoenix gets stunned, silenced, cycloned, hexed or slept.
Phoenix can use items and abilities without canceling Sun Ray.

phoenix_sun_ray_toggle_move.desc: Toggles slow forward movement during Sun Ray firing.
notes: Sun Ray allows Phoenix to move over cliffs and trees.

phoenix_supernova.desc:
The Phoenix willingly ends its current life for the chance to be reborn. Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area. The sun has pip health. Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to the sun. After %abilityduration% seconds the sun explodes, stunning all nearby enemies while restoring Phoenix to full health and mana with refreshed abilities.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
phoenix_supernova.scepter: Increases Supernova's pip health and allows Phoenix to cast Supernova on an allied hero, bringing both into the sun to be reborn together.

phoenix_launch_fire_spirit.desc: Each fire spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
notes: Fire Spirits reveal the area they strike for 1 second.

phoenix_dying_light.desc: Phoenix deals %damage_pct%%% of its missing health as magic damage to all enemies in a %radius% radius every second.
notes: Dying Light deals damage while Phoenix is transformed during Supernova.

phoenix_blinding_sun.desc: Phoenix ability debuffs apply a stackable %blind_per_second%%% Miss chance per second. Lasts %blind_duration% seconds.

primal_beast_onslaught.desc:
Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him. 

 Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.

primal_beast_onslaught_release.desc: Begins the rush to the specified location.

primal_beast_trample.desc: Primal Beast stomps over everything. For every %step_distance% units traveled, all enemies around the Beast receive damage. Deals base damage plus a multiplier of Primal Beast's attack damage. Primal Beast is disarmed for the duration of the ability.

primal_beast_uproar.desc:
The Beast's temper causes every instance of %damage_limit% hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.  

 When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for %roar_duration% seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
primal_beast_uproar.scepter: When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases %projectile_waves% waves of %projectiles_per_stack% projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.
notes: Primal Beast cannot gain Uproar stacks from self damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.

primal_beast_pulverize.desc: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts %channel_time% seconds.

primal_beast_rock_throw.desc:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns enemies and deals %base_damage% + %damage_str_pct%%% STR damage. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.

primal_beast_colossal.desc: Primal Beast has %base_slow_resist%%% base Slow Resistance and gains %aoe_per_threshold%%% bonus Area of Effect and %slow_resistance_per_threshold%%% Slow Resistance for every %hp_per_threshold% Max Health.

puck_illusory_orb.desc:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed. At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.

Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
notes: The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.

puck_ethereal_jaunt.desc: Teleports Puck to a flying Illusory Orb.

puck_puckish.desc: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores %mana_and_health_restore_pct%%% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores %dodged_spell_multiplier%x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.

puck_waning_rift.desc: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.

puck_phase_shift.desc: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
puck_phase_shift.shard: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.
notes: Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.

puck_dream_coil.desc: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
puck_dream_coil.scepter: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to %attack_rate_pct%%% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.

pudge_flesh_heap.desc: Pudge covers himself with a layer of flesh that blocks damage of any type taken from any source.

pudge_meat_hook.desc: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
pudge_meat_hook.shard: Increases range. When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.
notes: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
Meat Hook hits invisible units.
Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.

pudge_rot.desc: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.
pudge_rot.scepter: Increases Rot radius by %bonus_rot_radius%, damage by %bonus_rot_damage%, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by %scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%.
notes: Using Rot doesn't interrupt channeling.
Rot hits invisible units.
If Pudge is silenced, he can't deactivate Rot if it's activated.
Rot self-damage is non-lethal.

pudge_eject.desc: Ejects the swallowed allied hero inside of you.

pudge_dismember.desc: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of %pull_units_per_second% units, up to a minimum of %pull_distance_limit% range.
notes: If a unit becomes invisible while Dismembered, it will still be under the effects of Dismember.

pudge_innate_graft_flesh.desc: Pudge's skin thickens permanently every time he kills an enemy Hero, gaining %flesh_heap_strength_buff_amount% bonus Strength for each stack.
notes: Enemy Heroes that die within %flesh_heap_range% of Pudge grant a stack regardless of its killer.

pugna_nether_blast.desc: An exploding pulse deals damage to enemies and structures in the area.  Deals %structure_damage_mod%%% damage to structures.
notes: Damage is delayed by %delay% seconds.

pugna_decrepify.desc: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Healing received and dealt by affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
notes: Only magical and pure damage can affect a unit under the effects of Decrepify.
Doesn't slow allied units.
Can be used on your Nether Ward.

pugna_nether_ward.desc: Pugna places a Nether Ward at the target location. The ward will fire at any enemy hero who casts a spell dealing base damage plus the damage multiplier of the mana spent by the enemy hero. Only one Nether Ward can be active at a time; casting a new one destroys the previous ward.
notes: Nether Ward deals damage before the actual spell is cast, so if the caster dies the spell will have no effect.
Nether Ward can be decrepified.
Illusions and creeps deal 25% damage to Nether Ward.

pugna_life_drain.desc:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit, healing himself for the damage dealt and granting vision over the target.

When cast on an ally, Pugna heals his ally and takes magical damage equal to the amount healed. This damage cannot kill Pugna.
pugna_life_drain.shard: Life Drain can target your Nether Ward, causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within %abilitycastrange% units of the ward for %shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%% of its normal value. The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.

pugna_oblivion_savant.desc:
Pugna can cast spells and use items while channeling.

Pugna receives %tower_scale%%% spell amplification per destroyed tower.
pugna_oblivion_savant.scepter: Gains %AbilityCharges% charges with a %AbilityChargeRestoreTime% restore time. Pugna can cast any of his abilities an additional time, consuming an Oblivion Savant charge instead.

queenofpain_shadow_strike.desc: Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for %duration% seconds.  An instance of damage is dealt every %damage_interval% seconds.
queenofpain_shadow_strike.scepter: Causes Shadow Strike to become a %aoe_radius% AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.
notes: The affected unit slowly regains its original movement speed every second during the duration.
Units afflicted by Shadow Strike can be denied by their allies when their HP drops below 25% of their maximum health.

queenofpain_blink.desc: Short distance teleportation that allows Queen of Pain to move in and out of combat.
queenofpain_blink.shard: Releases a sonic boom when Queen of Pain blinks, at both her starting and ending locations. Deals %shard_damage% damage in a %shard_aoe% AoE and silences the target for %shard_duration% seconds.
notes: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.

queenofpain_scream_of_pain.desc:
The Queen of Pain lets loose a piercing scream around her, damaging nearby enemies.

%damage_reflected_to_self%%% of the damage dealt to heroes is reflected back to her.
notes: Scream Of Pain will hit invisible units.
Scream Of Pain cannot be disjointed.
Damage to illusions is not reflected. Damage reflected is before reduction and non-lethal.
Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

queenofpain_sonic_wave.desc: Creates a gigantic wave of sound in front of Queen of Pain, dealing heavy damage to all enemy units in its wake and pushing them back.
notes: Sonic Wave can hit units up to 1150 units away.

queenofpain_masochist.desc: Queen of Pain has bonus Spell Amplification but a percentage of her spell damage is reflected back to her.
notes: Damage to illusions is not reflected.
Damage reflected is before reduction.
Damage reflected is non-lethal.
Includes Spell damage from items.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

queenofpain_succubus.desc: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is %close_radius% units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is %max_radius% units or further from her.

queenofpain_bondage.desc: Whenever an enemy within %radius% range deals spell damage to Queen of Pain, she returns %spell_reflect_pct%%% of the damage dealt.

rattletrap_jetpack.desc: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.

rattletrap_overclocking.desc:
Supercharges Clockwerk's abilities:

Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.
Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.
Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.
Jetpack: Moves faster.

Clockwerk's movement and attack speed become slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.

rattletrap_battery_assault.desc: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
notes: Remains active if Clockwerk is disabled.

rattletrap_power_cogs.desc:
Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by %mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%% of the mana burned.

Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to %projectile_distance% distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.
notes: Cogs can shock invisible units.

rattletrap_rocket_flare.desc: Fires a global range flare that explodes over a given area. Upon impact, enemies in the area take damage and are briefly slowed. Rocket flare provides vision over the impact area for %duration% seconds.

rattletrap_hookshot.desc: Fires a grappling device rapidly at the target location.  If the hook hits a unit, Clockwerk launches himself into the target, stunning and dealing damage to everyone in a %stun_radius% radius around the hit target. Any enemies Clockwerk collides with along the way are damaged and stunned.
notes: Hookshot will latch and take Clockwerk to allies, but not damage or disable them.

rattletrap_armor_power.desc:
Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by %damage_per_armor%%% per point of armor.

Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +%armor_per_chainmail% armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
notes: Exact Armor Power bonus is 0.55845%.

razor_plasma_field.desc: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.

razor_static_link.desc: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows Razor to attack while moving with the link active.
razor_static_link.shard: Increases Cast Range. Slows Razor's target by %move_speed_factor%x the amount of damage stolen while the link is active.
notes: The link is broken when either unit dies or the distance between them becomes %drain_range_buffer% units greater than Static Link's cast range.

razor_storm_surge.desc: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
razor_storm_surge.shard: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is %eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by %strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.
notes: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

razor_eye_of_the_storm.desc: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at the enemy unit with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing armor.
razor_eye_of_the_storm.scepter: Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.
notes: Each blast targets the lowest health enemy unit within range.
Eye of the Storm will prioritize striking static linked heroes.
Successive casts of Eye of the Storm will stack.

razor_dynamo.desc: Razor gains %spell_amp_mult%%% spell amplification for every %spell_amp_damage_divisor% points of attack damage.

riki_smoke_screen.desc: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
riki_smoke_screen.shard: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by %armor_reduction% and cannot be targeted by their allies.
notes: Can be cast during Tricks of the Trade.
Doesn't prevent the use of active items.

riki_blink_strike.desc: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by %slow_pct_tooltip%%% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.
notes: You can Blink Strike to allies, but no damage is dealt.

riki_backstab.desc: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.

riki_innate_backstab.desc: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility and his attack has increased Item Potency.
notes: Works when denying friendly units at %ally_multiplier%%% effectiveness.
Illusions of Riki will play Backstab animations, but not deal any bonus damage.

riki_tricks_of_the_trade.desc: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes %interval_targets% random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.
riki_tricks_of_the_trade.scepter: Increases Cast Range to %AbilityCastRange%. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have %scepter_movespeed%%% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts %scepter_bonus_duration%s longer and does an additional %scepter_bonus_attacks% attacks.
notes: Backstab damage is applied to all units hit.
