ringmaster_spotlight.desc: Ringmaster shines %spotlight_count% spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds after leaving the light.

ringmaster_tame_the_beasts.desc: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to %abilitychanneltime% second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.

ringmaster_the_box.desc: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.
ringmaster_the_box.scepter: Escape Act has %max_charges% charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.

ringmaster_wheel.desc:
Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by %aura_slow%%%.

Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than %face_duration% seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after %trap_duration% seconds.

ringmaster_impalement.desc: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.

ringmaster_empty_souvenir.desc: Gather souvenirs from kills and assists.

ringmaster_dark_carnival_souvenirs.desc:
Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within %souvenir_collection_range% units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.

If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.

ringmaster_funhouse_mirror.desc:
Use: Proportion Distortion

Creates %images_count% imperfect image of your hero that lasts %illusion_duration% seconds. Your illusion deals %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%% and takes %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.
notes: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.

ringmaster_whoopee_cushion.desc:
Use: Whoopsie

Propels your hero forward %leap_distance% units. Leaves a %fart_cloud_radius% radius stink cloud behind for %fart_cloud_duration% seconds that slows enemies by %fart_cloud_slow%%%.

ringmaster_strongman_tonic.desc:
Use: Forcefully Imbibe

Temporarily increases an allied hero's Strength by %strength_bonus_base% plus %strength_bonus_per_level% per Ringmaster's level for %duration% seconds. The effect holds for %effect_strength_max_duration% seconds and then deteriorates over the duration.

ringmaster_summon_unicycle.desc:
Use: Saddle Up

Summons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for %mount_duration% seconds. %damage_grace_period%s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than %damage_threshold% dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.

ringmaster_weighted_pie.desc:
Use: Toss Pie

Knocks enemies back, slows them by %max_slow_pct%%% and reduces their vision to %vision_radius% recovering over %blind_duration% seconds, and prevents them from receiving vision from their allies for the duration. Instantly kills any non-ancient creep.

ringmaster_crystal_ball.desc:
Use: Clairvoyance

Scans a targeted %radius% area with global range for %duration% seconds. Indicates whether there are enemy heroes in that area for the duration. Reveals invisible units and wards in the scanned area, but does not provide vision. The reveal effect lingers for %truesight_linger_duration% second.

rubick_telekinesis.desc: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.
rubick_telekinesis.shard: Allows you to target yourself or allies with Telekinesis. Throw distance is increased to %max_land_distance% and throw delay is reduced to %shard_teammate_throw_delay% seconds.
notes: While the target is in the air, Rubick may use a secondary ability to throw the enemy in a targeted direction.
When the unit lands, it isn't affected by the area of effect stun.

rubick_telekinesis_land.desc: Chooses the location the target will land when Telekinesis finishes.

rubick_telekinesis_land_self.desc: Chooses the location you will land when Telekinesis finishes.

rubick_fade_bolt.desc: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage. Each jump deals less damage.

rubick_arcane_supremacy.desc: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and bonus spell amplification.

rubick_might_and_magus.desc: Rubick gains stacking bonus area of effect when he casts a spell.

rubick_curiosity.desc:
Rubick gains %curiosity_per_level% stack of Curiosity per level that grants him %curiosity_attack_damage% base damage, %curiosity_modifier_amp%%% Buff/Debuff Duration, and %curiosity_aoe_bonus% AOE Bonus.

If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within %charge_radius% distance of him, he gains %curiosity_per_spell_cast% Curiosity for %curiosity_duration% seconds. If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last %grace_period% seconds, he gains %curiosity_per_kill% Curiosity permanently.

rubick_spell_steal.desc: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
rubick_spell_steal.scepter: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.
rubick_spell_steal.shard: Upgrades stolen spells to their Shard version.
notes: Cannot steal item abilities.
Rubick will steal the Aghanim's Shard version of the ability, if he himself has an Aghanim's Shard.
Does not trigger spell reflect.

rubick_empty1.desc: Spells acquired with Spell Steal will replace this slot.

rubick_empty2.desc: Spells acquired with Spell Steal will replace this slot.

sandking_burrowstrike.desc:
Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit

Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
sandking_burrowstrike.scepter: Increases Cast Range. Sand King leaves behind a trail of spines, that, after a %spine_duration%s delay, create Stinger attack areas along the path, that apply %spine_damage_pct%%% of Stinger damage to enemies hit.
notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

sandking_sand_storm.desc: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.
notes: Sand Storm can be used to dodge projectiles.
Sand King briefly becomes visible upon attacking or using spells while in Sand Storm. Sand King will become invisible again in %fade_delay% seconds.

sandking_caustic_finale.desc: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.

sandking_epicenter.desc: After a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.
sandking_epicenter.scepter: When the pulses start, %scepter_explosions_per_pulse% Stinger attack areas are created every %spine_tick_rate%s at random locations, each measuring %scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply %spine_damage_pct%%% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause %shard_explosions_per_pulse% attack(s).
sandking_epicenter.shard: Every %shard_interval%s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.
notes: The pulses are centered on Sand King, not where he first cast the spell.

sandking_scorpion_strike.desc: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Attacks have decreased Item Potency. Enemies within an innermost radius of %inner_radius% take %inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.
sandking_scorpion_strike.shard: A Caustic Finale explosion that deals %caustic_damage_pct%%% damage is created around every enemy hero hit in Stinger's innermost radius. Does not apply to strikes created by Aghanim's Scepter upgrade.

shadow_demon_disruption.desc: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration.  Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit with bonus base damage are created under Shadow Demon's control.

shadow_demon_shadow_servant.desc:
Shadow Demon and his illusions' attacks reduce the current health of the target by %health_lost%%% per stack. When the effect expires, the target regains %health_regain_pct%%% of the lost health.

If an enemy Hero dies under this effect, Shadow Demon creates an illusion of them that lasts until the Hero respawns or Shadow Demon dies.
notes: Heroes killed by Shadow Demon spawn an illusion regardless of distance.
The illusion disappears when the enemy hero respawns or Shadow Demon dies.

shadow_demon_shadow_poison.desc: Deals damage in a line, and afflicts enemy units with a poison effect. The poison deals 1/2/4/8/16 times the stack damage based on the number of stacks on the target, up to %max_multiply_stacks% stacks. Additional stacks cause %bonus_stack_damage% damage each.  This deferred damage is dealt when Shadow Poison's duration is expired, or the Release sub-ability is used.
notes: Shadow Poison can affect units under Disruption.

shadow_demon_shadow_poison_release.desc: Releases the poison to do damage on all affected enemies. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Shadow Poison.

shadow_demon_demonic_purge.desc:
Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration.  The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt.  Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
shadow_demon_demonic_purge.scepter: Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain %max_charges% charges.
notes: The slow starts at %max_slow%%% and decreases over time to %min_slow%%%.
Positive buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Purge.

shadow_demon_demonic_cleanse.desc:
Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration. At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Negative buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Cleanse.

shadow_demon_disseminate.desc: Whenever the target takes damage, all enemies, including the target itself if it is an enemy, within %radius% range of the target also receive a portion of that damage. Can target enemy and allied units. Effect is paused if the target is hidden by Disruption.
notes: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

shadow_demon_menace.desc: Shadow Demon's Attacks apply a stacking debuff to the enemy for %duration% seconds that increases their damage taken.
notes: Break disables the application of new stacks.
Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.

shadow_shaman_ether_shock.desc: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.
notes: Can hit secondary targets up to 1000 distance away.

shadow_shaman_voodoo.desc: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
notes: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

shadow_shaman_shackles.desc: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.
shadow_shaman_shackles.scepter: Increase cast range. Every %scepter_shock_interval% seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within %scepter_shock_radius% of the target for %scepter_shock_pct%%% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within %ally_break_range% units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.

shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward.desc: Summons %ward_count% Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to the Serpent Ward.
shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward.shard: Allows to create a Mega Ward using the Urnaconda ability.

shadow_shaman_fowl_play.desc:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
shadow_shaman_fowl_play.shard: Increases the amount of time incoming damage is reduced to %damage_reduction_duration% seconds. When Fowl Play is triggered, Shadow Shaman becomes invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds. %chicken_illusions% additional uncontrollable chickens are created that last for %ally_voodoo_duration% seconds. While Shadow Shaman is transformed, he can now use items.
notes: Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.

shadow_shaman_voodoo_hands.desc: Your next attack on an enemy hero transforms them into a chicken for %voodoo_duration%s.
notes: Talents that affect Hex also affects enemies transformed by Chicken Fingers.

shadow_shaman_urnaconda.desc: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has %megaward_multiplier_tooltip%x the base Serpent Ward damage and pip health there that lasts %ward_duration%s.

shredder_flamethrower.desc: Releases a flame in the direction Timbersaw is facing. Applies a debuff that deals damage per second and slows enemy movement speed. Affects buildings for reduced damage.

shredder_whirling_death.desc: Timbersaw whirls extremely sharp edges, damaging enemies and destroying trees around him in an area. If an enemy hero is affected, it loses some of its primary attribute for a short duration. Whirling Death will deal bonus damage per tree destroyed.

shredder_timber_chain.desc: Timbersaw fires a chain that embeds itself in the first tree it hits, pulling him towards it.  Any enemy in the path takes damage.

shredder_reactive_armor.desc: Each time Timbersaw is attacked, he gains increased health regen and armor. Hero attacks are counted as %stacks_per_hero_attack%x the amount.
shredder_reactive_armor.scepter: Reactive Armor can now be activated to get max stacks and %initial_shield% damage barrier. Grants Timbersaw %shield_per_sec% + %shield_per_sec_per_enemy% barrier amount per second for each enemy hero within %radius% radius of Timbersaw up to a maximum of %max_shield%. After %duration% seconds, Timbersaw deals damage to every hero within %explosion_radius% radius equal to %base_explosion% + his remaining barrier amount and loses all of his barrier.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

shredder_chakram.desc: Fires Timbersaw's main saw blade at the target location where it will spin in place, dealing damage in an area around it.  Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every %slow_health_percentage%%% of health missing. The blade deals damage and cuts down trees in its path when fired and retracted.  While active the ability costs mana, and Timbersaw loses the ability to attack.
notes: The Chakram will return if Timbersaw runs out of mana or moves over %break_distance% distance away.

shredder_twisted_chakram.desc: Launches a second independent Chakram that follows a curved path and returns to Timbersaw, damaging and slowing enemies it passes through. Enemies caught in the saw blade will move more slowly for every %slow_health_percentage%%% of health missing.

shredder_exposure_therapy.desc: Whenever Timbersaw destroys a tree, he gains mana.

silencer_curse_of_the_silent.desc:
Curses the target area, dealing damage and causing enemies to take damage over time and slowing their movement speed.

Anytime affected enemies cast a spell, the duration is increased. The duration is paused as long as the target is silenced.
notes: Affects creeps.

silencer_glaives_of_wisdom.desc: Silencer enchants his glaives with his wisdom, stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.
silencer_glaives_of_wisdom.shard: Causes Glaives of Wisdom to bounce %bounce_count% time to a random enemy within %bounce_range% range and increases intelligence steal.

silencer_last_word.desc: Enchants a target, providing vision of them and causing them to be damaged and silenced if they cast a spell or if the enchantment timer expires. Deals extra damage based on the difference in intelligence between Silencer and the target.
notes: Channeling abilities will trigger this effect once the caster finishes its channel.

silencer_global_silence.desc: Silencer stops all sound, preventing enemy heroes and units on the map from casting spells.
silencer_global_silence.scepter: Global Silence applies Arcane Curse to heroes for the duration of Global Silence.
notes: This skill works on invisible and Debuff Immune units, but gaining debuff immunity will remove its effect.
Multiple Arcane Curses from Aghanim's Scepter Global Silence do not stack.

silencer_brain_drain.desc:
Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

If an enemy Hero dies within %permanent_int_steal_range% range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals %permanent_int_steal_amount% Intelligence from them. If the victim was silenced, steal an extra %silenced_bonus_int_steal_amount% Intelligence.
silencer_brain_drain.shard: Increases the Intelligence stolen per kill.
notes: Intelligence Steal is not disabled by Break.

silencer_oppressive_silence.desc: Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

skeleton_king_hellfire_blast.desc: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.

skeleton_king_bone_guard.desc: Gains a Charge for every 2 creeps killed and 2 charges per hero killed. Activate to spend all charges, summoning skeletons that respawn once when killed. Skeletons benefit from Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Casting Wraithfire Blast on an enemy causes the skeletons to attack that enemy.

skeleton_king_spectral_blade.desc: Curses units that Wraith King attacks, dealing a flat amount of damage and a percentage of the attack damage again after a delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage and a unit cannot be cursed again for a short period of time.

skeleton_king_mortal_strike.desc: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.
skeleton_king_mortal_strike.shard: Mortal Strike hits curse their target, causing them to take %curse_damage_pct%%% of the initial attack damage again as <font color="#d8ae53">Pure</font> damage after a %curse_delay% second delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage.

skeleton_king_reincarnation.desc: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle.  Upon death, enemy units in a %slow_radius% radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.
notes: Wraith King won't revive if he doesn't have enough mana.
If Wraith King has an Aegis and Reincarnation off cooldown, Reincarnation will trigger first.
Revives with full HP and Mana.

skeleton_king_vampiric_spirit.desc: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.
skeleton_king_vampiric_spirit.scepter: Turns Vampiric Spirit into an aura, allowing allied heroes to turn into wraiths when slain. Extends wraith duration.
notes: Credit for allies whose death was delayed will go to whoever struck the original killing blow.
Does not affect Reincarnate deaths.
Break only disables the passive lifesteal component.
Respawn timer is reduced by Wraith duration.

skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.desc: Skywrath Mage launches a slow-moving bolt of arcane magic, dealing damage to an enemy unit based on Skywrath Mage's intelligence.
skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt.shard: When Skywrath Mage casts Arcane Bolt, %total_bolt_count% bolts are created, one aimed at the original target, and two others aimed at random enemies within %extra_bolt_search_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.
notes: The projectile moves very slowly (500 ms), providing 325 vision around it.  Upon impact, it will reveal the target area for 3.34 seconds.
Arcane Bolt cannot be disjointed.

skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.desc: Skywrath Mage sets off a long range shot that hits the closest hero within a long range.  Upon impact, it deals damage and slows in an area of effect.
skywrath_mage_concussive_shot.scepter: When Skywrath Mage casts Concussive Shot, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be hit with the same ability. Heroes will take priority.
notes: If no enemy heroes are in range or they are in fog, Concussive Shot targets the nearest enemy creep.
Damages creeps around the impact area.
Provides 400 vision around the projectile, and reveals the target area for 3.34 seconds upon impact.

skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.desc: Skywrath Mage seals the targeted unit with an ancient rune, silencing it and causing it to take additional damage from spells.
skywrath_mage_ancient_seal.scepter: Anytime Skywrath Mage casts Ancient Seal, a different random target within %scepter_radius% range of the original target will be affected by the same ability. Heroes will take priority.
notes: The magic damage resistance reduction doesn't affect creeps.

skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.desc: Skywrath Mage uses his ultimate magical ability to conjure a precise and violent mystical field that lays waste to his adversaries. Deals massive damage distributed evenly among any Heroes in the area over %duration% seconds.
skywrath_mage_mystic_flare.scepter: When Skywrath Mage casts Mystic Flare, another Mystic Flare will be created on the position of a different random target enemy within %scepter_radius% range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.
notes: Mystic Flare only affects Heroes. Mystic Flare does not damage creep heroes.
Mystic Flare will damage enemy creeps if no enemy heroes are present.
Mystic Flare will immediately destroy illusions.

skywrath_mage_shield_of_the_scion.desc: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magical damage to an enemy hero with his abilities, he gains bonus intelligence and a small magic damage barrier. Each buff stacks independently.

skywrath_mage_staff_of_the_scion.desc: Every time Skywrath Mage deals magic damage to an enemy hero with an ability, he reduces all his ability cooldowns by %cooldown_reduction%s.

slardar_seaborn_sentinel.desc: Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration, attack damage, and armor while in a puddle, trail, or river.
slardar_seaborn_sentinel.scepter: Provides additional HP Regen, Armor and Status Resistance while in a puddle, trail, or river. Increases puddle/trail radius by %scepter_puddle_radius_tooltip%%% and puddle/trail duration by %scepter_puddle_duration_increase_tooltip%s.

slardar_sprint.desc: Slardar slithers ahead, moving significantly faster and passing through units. Slardar has %slow_resistance_tooltip%%% slow resistance for the first %speed_burst_max_duration%s. The slow resistance gradually fades over the remaining sprint duration.
notes: Activating this skill doesn't interrupt channeling abilities.

slardar_slithereen_crush.desc: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.  After the stun, the affected units are slowed.
slardar_slithereen_crush.scepter: Increases Slithereen Crush puddle radius and duration.
slardar_slithereen_crush.shard: Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.

slardar_bash.desc: After %attack_count% attacks, your next attack will bash the target.
notes: Does not stack with Skull Basher.

slardar_amplify_damage.desc: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.

slark_depth_shroud.desc: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.

slark_dark_pact.desc:
After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself.  Slark only takes %self_damage_pct%%% of the damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: %delay% seconds after cast, a series of %total_pulses% pulses separated by %pulse_interval% seconds deal the damage.
Each pulse also removes debuffs from Slark.
You can't kill yourself with this skill.
The pulses stop if Slark dies.

slark_pounce.desc: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
notes: On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of %pounce_speed%, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled %pounce_distance% distance.
Debuff Immune units cannot be leashed.
Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.

slark_essence_shift.desc: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining %stat_loss% of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus %agi_gain% Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals %stat_loss% Agility.
notes: Attributes cannot be dropped below 1.
Essence Shifted stats are returned to normal on death. The stat return for Slark and for the affected hero are separate.
To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within Slark's Steal Radius while having the Essence Shift debuff.
Break disables the gaining of temporary stacks. Does not disable the gaining of permanent stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses of existing stacks.

slark_shadow_dance.desc:
When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration. If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for %neutral_disable% seconds.

When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.

slark_saltwater_shiv.desc:
Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.

These effects stack independently.

snapfire_scatterblast.desc: Snapfire unloads with a wide blast that damages and slows enemies in a cone. Damage is increased by %point_blank_dmg_bonus_pct%%% and Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by %point_blank_debuff_duration_pct%%% for enemies caught at point-blank range.

snapfire_mortimer_kisses.desc: Snapfire's friend launches a barrage of firespit globs over %duration_tooltip% seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. Snapfire has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of %min_range%. Each glob can be targeted with a right click.
notes: Can be cancelled by pressing Stop, Hold Position, or using another ability.
Has a minimum travel time of %min_lob_travel_time% and maximum travel time of %max_lob_travel_time%.

snapfire_gobble_up.desc: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to %max_time_in_belly% seconds.
notes: Snapfire earns the creep's bounty after it has been spat out and died.

snapfire_spit_creep.desc: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.

snapfire_firesnap_cookie.desc: Snapfire feeds a potent cookie to Mortimer or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
snapfire_firesnap_cookie.shard: Firesnap cookies become even more potent, healing the target and launching a Mortimer Kiss that does %shard_damage_multiplier_tooltip%%% impact damage to the landing destination.
notes: The cookie projectile has a speed of %projectile_speed%.

snapfire_buckshot.desc: When attacking enemy heroes, Snapfire deals %damage_amp%%% more damage with her auto attacks, but has a %miss_chance%%% chance of a glancing shot, dealing %glancing_shot_damage_pct%%% damage.
notes: Ricochet II attacks cannot miss.

snapfire_lil_shredder.desc: Snapfire heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire %buffed_attacks% attacks dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of her attack damage. Each attack reduces the enemy's armor. Provides bonus attack range for the duration.
notes: Sets base attack time to %base_attack_time%s for the duration.
Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on Lil' Shredder attacks.

snapfire_boomstick.desc: Snapfire deals more damage to nearby enemies.

sniper_concussive_grenade.desc: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.
sniper_concussive_grenade.shard: Reduces cooldown, increases damage, and allows the knockback to affect Sniper as well.

sniper_shrapnel.desc: Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement. Reveals the targeted area. Shrapnel charges restore every %abilitychargerestoretime% seconds.
notes: Damage is dealt 11 times, immediately at spell effect then every second.
Does not damage buildings.
Provides vision in the targeted area.

sniper_headshot.desc: Sniper increases his accuracy, giving him a chance to deal %damage% extra damage and knock back his enemies. Knockback distance increases based on how close the enemy is to Sniper. Headshots briefly slow enemy movement and attack speed by %slow%%%.

sniper_take_aim.desc:
Passively increases Sniper's attack range by %passive_attack_range_bonus%.

On cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range. Slows you by %slow%%% for the duration and restricts your vision to a frontal cone.

sniper_assassinate.desc: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage with bonus Item Potency and bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
sniper_assassinate.scepter: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.
notes: Crosshair effect is only visible to allies.
Invisibility doesn't disjoint the projectile.

sniper_keen_scope.desc: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every %bonus_damage_distance% units of distance Sniper is from the target.

spectre_spectral_dagger.desc: Spectre flings a dagger to draw a Shadow Path, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail. Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path. While treading the path, Spectre moves faster and phases through otherwise impassable terrain.
notes: There is a %dagger_grace_period% second grace period after leaving the path where no collision is preserved.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

spectre_desolate.desc: Spectre and her illusions deal bonus Pure damage if attacking an enemy that does not have any allied units within a %radius% radius around them.
notes: Damage is dealt before Spectre's attack.
Spectre's illusions also have Desolate.

spectre_dispersion.desc: Spectre disperses part of the damage dealt to her, reflecting it to all nearby enemies. The effect lessens with distance.
spectre_dispersion.shard: Dispersion can be activated to increase the amount absorbed and reflected by Dispersion by %activation_bonus_pct%%% of its base values for %activation_duration%s. Cooldown %activation_cooldown%. Manacost %activation_manacost%.
notes: The reflected damage is not dealt to Spectre.
Illusions don't get this ability.
Damage is reflected before reductions, and is returned as the same damage type.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

spectre_haunt.desc:
Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.

Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself. They ignore terrain.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.
spectre_haunt.scepter:
The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a %fear_aoe% area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for %fear_duration%s and have their movement speed slowed by %fear_movespeed_slow%%%.

Reduces cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%s.

spectre_shadow_step.desc:
Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.

The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.

spectre_reality.desc: Spectre assumes the target Shadow Step or Haunt illusion, destroying it.
spectre_reality.shard: Reality also casts Spectral Dagger on the illusion's target.

spectre_spectral.desc:
When targeting a unit for attack, Spectre gains phased collision. If she moves through a unit, she gains %speed_bonus% movement speed. This effect lingers for %linger_time%s.

Spectre's illusions always have phased collision, and cannot gain the speed bonus.

spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.desc:
Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at %min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after %windup_time%s.

All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash. If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.
spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness.shard: Increases Charge of Darkness Bonus Speed by %bonus_movement_speed%.
notes: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
The charge indicator is visible only to allies.
Spirit Breaker gains shared vision of the target.

spirit_breaker_bulldoze.desc: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.

spirit_breaker_greater_bash.desc: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.
spirit_breaker_greater_bash.scepter: Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive %cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%% damage), and the original target takes %cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%% of Greater Bash's damage again.
notes: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
Break disables the passive percent Chance to Bash. Does not disable Greater Bash application from Charge of Darkness or Nether Strike.

spirit_breaker_nether_strike.desc: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.
notes: Spirit Breaker appears behind the target to deliver the bash.

spirit_breaker_planar_pocket.desc: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.
notes: Planar Pocket's effect stops if Barathrum moves %break_distance% units away from the target.

spirit_breaker_herd_mentality.desc: The hero on your team whose level is lower than anybody else's on your team gains %xp_gain_rate%%% more experience.

spirit_breaker_bull_rush.desc: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.
notes: Empowering Haste buff allows Spirit Breaker to go over the max movement speed limit.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

storm_spirit_electric_rave.desc: Grants Storm Spirit and allied heroes within %radius% AoE of him %charges% Overload charges. Provides 40 Attack Speed. Lasts up to %duration% seconds or until the charges are depleted.

storm_spirit_static_remnant.desc: Creates an explosively charged image of Storm Spirit that walks to the target position and lasts for %abilityduration% seconds. Will detonate and deal damage if an enemy unit comes near it.
notes: Remnants take %static_remnant_delay% second to materialize after the spell is cast.
Remnants grant unobstructed vision for their duration.
The explosion actually hits units in a %static_remnant_damage_radius% radius, but will only be triggered in %static_remnant_radius%.
Can be self-cast to cast in place.

storm_spirit_electric_vortex.desc: A vortex that pulls an enemy unit to Storm Spirit's location.
storm_spirit_electric_vortex.scepter: Electric Vortex affects all enemies within a radius around Storm Spirit.

storm_spirit_overload.desc: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.
storm_spirit_overload.shard: Can be activated to grant Storm Spirit and nearby allied heroes %shard_activation_charges% Overload charges. Provides bonus Attack Speed. Lasts up to %shard_activation_duration% seconds or until the charges are depleted.
notes: Using items doesn't trigger Overload.
Overload charges do not stack.

storm_spirit_ball_lightning.desc: Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is %ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is %ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%% of his total mana pool.  Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.
notes: Abilities and items can be used while traveling.
This ability will destroy trees.
Storm Spirit is invulnerable during Ball Lightning.

storm_spirit_galvanized.desc: Storm Spirit gains a charge of %mp_per_kill% mana regeneration per kill, and a charge every %level_divisor% levels. Loses %charges_per_death% charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains %perma_mp_per_kill% Mana Regen permanently.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks from kills.

sven_storm_bolt.desc: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.
sven_storm_bolt.scepter: Increases cast range to %AbilityCastRange% and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.

sven_great_cleave.desc: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.

sven_warcry.desc: Sven's Warcry heartens his allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts %duration% seconds.
sven_warcry.shard: Increases radius and bonus movement speed. Warcry is now undispellable and provides a %base_barrier_amount% physical damage barrier.

sven_gods_strength.desc: Sven channels his rogue strength, granting bonus damage and slow resistance for %abilityduration% seconds.
notes: The bonus damage is based on base damage and the primary attribute of Sven.

sven_vanquisher.desc: Sven's attacks deal %bonus_damage_pct%%% bonus damage to stunned enemies.

sven_wrath_of_god.desc: Sven gains additional attack damage from Strength.

techies_land_mines.desc: Plant an invisible mine that cannot be detected by True Sight, but is visible if an enemy is within the active %radius% AoE of the mine. Mines detonate if an enemy is standing within the active AoE for %proximity_threshold% seconds dealing damage and temporarily reducing the enemy's Magic Resistance. The explosion deals full damage if the target is within %min_distance% radius and decreases down to %outer_damage%%% on the edge. Deals %building_damage_pct%%% damage to buildings.
notes: Cannot be placed within %placement_radius% AoE of another Proximity Mine.
Proximity Mines do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.
Mines last until they explode or are destroyed.
Mines are triggered by invisible units.
Grants 30 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.

techies_snare_trap.desc: Plant an invisible trap that, when triggered by a player-controlled target, does a small amount of damage over time and slows enemy cast speed. Affected units are also tethered inside of the trap radius. Snare Traps take %activation_time% seconds to activate and last for up to %duration% seconds.
notes: Snare Traps destroy all other Snare Traps in their area of effect when they detonate.
Snare Traps are not triggered by invisible units.
Snare Traps do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.

techies_stasis_trap.desc: Plant an invisible trap that roots nearby enemy units instantly when triggered.
notes: Stasis Traps destroy all other Stasis Traps in their area of effect when they detonate.
Stasis Traps are not triggered by invisible units.
Stasis Traps do not block neutral creep camps from spawning.

techies_suicide.desc: Techies hurtle themselves into the enemy's midst, detonating charges upon impact which deal massive area of effect damage and stun enemies. Upon landing, the assault deals Techies non-lethal damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
notes: The self-damage Techies receive from this blast is pure and non-lethal.
This ability destroys trees.

techies_sticky_bomb.desc: Lobs a Sticky Bomb towards the target area. If it lands next to an enemy hero, the bomb will stick to it, slowing its movement speed. After a few seconds the bomb will explode, dealing damage in an area around the detonation and applying a secondary slow for %secondary_slow_duration% seconds.

techies_reactive_tazer.desc:
Techies trigger an electric charge on the target ally, giving them bonus movement speed for a short period of time. Enemies attacking the target take damage and are temporarily disarmed and get a Basic Dispel.

At the end of the effect or if detonated early with the sub-ability, the charge explodes, disarming all enemies within the radius and dealing damage.

techies_remote_mines.desc: Plant an invisible explosive that will only detonate after a brief delay when triggered.  Does not damage buildings.
notes: Grants 10 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.

techies_minefield_sign.desc:
Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal %bonus_mine_damage_pct%%% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts %lifetime% seconds.

When an enemy Hero walks within %trigger_radius% units of a minefield sign, the %aura_radius% units area around the sign will become a minefield for %minefield_duration% seconds, dealing damage to enemy Heroes any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.

techies_squees_scope.desc: Techies gains %attack_range_tooltip% attack range and attack projectile speed for each point of attack speed.

techies_spoons_stash.desc: Techies stack all previously selected Enchantments onto newly crafted Neutral Items.
notes: Only one Tier 5 Enchantment can be stacked after crafting your second Tier 5 Neutral Item.
Divine Regalia's Exalted loss of enchantment upon death only affects the most recently obtained Tier 5 enchantment.

techies_mutually_assured_destruction.desc:
Techies gain a percentage of their mana pool as bonus mana regeneration.

When Techies die, they leave behind a barrel that explodes after %explosion_delay%s, damaging enemies in an area around it. Damage is based on Techies' max mana.
techies_mutually_assured_destruction.shard: M.A.D. becomes an active ability. Increases max mana as damage amount. Techies plant a M.A.D. which can be detonated manually with a sub-ability. Only one M.A.D. from the active ability can be placed at a time.
notes: Break disables the bonus mana regeneration.

templar_assassin_refraction.desc: Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage.  The damage and avoidance effects are separate, and have a limited number of instances. If a barrier is consumed, a new one is created as long as there are charges left. If an instance of damage would deal more damage than the remaining barrier, all of the damage is absorbed.
templar_assassin_refraction.shard: Increases bonus damage. Refraction can be cast while disabled.
notes: Damage as HP Removal bypasses Refraction (it won't reduce the charges).

templar_assassin_meld.desc: Templar Assassin conceals herself, becoming invisible as long as she remains still. If Meld's invisibility is broken by attacking an enemy, Lanaya's attack will deal bonus damage to the enemy and reduce their armor for %debuff_duration% seconds. Bonus damage and debuffs from Meld are applied to all enemies in the Psi Blades split range.
notes: Meld is broken by any action other than staying in position or channeling Psionic Projection.
Meld's armor reduction does not work against towers.

templar_assassin_psi_blades.desc: Templar Assassin's psi blades slice through the attacked unit, splitting and damaging enemy units directly behind it, while gaining bonus attack range. For each unit it damages, the split damage is reduced by a percentage.
notes: Split damage hits invisible units.
Attack effects like Bash will only be applied to the main target.

templar_assassin_psionic_trap.desc: Templar Assassin places mystical traps that invisibly monitor enemy movement. When sprung at her command, they exert a slowing influence of %movement_speed_min%%% in a %trap_radius% radius. Trap movement slow charges up to %movement_speed_max%%% after %trap_max_charge_duration% seconds. Deals damage after %trap_max_charge_duration%s.
templar_assassin_psionic_trap.scepter: When activated, traps now silence affected enemies.
notes: Traps last indefinitely.
They have invisibility that fades in over %trap_fade_time% seconds and spell immunity. Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to them.
Traps have 250/250 vision range and don't prevent neutral camps from spawning.
Traps have fragile pips: melee heroes and Roshan remove 2 pips per attack.

templar_assassin_third_eye.desc: Templar Assassin and her teammates can see Roshan's respawn timer.

templar_assassin_hidden_gates.desc: Templar Assassin gains access to linked portals at the edges of the map usable only by her.

templar_assassin_trap.desc:
Springs the trap nearest to Templar Assassin, slowing nearby enemies.

If the ability is in alt-cast state, springs the trap that is closest to the mouse cursor.

templar_assassin_trap_teleport.desc: CHANNELED - Allows Templar Assassin to teleport to any Psionic Trap after channeling for %abilitychanneltime% seconds, detonating it upon arrival as if it was fully charged and instantly dealing %extra_damage% bonus damage. Channeling Psionic Projection does not break Meld.

templar_assassin_self_trap.desc: Springs the trap, slowing nearby enemies.

templar_assassin_inner_peace.desc: When remaining stationary and not taking damage for %time_until_meditation%s, Templar Assassin begins meditating, gaining health and mana regeneration, reaching the maximum bonus after %time_until_max_bonus%s of meditating.

terrorblade_reflection.desc: Terrorblade brings forth an invulnerable dark reflection of all enemy heroes in a target area. Affected enemy heroes have movement and attack speeds slowed and attacked by their reflection.
notes: Reflections are untargetable, invulnerable illusions, that will be destroyed if the slow debuff is removed.
Reflections can only attack their source.

terrorblade_conjure_image.desc: Creates an illusion of Terrorblade that deals damage.
notes: Illusions created by Conjure Image are visually different for enemies.

terrorblade_metamorphosis.desc: Terrorblade transforms into a powerful demon with a ranged attack. Any of Terrorblade's illusions that are within %metamorph_aura_tooltip% range will also be transformed by Metamorphosis.
notes: Cooldowns of items that are different for ranged and melee units will be based on which form Terrorblade was in when the item was used.

terrorblade_terror_wave.desc: Causes a wave to travel outwards in all directions forcing enemy heroes to become Feared upon impact and dealing damage, and grants Terrorblade Metamorphosis for a short time.

terrorblade_demon_zeal.desc: Costs part of Terrorblade's current HP to cast, providing Terrorblade and nearby illusions bonus movement, HP Regen and attack speed. Does not affect Reflection illusions. Can't be cast while in Metamorphosis and Metamorphosis will remove Demon Zeal.

terrorblade_sunder.desc: Severs the life from both Terrorblade and a target hero, exchanging a percentage of both units' current health. Some health points must remain.
notes: Debuff Immune enemies don't get their HP modified.

terrorblade_dark_unity.desc: Nearby Illusions created by Terrorblade have bonus attack damage.
notes: Reflection Illusions are also affected.

tidehunter_gush.desc: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.
tidehunter_gush.scepter: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.  Decreases cooldown.

tidehunter_kraken_shell.desc:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of %active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%% movement speed. Lasts %active_duration%s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: Does not stack with items that provide Damage Block.

tidehunter_anchor_smash.desc: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus %additional_range% units.
notes: Anchor Smash works on all Ancient creeps except for Roshan.
Damage done by Anchor Smashes triggered by Kraken Shell Cleanse is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

tidehunter_ravage.desc: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
notes: Ravage will hit invisible units.
Ravage waves move outwards at a speed of %speed%.

tidehunter_dead_in_the_water.desc: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than %chain_length% units away from the anchor forces the hero to %max_movement_speed% move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor has %attacks_to_destroy% pip health.

tidehunter_leviathans_catch.desc:
Whenever an enemy hero is killed by Tidehunter or dies under his debuffs, a fish appears in their place; Tidehunter can eat the fish to permanently gain %fish_health_bonus% Health, %fish_attack_range% Attack Range, and %fish_damage_block% Bonus Damage Block.

Tidehunter eats a free fish every time he reaches an even hero level.
notes: Enemies can destroy the fish.
Bonus Damage Block only applies if another source of Damage Block will be affecting the incoming physical attack.

tidehunter_blubber.desc:
Tidehunter's hide removes negative status effects if he takes more than %damage_cleanse% damage. Removes most debuffs, even if they are generally not purgable.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: Only damage from player owned sources is counted towards debuff removal.
The counter will reset if no player owned damage is taken for %damage_reset_interval% seconds.

tinker_defense_matrix.desc: Targets an allied unit, applying an all damage barrier to them that also provides Status Resistance.

tinker_keen_teleport.desc: CHANNELED - Teleport to a target friendly structure. Level 2 allows teleporting to friendly units and Level 3 to friendly heroes.

tinker_eureka.desc: Tinker gains %one_percent_tooltip%%% item cooldown reduction per %int_per_one_cdr% Intelligence, up to a maximum of %max_cdr%%%.

tinker_laser.desc: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.
tinker_laser.scepter: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by %scepter_reduction_pct%%% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.

tinker_march_of_the_machines.desc: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.
tinker_march_of_the_machines.scepter: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
notes: Robots spawn at a rate of %machines_per_sec% per second.

tinker_rearm.desc: CHANNELED - Resets the cooldown on Tinker's abilities.

tinker_warp_grenade.desc:
Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, slowing them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for %debuff_duration% seconds.

The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
notes: Max teleportation distance is %warp_distance_pct_tooltip%%% of Warp Flare's cast range, which decreases down to 0 at max cast range.

tinker_deploy_turrets.desc: Deploys 3 uncontrollable turrets at the target location. Enemies hit by the impact take damage and are pushed away from the landing point. If Tinker is hit, he also gets pushed by the impact. Once deployed, the turret fires missiles in the direction of the nearest enemy hero.
tinker_deploy_turrets.scepter: Turrets missiles have %bonus_missile_range%%% faster attack interval, increased range, and increased speed.

tiny_avalanche.desc: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.

tiny_toss.desc: Grabs the nearest unit in a %grab_radius% radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.
notes: You can toss allies, but they don't take damage.
Toss deals 33% of its damage to buildings.
Debuff Immune units can be targeted but cannot be tossed.
Flight time is %duration%s.

tiny_craggy_exterior.desc: Enemies that attack Tiny receive a stacking debuff that lowers their attack damage with each stack.
notes: Break disables the application of new stacks.
Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.

tiny_tree_grab.desc: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks.  The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.
notes: The cooldown begins when the tree is thrown.

tiny_toss_tree.desc: Throws the tree at the target unit, proccing your attack on it and splashing damage around the target.

tiny_tree_channel.desc: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.

tiny_grow.desc: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.
tiny_grow.shard: Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.

tiny_insurmountable.desc: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.
notes: Insurmountable does not reduce the effect of Grow's Attack Speed Reduction.

treant_natures_guise.desc: Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for %cooldown_time% seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.
notes: While affected by Nature's Guise, Treant can move unobstructed through other trees.
Vines from Nature's Grasp are considered trees for this ability.
While Tree Walking, taking damage does not disable the active ability or Tree Walking.

treant_natures_grasp.desc: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through.

treant_leech_seed.desc: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits %healing_pulse_count% healing pulses to up to %max_heal_units% nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.

treant_living_armor.desc: Infuses the target hero or structure with a protective coating which heals the target and blocks damage from player-controlled sources. Each time this spell blocks damage, the block amount is decreased. If the damage block is decreased to 0, the buff is removed early.
treant_living_armor.shard: Increases the Damage Blocked by Living Armor. Treant now also passively benefits from Living Armor, with the damage block resetting after not taking damage for %passive_reset_cd% seconds.
notes: Instances of damage less than %damage_block_threshold% are ignored.

treant_overgrowth.desc: Summons an overgrowth of vines and branches around Treant that deal damage to afflicted enemies and prevent them from moving, blinking, going invisible, or attacking.
treant_overgrowth.scepter: Decreases Cooldown to %AbilityCooldown% seconds. When casting Overgrowth, Treant Protector draws power from the soil, greatly increasing his size for %bloom_duration% seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of %movement_speed%, %strength_bonus%%% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals %splash_pct%%% of his attack damage in a %splash_radius% unit radius.
notes: Works on Debuff Immune units, but if units gain debuff immunity after the effect starts, they'll break free.

treant_eyes_in_the_forest.desc: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for %duration% seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
notes: Being entangled by Overgrowth through enchanted trees from Eyes in the Forest does damage.
If the enemy has True Sight, they will be able to see which trees are enchanted.

treant_super_bloom.desc: Treant grows massive in size for %duration% seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of %movement_speed%, %strength_bonus%%% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals %splash_pct%%% of his attack damage in a %splash_radius% unit radius.

troll_warlord_berserkers_rage.desc:
While in melee form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to ensnare, preventing the target from moving or using mobility spells and has additional movement speed.

When in ranged form, Troll Warlord's attacks have a chance to Maim the target, dealing bonus damage, and slowing the target's movement and attack speed.

troll_warlord_switch_stance.desc:
Troll Warlord swaps from using ranged to melee attacks. While melee, Troll Warlord's base attack time is improved to %base_attack_time%.

Troll Warlord gains %armor_per_interval% armor per %attack_speed_interval% bonus attack speed.

troll_warlord_whirling_axes_ranged.desc: Troll hurls a fistful of five axes in a cone shape over %axe_range% range, slowing and damaging enemy units.
troll_warlord_whirling_axes_ranged.scepter:
Causes Whirling Axes (Ranged) to dispel enemies. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Does not affect Roshan.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

troll_warlord_whirling_axes_melee.desc: Troll hurls two axes around him in a close range area of effect, damaging enemy units and causing them to miss some attacks.
troll_warlord_whirling_axes_melee.scepter:
Causes Whirling Axes (Melee) to dispel Troll Warlord. Reduces cooldown and mana cost.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Does not affect Roshan.

troll_warlord_fervor.desc: With each continuous blow on the same target, Troll gains increased attack speed.  If Troll changes targets, the stacks drop to zero.
troll_warlord_fervor.shard: Grants Troll %base_chance%%% + %extra_attack_chance_per_stack%%% chance per Fervor stack of firing an additional ranged attack to any unit within its ranged attack range plus %range_buffer% when attacking an enemy unit.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break disables the proc chance granted by Aghanim's Shard.

troll_warlord_battle_trance.desc:
Troll unleashes a powerful battle trance, that forces you to continuously attack the closest enemy unit within %range% range, prioritizing heroes. Unslowable while attacking. Damage does not kill you during this mode. Grants you bonus lifesteal, attack speed, status resistance, and movement speed. Applies a Basic Dispel.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Troll can still use his items and abilities while affected by Battle Trance, but not other commands.
Troll can still be killed with Axe's Culling Blade.
Troll is granted vision over the target.

dark_troll_warlord_ensnare.desc: The Dark Troll Trapper tosses netting around an enemy's feet, briefly immobilizing the unit, though the unit can still attack and use abilities.

dark_troll_warlord_raise_dead.desc: The Dark Troll Summoner stirs the ground underfoot, raising the remains of trolls long dead, bringing to life three skeleton Warriors who will fight at his side.

tusk_ice_shards.desc: Tusk compresses shards of ice into a ball of frozen energy that damages all enemies it comes in contact with. When the ball reaches its target destination the shards are released, creating a barrier that lasts for %shard_duration% seconds.
notes: Creates an impassable barrier.

tusk_snowball.desc: Tusk begins rolling into a snowball. Allies within a %snowball_grab_radius% radius can also be added to the snowball by right-clicking on them, even while the snowball is moving. Once launched, any enemies caught in the snowball's path will be stunned and take damage. Each allied Hero in the snowball will add to its damage and stun duration.
notes: The snowball will break apart a maximum of 3 seconds after launch.
The snowball can be launched early by pressing using the Launch Snowball ability.
Doesn't carry illusions, but will carry Meepo clones and other units that Tusk controls.
Each Meepo clone added to the snowball will add its own bonus damage.
Allies can click on a snowball to add themselves to it.

tusk_launch_snowball.desc: Launch the snowball toward the target.
notes: The snowball destroys trees.
Doesn't carry illusions, but will carry Meepo clones and other units that Tusk controls.
Each Meepo clone added to the snowball will add its own bonus damage.

tusk_tag_team.desc: Activate to temporarily apply a negative debuff aura around you, causing enemies that are attacked under it to take bonus physical damage and reduced movement speed. Lasts %debuff_duration% seconds.
notes: Affects attacks from allied heroes, Tusk or any of his units.

tusk_drinking_buddies.desc: Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor.
notes: Doesn't pull Tusk or targeted ally if they are within %min_distance% range of each other.
Cannot be used during Snowball.

tusk_bitter_chill.desc: Passively slows the attack speed of all enemy heroes within a %radius% unit radius.

tusk_walrus_punch.desc: Tusk connects with his mighty Walrus Punch, a critical strike with bonus damage so powerful it launches its victim into the air.
notes: Walrus PUNCH has true strike.

tusk_walrus_kick.desc: Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within %search_radius% radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by %creep_cooldown_reduction_pct%%% if kicking a creep.

undying_decay.desc: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals %creep_damage_multiplier%x damage to creeps.
notes: The strength stolen stacks, but can't cause a hero to have strength below 1.
The strength steal takes effect before the damage is dealt.
Affects invisible units.

undying_soul_rip.desc: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.
notes: Can heal Tombstone, but can't heal or damage other buildings.
Does not rip from invisible units, invulnerable units, units in the fog of war, or spell immune enemies.
Does rip from spell immune allies, including zombies.

undying_tombstone.desc: Summons a tombstone at the target point.  Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.  Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
undying_tombstone.shard: Tombstone can be cast on an allied hero to bunker inside of the tombstone. Heroes that enter the Tombstone cannot leave for %tombstone_bunker_cd% seconds nor can they re-enter after leaving. If the tombstone is destroyed with a hero inside, that hero gets stunned for %tombstone_stun_penalty% seconds.
notes: Tombstone is Spell Immune, but can be healed by Soul Rip.
Zombies and Tombstone are Spell Immune.
If their initial target dies or goes out of vision, the Zombie will die.

undying_tombstone_zombie_deathstrike.desc: Slows enemy units on attack.  If the attacked unit's health goes below the threshold, the zombie receives enhanced movement and attack speed.

undying_flesh_golem.desc: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem.  While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.

undying_bite.desc:
Undying sinks his teeth into his target, dealing his attack damage plus bonus physical damage and healing himself for the amount dealt.

Biting a hero turns them into a zombie for %zombie_duration%s: becoming melee, silenced, %zombie_slow%%% slowed, and dealing %zombie_damage_reduction%%% less damage. Bitten creeps die and become a controllable zombie for %creep_zombie_duration%s.
notes: Bite has %bonus_attack_range% bonus attack range.
Bite cannot miss.

undying_ceaseless_dirge.desc: When Undying dies he will instantly respawn in the fountain. Begins the game on cooldown. Cannot be refreshed and is not affected by cooldown reduction.

ursa_earthshock.desc: Ursa leaps forward %hop_distance% units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemy units in a nearby area for %abilityduration% seconds.
ursa_earthshock.shard: Earthshock applies %fury_swipe_stacks_on_hit% Fury Swipes to enemies hit.

ursa_overpower.desc: Using his skill in combat, Ursa gains increased attack speed and slow resistance for a number of subsequent attacks.
notes: Missing an attack still consumes a charge of Overpower.

ursa_fury_swipes.desc: Ursa's claws dig deeper wounds in the enemy, causing consecutive attacks to the same enemy to deal more damage.  If the same target is not attacked after %bonus_reset_time% seconds, the bonus damage is lost.
notes: Break disables the application of new stacks.
Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.

ursa_enrage.desc:
Ursa goes into a frenzy, providing damage reduction and status resistance. Removes any existing debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
ursa_enrage.scepter: Reduces cooldown and allows Ursa to use Enrage while disabled.

ursa_maul.desc: Ursa gains bonus damage equal to a percentage of his Current HP.

ursa_bear_down.desc: Debuffs inflicted by Ursa last longer.

vengefulspirit_magic_missile.desc: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.
vengefulspirit_magic_missile.shard: Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within %bounce_range_pct%%% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.

vengefulspirit_command_aura.desc: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives %self_multiplier%%% extra bonus.
vengefulspirit_command_aura.scepter:
Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells.

If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.
notes: Break disables the damage aura.

vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror.desc: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.

vengefulspirit_nether_swap.desc: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.
notes: Works on Spell Immune units.
Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.

vengefulspirit_soul_strike.desc: Vengeful Spirit's ranged attacks behave as if they were melee attacks.

vengefulspirit_retribution.desc:
Vengeful Spirit is considered both a ranged and a melee attacker to gain the respective bonuses.

When killed by an enemy hero, Vengeful Spirit deals %bonus_damage%%% bonus damage to her killer until their next death. Only one debuff can exist at a time.
notes: When attacking units with Pip Health, Vengeful Spirit is considered a ranged attacker.

venomancer_venomous_gale.desc: Launches a ball of venom in a line, poisoning enemy units so that they take both initial damage and damage over time, as well as suffering slowed movement.  Venomous Gale deals damage every 3 seconds over its duration.
venomancer_venomous_gale.shard: Increases cast range and projectile speed by %shard_travel_tooltip%%%. When Venomous Gale impacts enemy heroes, %num_created_wards_tooltip% Plague Wards are created around them.
notes: Venomous Gale can be lethal.
Duration damage is dealt every %tick_interval% seconds.
Slow starts at %movement_slow%%%, and decreases as time passes.

venomancer_poison_sting.desc: Venomancer's attacks slow enemies and deal damage over time.
venomancer_poison_sting.shard: Whenever Poison Sting is applied, it deals extra damage equal to %debuff_dmg%%% of the attacker's base damage for every debuff the enemy has from Venomancer or a unit he controls.
notes: Poison Sting damage can be lethal.
Damage from Poison Sting does not interrupt healing from items, nor does it activate the cooldown on Blink Dagger.

venomancer_plague_ward.desc: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Ward attacks apply Venomancer's Poison Sting with %poison_sting_potency%%% damage/slow.
notes: Poison Sting from a plague ward fully stacks with Poison Sting from Venomancer.

venomancer_noxious_plague.desc: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.
venomancer_noxious_plague.scepter: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown% seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.
notes: Spread debuffs have fixed duration and are not modified by status resistance or debuff amplification.

venomancer_snakebite.desc: Venomancer summons a Spawn of Aktok to sink its fangs into a target, dealing magic damage and applying a toxin that does damage every second. When the target attacks while infected, they take the initial damage again.

venomancer_poison_nova.desc: Venomancer emits a spreading ring of poison that does nonlethal damage over time to enemy units. Damage done is a base amount plus a percentage of the target's max health.

venomancer_sepsis.desc: Venomancer's attacks deal extra damage based on how many debuffs the attack target has. Extra damage is dealt as magical damage. Only counts debuffs from Venomancer or his Plague Wards.
venomancer_sepsis.shard: Plague Wards also deal Septic Shock damage based on their attack damage.
notes: Break only disables the bonus damage for Venomancer's attacks.

viper_poison_attack.desc: Intensifies Viper's venom, adding an effect to his normal attack that applies a stacking movement speed slow and magic resistance deduction while dealing damage over time. Stacks up to %max_stacks% times.
viper_poison_attack.shard: Increases max stacks, and causes Poison Attack to lower armor per stack and to affect buildings for reduced damage.

viper_nethertoxin.desc: Viper releases a Nethertoxin at the targeted area. Units in that area take an increasing damage over time based on how long they remain in it. Units in it have their attack speed slowed.
notes: Multiple Nethertoxins do not stack.

viper_corrosive_skin.desc: Viper exudes an infectious toxin that damages and slows the attack speed of any enemy that damages it in a %max_range% radius. The acid exudate also increases Viper's resistance to magic.
viper_corrosive_skin.scepter: Corrosive Skin applies %effect_multiplier%x the attack speed slow to enemies that are within %effect_multiplier_distance% distance of Viper.  Viper's Corrosive Skin Magic Resistance and Damage per Second are gradually increased while he is in Nethertoxin, up to %nethertoxin_bonus_pct%%% increased effect after %nethertoxin_bonus_pct_max_duration_tooltip%s.
notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other magic damage resistance sources.
Break prevents the application of Corrosive Skin. Does not disable Corrosive Skin application from Nosedive.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

viper_predator.desc: Viper's attacks deal an additional instance of physical damage per missing health percentage of the target hero.

viper_viper_strike.desc: Viper slows the targeted enemy unit's movement and attack speed while also disabling their passives and dealing poison damage over time. The slowing effect reduces over the duration of the poison.

viper_nose_dive.desc: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a %corrosive_radius% AoE for %effect_duration% seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.

visage_grave_chill.desc: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining the drained speed for itself and nearby Familiars.
notes: The two buffs can be removed separately by dispels.
The speed gained is independent of the speed lost on the target.
Familiars within %radius% range of Visage will also receive bonuses from Grave Chill.

visage_soul_assumption.desc: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than %damage_limit% damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.
notes: Charges are only gained for damage greater than %damage_min% and less than %damage_max% that is dealt by a player or Roshan.  Self-damage or Soul Assumption damage isn't counted.

visage_gravekeepers_cloak.desc:
Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage. If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.

Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within %radius% range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.
visage_gravekeepers_cloak.shard: Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds. Restores up to %shard_hp_restoration_pct%%% of your health.
notes: Each time Visage receives damage greater than the Minimum Damage that was not self-inflicted and was from a player owned source, a layer is removed.
Familiars within %radius% range of Visage will receive the current damage reduction from Gravekeeper's Cloak.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

visage_summon_familiars.desc:
Conjures %familiar_count% blind Familiars to fight for Visage.  Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing.  While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.  Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
notes: Casting Summon Familiars will replace any existing Familiars.
Familiars within range of Visage will receive bonuses from Gravekeeper's Cloak and Grave Chill.
