visage_silent_as_the_grave.desc: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed.  Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for %bonus_duration%s.
visage_silent_as_the_grave.scepter: Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.

visage_stone_form_self_cast.desc:
Orders the Familiar closest to Visage to cast Stone Form in its current location, turning into stone and smashing into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area. The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly. After %stone_duration% seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form.

Can be alt-cast to order the closest Familiar to the target location to move there and cast Stone Form.
notes: While Stone Form is not dispellable, the stun can be removed by strong dispels.

visage_summon_familiars_stone_form.desc:
After a short delay, the Familiar turns into stone and smashes into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area. The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly. After %stone_duration% seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form.

Can be alt-cast to order the Familiar to move to the target location and cast Stone Form.

visage_lurker.desc:
Visage's ability cooldown durations are accelerated as long as he's not taking damage.

Grants a stack every %stack_gain_time%s that Visage does not take damage. Each stack grants %cooldown_speed_per_stack%%% cooldown acceleration with a max of %max_stacks% stacks. Stacks fade after %linger_duration%s upon taking any damage.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
Affects Visage's ability cooldown durations, including spells already on cooldown.

visage_summon_familiars_recall.desc: Recall this familiar to Visage after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.

void_spirit_aether_remnant.desc: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.
void_spirit_aether_remnant.shard: Creates an additional watcher path that rotates around the remnant.  The remnant now provides True Sight, and no longer triggers on creeps, instead dealing %creep_damage_pct%%% damage to them every second in both paths. Does not reveal wards.

void_spirit_dissimilate.desc: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.

void_spirit_astral_step.desc: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path with bonus item potency. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for %pop_damage_delay% seconds and then detonates.
notes: Astral Step attacks do not cleave.

void_spirit_resonant_pulse.desc: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
void_spirit_resonant_pulse.scepter: Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain %max_charges% charges.

void_spirit_symmetry.desc: Void Spirit gains a physical damage barrier when dealing magic damage to enemy heroes.

void_spirit_intrinsic_edge.desc: Void Spirit gains %damage_stat_bonus_pct%%% more attack damage per point of each attribute, and %secondary_stat_bonus_pct%%% more HP regen from Strength, attack speed from Agility, and mana regen from Intelligence.

warlock_fatal_bonds.desc: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.
notes: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

warlock_shadow_word.desc: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.
warlock_shadow_word.scepter: Increases Effect Radius. Shadow Word now applies to %additional_targets% additional units in a %cast_aoe% radius, prioritizing heroes. The healing and damage on the additional targets is reduced by %secondary_reduction%%%.

warlock_upheaval.desc: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Enemies are slowed for %duration% second after leaving the area or the spell ends.
warlock_upheaval.shard: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every %imps_interval% seconds that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.
notes: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.

warlock_rain_of_chaos.desc: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds. The Golem lives %golem_duration% seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
notes: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.

warlock_golem_flaming_fists.desc: Deals extra damage to nearby units when attacking.

warlock_golem_permanent_immolation.desc: Burns the Golem's nearby enemy units, dealing damage per second.

warlock_imp_explode.desc: Shortly after dying, a burst of magic damage is dealt to all enemies in a small area. Does %explosion_nonhero_reduce%%% less damage to non-hero targets.

warlock_eldritch_summoning.desc: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.
warlock_eldritch_summoning.shard: Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.
notes: Minor imps do not explode if killed by enemy heroes.

warlock_black_grimoire.desc: Grants Warlock the item Black Grimoire, which can be consumed to gain experience for each kill Warlock participated in. Starts with 1 charge.

weaver_the_swarm.desc: Weaver launches a swarm of %count% young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.
notes: When a beetle latches on a target, it will remain there until it is killed or the duration expires.
Beetles are Spell Immune and have %destroy_attacks% pip health. Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to beetles.
Beetles provide vision.

weaver_shukuchi.desc: Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed and doing harm to any enemies it passes through.
weaver_shukuchi.shard: Shukuchi puts a mark on enemies it damages that last %geminate_attack_mark_duration% seconds. %shukuchi_attack_delay%s after Weaver exits Shukuchi, enemies with a mark within %shukuchi_attack_mark_radius% range will also be attacked with a secondary Geminate attack
notes: Can only damage the same unit once per cast.

weaver_geminate_attack.desc: Allows Weaver to dispatch additional attacks. Additional attacks have bonus damage and item potency.
weaver_geminate_attack.shard: Geminate Attack will also hit units within %shard_beetle_search_range% range of the original target that have The Swarm beetles attached to them.
notes: Additional attacks leave Weaver %delay% seconds after the previous one, and have no range limit.
Bonus damage only applies to the geminated attack and not the original attack.

weaver_time_lapse.desc:
Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier - regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: Removes most negative buffs from Weaver.
Time Lapse disjoints projectiles.

weaver_time_lapse_ally.desc:
Weaver warps an allied Hero backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier - restoring the HP and mana it had at that time. Shares a cooldown with Time Lapse.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: Removes most negative buffs from the target.
Disjoints projectiles.
Level matches Time Lapse.

weaver_rewoven.desc: Every time Weaver damages an enemy hero with an ability, he gains %experience_gain% experience.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

weaver_threads_of_fate.desc: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within %thread_setup_distance% range of them for %thread_setup_time%s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. While the thread holds, the enemy is slowed again every %established_thread_duration%s. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.

windrunner_gale_force.desc: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.

windrunner_shackleshot.desc: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it.  If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to %fail_stun_duration%.
notes: This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most %shackle_distance% behind the target.
Shackleshot can be disjointed.

windrunner_powershot.desc: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to %abilitychanneltime% second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
notes: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.

windrunner_windrun.desc: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.

windrunner_focusfire.desc: Windranger channels the wind to gain %bonus_attack_speed% additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage and her Item Potency.
notes: Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.
Windranger can move while attacking.

windrunner_easy_breezy.desc: Windranger's movement speed cannot be lower than %min_movespeed% and can reach %max_movespeed%.

windrunner_tailwind.desc:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.
windrunner_tailwind.scepter: Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.desc: Winter Wyvern soars upon an arctic wind, granting her unobstructed movement and allowing her to exhale a blistering chill into each attack. While soaring, her attacks travel further and faster, and slow enemies with a magical freeze that strips them of %percent_damage%%% of their current health each second.
winter_wyvern_arctic_burn.scepter: Causes Arctic Burn to be a toggle ability, draining mana every second when active. Increases Winter Wyvern's movement speed.
notes: This ability does not affect Roshan.
Reduces Winter Wyvern's attack point to %attack_point%.
The damage and slow from Arctic Burn can be dispelled.

winter_wyvern_splinter_blast.desc: Launches a ball of brittle ice toward a unit. The ice shatters on impact, leaving the primary target completely unaffected, while hurling damaging splinters into nearby enemies in a %split_radius% base radius. Enemies struck by these splinters are slowed by %movespeed_slow_tooltip%%%.
notes: The primary projectile moves at %projectile_speed% movement speed.
The primary projectile cannot be disjointed and cannot be targeted towards Winter Wyvern herself.

winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.desc: Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.
winter_wyvern_cold_embrace.shard: Reduces cooldown by %shard_cooldown_reduction% seconds. Allied units gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon.

winter_wyvern_winters_curse.desc: Winter Wyvern dispells then freezes an enemy in place while striking those nearby with a maddening curse which causes them to attack their frozen ally with increased attack speed. The frozen ally and those cursed to attack their ally are immune to all damage from their enemies with the exception of damage from Winter Wyvern or her controlled units. Enemy heroes which enter the cursed area after the cast add to the duration of the curse.
notes: If the target dies to its allies, Winter Wyvern will receive credit for the kill.
Will only pierce the spell immunity of the primary target, not the target's surrounding allies.

winter_wyvern_eldwurm_scholar.desc: When an enemy hero casts an Ultimate ability within %xp_gain_range% of Winter Wyvern, she receives experience equal to %mana_to_xp_percentage%%% of the ultimate's manacost.

winter_wyvern_eldwurms_edda.desc: Grants Winter Wyvern the item Eldwurm's Edda, which can be consumed to increase the current and maximum level of a basic ability by one and Winter Wyvern's base intelligence by %tooltip_int_pct%%% of its current value at the time of consumption.

special_bonus_unique_winter_wyvern_4.desc: The slow is still applied for the same duration.

winter_wyvern_essence_of_the_blueheart.desc: Winter Wyvern's heals also restore mana.

winter_wyvern_dragon_sight.desc: Winter Wyvern gains bonus damage when her attack range is over %attack_range_min%.

winter_wyvern_accelerated_learning.desc: Winter Wyvern can skill this ability to reduce all ability and talent level requirements by 1. On the next level up, Winter Wyvern will receive an additional ability point for every level that was put into Eldwurm Studies since the last level up.

wisp_tether.desc: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.
wisp_tether.shard: Tether damages enemies touching it. Io is healed for %damage_to_heal%%% of the damage done.
notes: If you try to tether a unit that is 700 distance or further away from Io, Io will latch on and pull itself closer to the tethered unit (to a distance of 300).
The tethered unit will heal faster and will heal even if Io is at full health.
Io's movement speed matches the tethered unit's.

wisp_spirits.desc: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
wisp_spirits.scepter: Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.
notes: After summoning, Io can call the spirits in and out.

wisp_overcharge.desc: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.

wisp_relocate.desc: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
notes: Enemies receive a visual indicator in the world and on the minimap of the target location during the cast delay.
If Io is disabled during the cast delay, Relocate is cancelled.
If an allied hero is Tethered, that hero will teleport along with you. You can break the tether at any time to prevent that hero from teleporting with you.
Only heroes, creep heroes, and illusions can be relocated.

wisp_tether_break.desc: Break the link to the tethered unit.

wisp_spirits_in.desc: Sends the spirits closer to you. Can be toggled on and off.

wisp_spirits_out.desc: Sends the spirits farther away from you. Can be toggled on and off.

wisp_essence_conduction.desc: Io regenerates from consumables and the fountain %consume_speed%x faster.
notes: Total amount of restored health or mana remains the same.
Only applies to Healing Salve, Tango, Clarity, Bottle, Urn of Shadows, Spirit Vessel, Mana Draught, and Pollywog Charm.

wisp_equilibrium.desc: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.desc: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
notes: Targets can be hit multiple times, as long as another unit is struck in between the bounces.

witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.desc: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.
notes: Healing is done in %heal_interval% second intervals.
Can heal Spell Immune units.

witch_doctor_maledict.desc: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled targets in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.
notes: If an affected hero's health has increased above the amount they had when Maledict was cast, the burst damage will be 0.

witch_doctor_death_ward.desc: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Death Ward has %bonus_accuracy%%% bonus accuracy.
witch_doctor_death_ward.scepter: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.
notes: The Death Ward is invulnerable, and is only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires.
The Death Ward can be controlled, and made to attack a specific target.
Death Ward attacks once every 0.22 seconds.

witch_doctor_voodoo_switcheroo.desc: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.

witch_doctor_gris_gris.desc:
Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, %death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every %gold_tick_interval_tooltip%s.

Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

zuus_heavenly_jump.desc: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets %vision_radius% unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.

zuus_arc_lightning.desc: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.

zuus_lightning_bolt.desc: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a %sight_radius_night% radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in %spread_aoe% range.
notes: You can interrupt channeling spells and items with this ability.

zuus_cloud.desc: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.
notes: Grants %cloud_bounty_tooltip% gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
Affects the closest enemy unit with strikes from Zeus's current level of Lightning Bolt.
Creeps and illusions deal 25% damage to the Nimbus.
The Nimbus has fragile pips: melee heroes and Roshan remove 2 pips per attack.

zuus_static_field.desc: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit with his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.

zuus_thundergods_wrath.desc: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.

zuus_lightning_hands.desc: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.

item_blink.desc:
Active: Blink

Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.

Blink Dagger cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

item_overwhelming_blink.desc:
Active: Overwhelming Blink

Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.

After teleportation, all enemies in a %radius% AoE take damage equal to %damage_base% + %damage_pct_instant%%% of your strength and an additional %damage_pct_over_time%%% over time, and have %movement_slow%%% movement speed slow and %attack_slow% attack speed slow for %duration% seconds.

Overwhelming Blink cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

item_swift_blink.desc:
Active: Swift Blink

Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.

After teleportation, you gain %bonus_movement%%% phased movement speed and +%bonus_agi_active% Agility for %duration% seconds.

Swift Blink cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

item_arcane_blink.desc:
Active: Arcane Blink

Teleport to a target point up to %blink_range% units away.

After teleportation, you restore %heal_amount% health and %mana_amount% mana.

Arcane Blink cannot be used for %blink_damage_cooldown% seconds after taking damage from an enemy hero or Roshan.
notes: Self-casting will cause you to teleport in the direction of your team's fountain.

item_javelin.desc:
Passive: Pierce

Grants each attack a %bonus_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus magical damage.

item_quelling_blade.desc:
Active: Chop Tree

Destroy a target tree.

Passive: Quell

Increases attack damage against non-hero units by %damage_bonus% for melee heroes, and %damage_bonus_ranged% for ranged.
notes: Effects of multiple quelling blades do not stack.

item_infused_raindrop.desc:
Passive: Magical Damage Block

Consumes a charge to block %magic_damage_block% magic damage from damage instances over %min_damage% damage.

Comes with %initial_charges% charges. When the charges are gone, the item disappears.
notes: Uses at most one charge per damage instance.

item_wind_lace.desc: Bonuses from multiple Wind Laces do not stack.

item_stout_shield.desc:
Passive: Damage Block

Grants a %block_chance%%% chance to block %damage_block_melee% damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and %damage_block_ranged% damage on ranged.
notes: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.

item_moon_shard.desc:
Use: Consume

Consume the Moon Shard to permanently gain %consumed_bonus% attack speed and %consumed_bonus_night_vision% bonus night vision. Max 1 use.

Passive: Shade Sight

Grants bonus night vision.

item_branches.desc:
Use: Plant Tree

Targets the ground to plant a happy little tree that lasts for %tree_duration% seconds.

item_lifesteal.desc:
Passive: Lifesteal

Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

item_voodoo_mask.desc:
Passive: Spell Lifesteal

Heals the wearer for a percentage of spell damage dealt to enemies.
notes: Does not heal from Pure or Reflected damage.

item_boots.desc: Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

item_gem.desc:
Active: Reveal

Gives True Sight over a %active_radius% radius revealing wards and units even in Fog of War.

Passive: True Sight

Grants the ability to see invisible units and wards to any allied vision within %radius% range of its carrier.

Passive: Everlasting

Dropped on death, and cannot be destroyed.
notes: Disabled while on a courier.
Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.
Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.
Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

item_cheese.desc:
Use: Fondue

Instantly restores %health_restore% health and %mana_restore% mana.
notes: Cheese is shareable.

item_magic_stick.desc:
Active: Energy Charge

Instantly restores %restore_per_charge% health and mana per charge stored.

Max %max_charges% charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.
notes: Gains charges for spells cast by visible enemies in 1200 range.
Certain abilities and item abilities will not add charges.

item_magic_wand.desc:
Active: Energy Charge

Instantly restores %restore_per_charge% health and mana per charge stored.

Max %max_charges% charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.
notes: Gains charges for spells cast by visible enemies in 1200 range.
Certain abilities and item abilities will not add charges.

item_ghost.desc:
Active: Ghost Form

You enter ghost form for %duration% seconds, becoming immune to physical damage, but are unable to attack and %extra_spell_damage_percent%%% more vulnerable to magic damage.
notes: Ends if you become Debuff Immune, and will have no effect if you are already Debuff Immune.
Shares cooldown with all Ghost Scepter upgrades.

item_clarity.desc:
Use: Replenish

Grants %mana_regen% mana regeneration to the target for %buff_duration% seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

notes: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.

item_famango.desc:
Use: Eat Lotus

Instantly restores %replenish_amount% health and mana.
notes: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.

item_great_famango.desc:
Use: Eat Lotus

Instantly restores %replenish_amount% health and mana.
notes: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.

item_greater_famango.desc:
Use: Eat Lotus

Instantly restores %replenish_amount% health and mana.
notes: Hold Control to use on a nearby allied hero.

item_blood_grenade.desc:
Use: Throw Grenade

Throw a grenade at the target area. Enemies in the area will take %impact_damage% damage on impact, and be slowed by %movespeed_slow%%% and take %damage_over_time% damage every %tick_rate%s for %debuff_duration%s. Radius %radius%.

item_bloodslinger.desc:
Active: Sling Grenade

Launch a grenade at the target area. Enemies in the area will take %impact_damage% damage on impact, and be slowed by %movespeed_slow_max%%% and take %damage_over_time% damage every %tick_rate%s for %debuff_duration%s. Movement slow decreases over time to %movespeed_slow_min%%%. Radius %radius%.
notes: Shares a cooldown with Blood Grenade.

item_flask.desc:
Use: Salve

Grants %health_regen% health regeneration to the target for %buff_duration% seconds.

If the unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

Heals for half the amount per second when cast on an ally.

item_dust.desc:
Use: Reveal

For %duration% seconds, creates an area that reveals and slows invisible heroes by %movespeed%%% in a %radius% radius where the caster was standing. Invisible units revealed by dust take %damage% damage.

The debuff effect on enemies lingers for %linger_duration%s after leaving the area of effect.
notes: Places a debuff on enemy units in the area that reveals them when they are invisible.

item_bottle.desc:
Active: Regenerate

Consumes a charge to restore %health_restore% health and %mana_restore% mana over %restore_time% seconds. If the hero is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.

The Bottle automatically refills at the fountain.

Hold Control to use on an allied hero.

Passive: Store Rune

Runes can be stored in the Bottle for later use by right-clicking them. Unused runes will automatically activate after 90 seconds.

Using a stored rune fully refills the Bottle.
notes: Bottle is shareable. Stored runes cannot be shared.
Using a stored Bounty or Water rune fully refills the bottle if the bottle was full when the rune was stored; otherwise, it refills two charges.

item_ward_observer.desc:
Use: Plant

Plants an Observer Ward, an invisible watcher that gives ground vision in a %vision_range_tooltip% radius to your team. Lasts %duration_minutes_tooltip% minutes.

Hold Control to give one Observer Ward to an allied hero.

item_ward_sentry.desc:
Use: Plant

Plants a Sentry Ward, an invisible watcher that grants True Sight, the ability to see invisible enemy units and wards, to any existing allied vision within a %true_sight_range% radius.
Lasts %duration_minutes_tooltip% minutes.

Does not grant ground vision.
Hold Control to give one Sentry Ward to an allied hero.

item_ward_dispenser.desc:
Use: Plant

Plant the currently active ward. Double-Click to switch the currently active ward.
notes: Hold Control to give one ward to an allied hero.

item_tango.desc:
Use: Devour

Consumes a target tree to gain %health_regen% health regeneration for %buff_duration% seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.

Comes with %tooltip_charges% charges. Can be used on an allied hero to give them one Tango.

Tree Range: %abilitycastrange%

item_tango_single.desc:
Use: Devour

Consumes a target tree to gain %health_regen% health regeneration for %buff_duration% seconds. Consuming an Ironwood Tree doubles the heal duration.

Tree Range: %abilitycastrange%

item_tpscroll.desc:
Use: Teleport

After channeling for %tooltip_channel_time% seconds, teleports you to a target friendly building.

Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
notes: If multiple heroes teleport to the same location in succession, the channeling time will be increased for each successive hero.
Teleport can be prevented or canceled by Root abilities.

item_travel_boots.desc:
Upgrade: Town Portal Scroll

Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units, reduces cooldown and does not consume a charge on usage. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

item_travel_boots_2.desc:
Upgrade: Town Portal Scroll

Upgrades your Town Portal Scroll, allowing it to target units and heroes, reduces cooldown, channel time and does not consume a charge on usage. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

item_phase_boots.desc:
Active: Phase

Gives %phase_movement_speed%%% increased movement speed on melee heroes, and %phase_movement_speed_range%%% on ranged heroes, and lets you move through units and turn more quickly for %phase_duration% seconds. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.

item_power_treads.desc:
Active: Switch Attribute

Switches between +%bonus_stat% Strength, +%bonus_stat% Agility, or +%bonus_stat% Intelligence. Movement speed bonuses from multiple pairs of boots do not stack.
notes: Power Treads can be built using a Belt of Strength, Band of Elvenskin, or a Robe of the Magi.

item_phylactery.desc:
Passive: Empower Spell

The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% bonus damage to the target and slows them by %slow%%% for %slow_duration%s.

item_angels_demise.desc:
Passive: Empower Spell

The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% additional damage, disables their passives, and slows their movement speed by %slow%%% for %slow_duration%s.
notes: The slow debuff is dispellable.
The break debuff is not dispellable.

item_caduceus.desc:
Active: Force

Pushes any target unit %push_length% units in the direction it is facing, and applies one instance of Empower Spell to them.

Passive: Empower Spell

The next Unit Target spell you cast on an enemy deals a separate %bonus_spell_damage% bonus damage to the target and slows them by %slow%%% for %slow_duration%s.

The next Unit Target spell you cast on an ally heals them for %bonus_heal% and increases their movement speed by %haste%%% for %haste_duration%s.
notes: The enemy and ally halves of Empower Spell run on separate cooldowns of %enemy_proc_cooldown%s and %ally_proc_cooldown%s.
Force applies Empower Spell to its target whether or not that half's cooldown is ready, and does not put it on cooldown.
Force doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Force has %enemy_cast_range% cast range when cast on enemies.

item_hand_of_midas.desc:
Active: Transmute

Kills a non-hero target for %bonus_gold% gold. Killing a neutral creep additionally grants a madstone bundle.

Cannot be used on Ancient creeps.
notes: The gold given is unreliable gold (you do not get the normal creep bounty).
Experience gained by using Transmute is not shared.

item_witch_blade.desc:
Passive: Witch Blade

Causes your next attack to apply a poison for %slow_duration% seconds, slowing by %slow%%% and dealing %int_damage_multiplier%x your intelligence as damage every second. This attack has True Strike.
notes: Illusions do not apply Witch Blade

item_poor_mans_shield.desc:
Passive: Damage Block

Gives a 100% chance to block %damage_block_melee% damage from incoming attacks on melee heroes, and %damage_block_ranged% damage on ranged.

Has a %block_chance%%% chance to block damage from creeps.
notes: Multiple sources of damage block do not stack.

item_mekansm.desc:
Active: Restore

Restores %heal_amount% health to allied units in a %heal_radius% radius.

Passive: Mekansm Aura

Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allied units in a %aura_radius% radius.
notes: Restore does not affect units that have been affected by Restore or Guardian Greaves Mend within Mekansm's cooldown.
Multiple instances of Mekansm Aura do not stack.

item_vladmir.desc:
Passive: Vladmir's Aura

Grants %lifesteal_aura%%% lifesteal, %damage_aura%%% bonus damage, %mana_regen_aura% mana regeneration, and %armor_aura% armor to nearby allies.

Radius: %aura_radius%
notes: Lifesteal on attacks against creeps is reduced to %lifesteal_creeps_tooltip%%%.

item_ristuls_devotion.desc:
Passive: Ristul's Aura

Grants %lifesteal_aura%%% lifesteal, %spell_lifesteal_aura%%% spell lifesteal, %damage_aura%%% bonus damage, %mana_regen_aura% mana regeneration, and %armor_aura% armor to nearby allies.

Radius: %aura_radius%
notes: Lifesteal on attacks against creeps is reduced to %lifesteal_creeps_tooltip%%%.

item_buckler.desc:
Passive: Buckler Aura

Grants %bonus_aoe_armor% armor to allied player units.

Radius: %bonus_aoe_radius%

item_ring_of_basilius.desc:
Passive: Basilius Aura

Grants %aura_mana_regen% mana regeneration to allies.

Radius: %aura_radius%

item_holy_locket.desc:
Active: Energy Charge

Target an allied unit to increase their incoming Heal Amplification by %incoming_heal_increase_active%%% for %active_buff_duration%s and instantly restore %health_restore_per_charge% health and %mana_restore_per_charge% mana per charge stored.

Automatically gains a charge every %AbilityChargeRestoreTime% seconds and whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.

Passive: Holy Blessing

Amplifies heals you provide by %heal_increase_passive%%%.

item_pipe.desc:
Active: Barrier

Gives a magic damage barrier that absorbs %barrier_block% damage to all nearby allies. Lasts %barrier_duration% seconds.

Radius: %barrier_radius%

Passive: Insight Aura

Gives allied units %magic_resistance_aura%%% magic resistance.

Radius: %aura_radius%
notes: Barrier does not affect units that have been affected by Barrier within Pipe of Insight's cooldown.
Stacks multiplicatively with other sources of magic resistance.

item_urn_of_shadows.desc:
Active: Soul Release

Provides %soul_heal_amount% health regeneration when cast on allies, and deals %soul_damage_amount% damage per second when cast on enemies.

Lasts %duration% seconds.

Gains charges every time an enemy hero dies within %soul_radius% units.
notes: Empty urns gain 2 charges.
If the allied unit is attacked by an enemy hero or Roshan, the effect is lost.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

item_headdress.desc:
Passive: Regeneration Aura

Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allied player units.

Radius: %aura_radius%

item_sheepstick.desc:
Active: Hex

Turns a target unit into a harmless critter for %sheep_duration% seconds. The target has a base movement speed of %sheep_movement_speed% and will be silenced, muted, and disarmed.
Instantly destroys illusions.
notes: The target will have a base movement speed of %sheep_movement_speed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

item_orchid.desc:
Active: Soul Burn

Silences the target unit for %silence_duration% seconds. At the end of the silence, %silence_damage_percent%%% of the damage received while silenced is inflicted as bonus magical damage.

item_bloodthorn.desc:
Active: Soul Rend

Silences a target for %silence_duration% seconds. At the end of the silence, an additional %silence_damage_percent%%% of all damage taken during the silence will be dealt to the target as magical damage.

All attacks on the silenced target will deal additional damage equal to %proc_damage_heroes% if the attacker is a hero, and %proc_damage_creeps%, if the attacker is a creep. Provides True Strike for your attacks and attacks from your controlled units against the silenced target.

item_echo_sabre.desc:
Passive: Echo Strike

Causes melee attacks to attack twice in quick succession. The double attacks apply a %movement_slow%%% movement slow for %slow_duration% seconds on the first strike.

item_cyclone.desc:
Active: Cyclone

Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds. Cyclone can only be cast on enemy units or yourself.

Enemy units take %tooltip_drop_damage% magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes: You cannot cyclone allies.
Cyclones cast on yourself go through spell immunity.
Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.

item_wind_waker.desc:
Active: Cyclone

Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds. Cyclone can be cast on yourself, enemy units or allied units. When cast on yourself, you can move the tornado at a speed of %tornado_speed%.

Enemy units take %tooltip_drop_damage% magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes: Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
When cast on yourself, the cyclone can be moved anywhere at a speed of 360.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

item_force_staff.desc:
Active: Force

Pushes any target unit %push_length% units in the direction it is facing.
notes: Force Staff doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Force Staff has %enemy_cast_range% cast range when cast on enemies.

item_hurricane_pike.desc:
Active: Hurricane Thrust

Pushes you and target enemy %enemy_length% units away from each other, and for %range_duration% seconds, allows you to make %max_attacks% attacks against the target without range restrictions and with +%bonus_attack_speed% attack speed.

Can be cast on self or allies to push the target %push_length% units in the direction it is facing.
Enemy Range: %cast_range_enemy%
notes: Self-cast will use Hurricane Pike on yourself.
Hurricane Pike doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Attack Range bonuses from Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.

item_dagon.desc:
Active: Energy Burst

Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: %damage%
Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
notes: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

item_dagon_2.desc:
Active: Energy Burst

Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: %damage%
Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
notes: Instantly kills illusions.
Cast Range bonuses from Aether Lens and Dagon do not stack.

item_dagon_3.desc:
Active: Energy Burst

Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: %damage%
Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
notes: Instantly kills illusions.

item_dagon_4.desc:

Emits a powerful burst of magical damage upon a targeted enemy unit. Upgradable.

Damage: %damage%
Mana Cost: %mana_cost_tooltip%
notes: Instantly kills illusions.

item_dagon_5.desc:
